lokele: Nda baakoelo Lioi liayaläkä. Lioi liaäkä nde amamwito la Mungu, la lioi liäkä ngo nde Mungu.
english: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

lokele: Inde ayaläkä la Mungu nda baakoelo.
english: The same was in the beginning with God.

lokele: Bitotina biakelomöko ko lande, aenaka Inde, ani angɔɛnɛ yeka yakelomökö.
english: All things were made through him. Without him, nothing was made that has been made.

lokele: Eyakelomökö end’Inde, yaäkä nde liwawi; la liwawi-ao liaäkä Löwa loa bato.
english: In him was life, and the life was the light of men.

lokele: E-Löwa-lo lotoanganga nda lilima, la lilima angotiamesa Loao.
english: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome 1:5 it.

lokele: Boto ayäkä oyatomomökö la Mungu; lina liande liko Yoane.
english: There came a man sent from God, whose name was John.

lokele: Inde loya oyayala boongeli woongela Löwa, mbo bato batotina bimeleke ko l’eoka yande.
english: The same came as a witness, that he might testify about the light, that all might believe through him.

lokele: Boto ona atiäkä Löwa, nde ayäkä mbo aongeleke Löwa.
english: He was not the light, but was sent that he might testify about the light.

lokele: Loäkä nde Löwa loa wewe elotoangangela bato batoti ani atoyaka Loao nda wenda.
english: The true light that enlightens everyone was coming into the world.

lokele: Ayaläkä nde nda wenda, la wenda wayalesomökö lande, nde wenda botialuwäk’Inde.
english: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world didn’t recognize him.

lokele: Inde loya eyande, nde ebande batianyangeläk’Inde.
english: He came to his own, and those who were his own didn’t receive him.

lokele: Kongo ko Inde lofaef’iyo ebanyangeläk’Inde, bako ebalendelökö lina liande, isosha shoyalesomo bana ba Mungu;
english: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name:

lokele: iyo ana baotomöko, inga la bakila, inga la yɛmɛ ya bindo, inga la yɛmɛ ya botolome, kangä la Mungu.
english: who were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

lokele: La Lioi lokinjwa bindo, la Inde loyalana lasu; twɛnɛ̈kɛ tala yande tala kwa eya wana ɔmwitoto wa Sango; atumäkä la booto la wewe.
english: The Word became flesh and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the only born 1:14 Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.

lokele: Yoane loonga loaso loande, inde lota boekï mbo— Oyo ende Inde oyaongeläkä’mi Inde mbo, Inde oyatoya mbisa yami, nd’asɛlɔmu oso wami, eoka Inde nd’ayali oso wami,
english: John testified about him. He cried out, saying, “This was he of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me, for he was before me.’”

lokele: eoka iso yatotina tosɔɔlɔ booto la booto ko la lifafu liande.
english: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.

lokele: Eoka Bikela yafomökö la Mɔsɛ, nde booto la wewe biyi ko la Yesu Masiya.
english: For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ. 1:17

lokele: Angɔɛnɛ boto angɔmɔi nd’ɛnɛkɛ Mungu lise angɔ limɔi, wana ɔmwitoto, Mungu imɔ, oyayali bosamomu wa Sango, inde nd’asosanoel’iso Inde. Boeki ewatäkä Yoane Bolufi eoka ya Yesu
english: No one has seen God at any time. The only born 1:18 Son, 1:18 who is in the bosom of the Father, has declared him.

lokele: Liao to lile lioi eliaongäkä Yoane Bolufi liomutoela BaYuda nda mbile eyatomäk’iyo kanga la BaLewi ba Yelusaleme oyafel’inde mbo— ¿Aɛ wende to ndai?
english: This is John’s testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, “Who are you?”

lokele: Inde loaola, atiaanganäkä, inde loaola mbo— Imi, iti ango Masiya.
english: He declared, and didn’t deny, but he declared, “I am not the Christ.”

lokele: Limɔ iyo lofel’inde mbo— ¿Ndai to, wende Eliya? Inde mbo— Im’iti inde. Iyo mbo— ¿Wende Bɔtɔndɔli oyaluwani? Inde lomutola mbo— Mbayo.
english: They asked him, “What then? Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the prophet?” He answered, “No.”

lokele: Eokao, iyo loonga lande mbo— ¿Wende ndai to? Eoka tofeke limutoli ende ebatomäk’iso; ¿Otoonga nde moni loasɔ loaɛ angɛnɛ?
english: They said therefore to him, “Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”

lokele: Inde mbo— Imi yende limiki elitoamama nda liɔmbɛlɛ mbo— Komyaka mboka ya Ngɛnɛ; kwa aongäkä Bɔtɔndɔli Yesaya.
english: He said, “I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way of the Lord,’ Isaiah 40:3 as Isaiah the prophet said.”

lokele: Ebatomomökö baaka nde BaFalusi.
english: The ones who had been sent were from the Pharisees.

lokele: Iyo lofelak’inde mbo— ¿Eya to mbo aɛ oti Masiya, ango ko Eliya, ango ko Bɔtɔndɔli oyaluwani, otolufia bato eoka iye to?
english: They asked him, “Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?”

lokele: Yoane lomutoel’iyo mbo— Imi nd’atolufia la balia; ɔmɔi aemali sisi yanu oyatiluw’ino oluw’Inde,
english: John answered them, “I baptize in water, but among you stands one whom you don’t know.

lokele: ko Inde oyatoya liili liami, imi itiengane ndofaikola ikulu sha ikwaka shande.
english: He is the one who comes after me, who is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I’m not worthy to loosen.”

lokele: Loasɔ-lo loaaka nda Betania, fangi yasi ya Yaladane, olo alufieläkä Yoane. Lolembeelesomo loa Yesu
english: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.

lokele: Lɛlɛngɔ Yoane lɔɛnɛ Yesu ani atoya end’inde la inde loonga mbo— Tɛnɛ Bɔkɔkɔ wa Mungu oyatotolaka bobe wa wenda!
english: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, 1:29 the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!

lokele: Oyo end’Inde oyaongelaka’mi mbo— Mbisa yami atoya Boto oyasɛlɔmu oso wami, eoka Inde nd’ayali oso wami.
english: This is he of whom I said, ‘After me comes a man who is preferred before me, for he was before me.’

lokele: Nde Imi angɛnɛ itiluwek’Inde, kongo ko im’isoya oyalufia la balia mbo ɛnɛlɛkɛ fololo ende BaIsalaele.
english: I didn’t know him, but for this reason I came baptizing in water, that he would be revealed to Israel.”

lokele: La Yoane loonga la wewe mbo— Yɛnɛkɛ̈ Bolimo botoaa se kwa ekükü esokwi nda use, bosotalema end’Inde.
english: John testified, saying, “I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.

lokele: Nde Imi angɛnɛ itiluwek’Inde, kongo ko oyatomäkä’mi oyalufia la balia, Inde nd’aongäkä lami mbo— Oyatoɛnɛ aɛ wɛnɛ ani Bolimo botoa se la ndotikala lande, ambo ende Inde oyatolufia la Bolimo Botanu.
english: I didn’t recognize him, but he who sent me to baptize in water said to me, ‘On whomever you will see the Spirit descending and remaining on him is he who baptizes in the Holy Spirit.’

lokele: La yɛnɛkɛ̈ la isoongaka wewe mbo Inde ende Wana wa Mungu. Baeki ba Oso
english: I have seen and have testified that this is the Son of God.”

lokele: Limɔ lɛlɛngɔ aemaläkä Yoane la baeki bande bambale, inde loticha Yesu ani atoeta, Yoane mbo— Tɛnɛ, Bɔkɔkɔ wa Mungu!
english: Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,

lokele: Baeki bambale bande looka ani aongi Yoane la iyo lotuta Yesu.
english: The two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.

lokele: Limɔ Yesu lokikwa, la ɛnɛkɛ̈ Inde ani iyo batotuta, Inde loonga lau mbo— ¿Otolukä iye? Limɔ iyo loonga lande mbo— ¿Labi, (litina mbo— Boekesi) otoingala kw’anima?
english: Jesus turned and saw them following, and said to them, “What are you looking for?” They said to him, “Rabbi” (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), “where are you staying?”

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— Yauku oyɛnɛ! Eokao iyo lɔkɛ la iyo lɔɛnɛ olo aingal’Inde, iyo loyala kɔni lande lise-ao, konda mbile ya lilöngolöngo.
english: He said to them, “Come and see.” They came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour. 1:39

lokele: Andelo etungani ya Simona Petelo aaka ɔmɔi w’ebambale ebokakä kwa aongäkä Yoane la ebatutäkä Yesu;
english: One of the two who heard John and followed him was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.

lokele: inde lokosha oso boloo wande angɛnɛ ako Simona la inde loonga lande mbo— Tosoosha Masiya (litina mbo— Oy’üchomu).
english: He first found his own brother, Simon, and said to him, “We have found the Messiah!” (which is, being interpreted, Christ 1:41 ).

lokele: Inde loesha Simona ende Yesu. Yesu lɔwɛl’inde baiso, Inde mbo— Aɛ wende Simona, wana wa Yona, botangomoko mbo Kefa (litina mbo— Petelo ako Litalɛ).
english: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, “You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas” (which is by interpretation, Peter). 1:42

lokele: Lɛlɛngɔ Inde losanga oketa nda Ngalilai, la Inde loosha Filipo nda mboka; Yesu loonga lande mbo— Tutaka’mi!
english: On the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”

lokele: Filipo aäkä nde boto wa Betesaida, bokenge wa Andelo la Petelo.
english: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.

lokele: Filipo lokosha Natanaele la inde loonga lande mbo— Tosooshana la Inde oyatelomoko la Mɔsɛ nda Bikela la oyatelomoko la Batɔndɔli, ako Yesu wana wa Yosefa, boto wa Nasaleta.
english: Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, “We have found him of whom Moses in the law and also the prophets, wrote: Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”

lokele: Natanaele loonga lande mbo— ¿Bolau botokɔkɔlɔ nde osokwa nda Nasaleta? Filipo loonga lande mbo— Yauku la wɛnɛkɛ!
english: Nathanael said to him, “Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?” Philip said to him, “Come and see.”

lokele: Yesu lɔɛnɛ Natanaele atoya end’Inde, Inde loonga loasɔ loande mbo— Tɛnɛ, WaIsalaele wa wewe oyati la bolimbake!
english: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”

lokele: Natanaele loonga lande mbo— ¿Oluwi nde’mi la moni? Yesu lomutola lande mbo— Oso ani Filipo atitateke aɛ lioi, ani okoyali ose ya bosau, yɛniki nde aɛ.
english: Nathanael said to him, “How do you know me?” Jesus answered him, “Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”

lokele: Natanaele lomutola lande mbo— Labi, Aɛ wende Wana wa Mungu, Aɛ wende Bɔkɔta wa Isalaele!
english: Nathanael answered him, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are King of Israel!”

lokele: Yesu lomutola lande mbo— ¿Ko l’eoka mbo isoonga mbo yɛniki aɛ ose ya bosau, ambo osoimela? Wɛnɛkɛ nde yao yolongela ebi.
english: Jesus answered him, “Because I told you, ‘I saw you underneath the fig tree,’ do you believe? You will see greater things than these!”

lokele: Inde loonga imɔ mbo— Wewe, wewe, Imi mbo ino wɛnɛkɛ nde buse boliolomu la bakitomo ba Mungu batolila la batosulwa se ko ende Wana wa Boto.
english: He said to him, “Most certainly, I tell you all, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”

lokele: Nda lise lia asatɔ aaka nde liäla nda Kena bokenge wa Ngalilai, la nyango wa Yesu loyala omao;
english: The third day, there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there.

lokele: Yesu la baeki bande imɔ batomökö lioi nda liäla.
english: Jesus also was invited, with his disciples, to the wedding.

lokele: Aomelökö bamɔ, nyango wa Yesu loonga lande mbo— Bat’imɔ la bamɔ.
english: When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother said to him, “They have no wine.”

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— ¿Lole loni to loasɔ ende’mi laɛ, Iya? Mbile yami ekayi kɔni.
english: Jesus said to her, “Woman, what does that have to do with you and me? My hour has not yet come.”

lokele: Nyango wande loonga la ebakaeli bieka mbo— Elokongek’Inde lanu, kelaka ngo ko ongolo.
english: His mother said to the servants, “Whatever he says to you, do it.”

lokele: Yasɛlɔmɔ̈kɔ̈ omao mbutɛ bifi liambɛ eyatumäkä la balia bosola njala la bosoleli wa BaYuda. Mbutɛ lɔsɛlɛ loketi loa biangola litinda.
english: Now there were six water pots of stone set there after the Jews’ way of purifying, containing two or three metretes 2:6 apiece.

lokele: Yesu loonga lau mbo— Tumesaka mbutɛ la balia, la iyo lotumesa yao ko la biɔngɔ fuu.
english: Jesus said to them, “Fill the water pots with water.” So they filled them up to the brim.

lokele: Limɔ Inde loonga lau mbo— Angolaka kwani la kɛsɛkɛ bao ende ikomya sha elambɔ, iyo lɔkɛ la bao.
english: He said to them, “Now draw some out, and take it to the ruler of the feast.” So they took it.

lokele: Alailäkä ikomya elala ya balia ebasokinjwa kɔni bamɔ, angoluwa olo asosokwa la bao (nde bakaeli ba bieka ebaangoläkä bao nd’aluwäkä) inde lota bɔsɔngi lioi,
english: When the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and didn’t know where it came from (but the servants who had drawn the water knew), the ruler of the feast called the bridegroom

lokele: inde loonga lande mbo— Batolome batotata bamɔ balau nda mɛsa, limɔ ani basowa bamɔ, batota eba ngai, kongo ko aɛ nd’asoisa ebasoeta l’olau ko nda kwani.
english: and said to him, “Everyone serves the good wine first, and when the guests have drunk freely, then that which is worse. You have kept the good wine until now!”

lokele: Yesu loakola ndembe ya tolombo ko la shao eshakeläk’Inde nda Kena, bokenge wa Ngalilai; ongoma Inde loisolaka tala yande, la baeki bande lolendeloko Inde.
english: This beginning of his signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.

lokele: Mbisa yamao Inde lɔkɛ nda Kafenauma, la nyango wande, la bitungani yande, la baeki bande; iyo lotikala omao bacho bamɔi. Lotaneso loa balɛlɛ ba Tempelo
english: After this, he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, his brothers, and his disciples; and they stayed there a few days.

lokele: Elambɔ-ya-Lieti ya BaYuda yaäkä tina, limɔ Yesu lɔkɛ nda Yelusaleme,
english: The Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

lokele: la nda balɛlɛ ba Ndakɔ ya Mungu Inde loosha ebatoungekesa mbolo la bɛkɔkɔ la biküku, la bafetekwani ba bieto ebayalaka se omao;
english: He found in the temple those who sold oxen, sheep, and doves, and the changers of money sitting.

lokele: la Inde lokela inyɔli la tokulu, Inde losayaka iyo batotina lousa loa Ndakɔ ya Mungu, la bɛkɔkɔ la mbolo imɔ, Inde lɔwɛlɛ bieto ya bafetekwani se, Inde loukola mɛsa yau ukwa.
english: He made a whip of cords and drove all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen; and he poured out the changers’ money and overthrew their tables.

lokele: Ende ebaungesi ba biküku, Inde loonga mbo— Kusokolaka ebi lousa, okindolëke Ndakɔ ya Sango wami kwa eölö ya liongo!
english: To those who sold the doves, he said, “Take these things out of here! Don’t make my Father’s house a marketplace!”

lokele: Baeki bande loenyela mbo losotomo nda Lokasa mbo— Boliliya wolitesa ndakɔ yaɛ bosoola’mi itɔɔ.
english: His disciples remembered that it was written, “Zeal for your house will eat me up.” Psalms 69:9

lokele: Eokao BaYuda lomutoel’Inde la lofelo mbo— Ototamb’iso eni ndembe ya isosha esitokel’aɛ la njasɔ-bi?
english: The Jews therefore answered him, “What sign do you show us, seeing that you do these things?”

lokele: Yesu lomutoel’iyo mbo— Ukolaka Ndakɔ-ye ya Mungu, la itoemesa yao liasi nda bacho basatɔ!
english: Jesus answered them, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.”

lokele: Limɔ BaYuda loonga mbo— Miaka kama inɛi la liambɛ yɛngani nde la liswi lia Ndakɔ-ye ya Mungu; ¿Nde Aɛ koemesa yao la bacho basatɔ kongo?
english: The Jews therefore said, “It took forty-six years to build this temple! Will you raise it up in three days?”

lokele: Nde Inde nd’aongäkä loasɔ loa Ndakɔ ya Mungu eko bindo yande.
english: But he spoke of the temple of his body.

lokele: Eokao akatɛmwɛk’Inde nda liwa, baeki bande loenyela mbo aongäkä lioi-li la iyo loimela Lokasa loa Mungu la lioi eliaongak’Inde.
english: When therefore he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he said this, and they believed the Scripture and the word which Jesus had said.

lokele: Ayaläk’Inde nda Yelusaleme nda mbile ya Elambɔ-ya-Lieti bato wike lolendelo lina liande ani bɛnɛ̈kɛ̈ ndembe ya tolombo etwakelak’Inde;
english: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the Passover, during the feast, many believed in his name, observing his signs which he did.

lokele: nde Yesu angɛnɛ atialendeloko iyo, eoka aluwäkä bato batotina la mbo atiaenökö mbo boto aluwesek’Inde loasɔ loa balomboki eoka Inde angɛnɛ nd’aluwäkä betema ya balomboki.
english: But Jesus didn’t entrust himself to them, because he knew everyone,

lokele: Yaäkä boto wa BaFalusi, lina liande liko Nikodemo, ayaläkä Bokumi wa BaYuda.
english: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.

lokele: Boto-yo loya ende Yesu la ocho, inde loonga lande mbo— Labi, toluwi nde mbo wende Boekesi oyasokwi ende Mungu; angwɛnɛ to boto angɔmɔi wokɔkɔlɔ okelaka ndembe ya tolombo ebitokelak’Aɛ, sakolo ngo Mungu koyala lande.
english: He came to Jesus by night and said to him, “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher who has come from God, for no one can do these signs that you do, unless God is with him.”

lokele: Yesu lomutoel’inde mbo— Wewe, wewe, itoonga laɛ mbo, Sakolo ko boto kootomo lɔɔtɔ loa Use, ani inde angokɔkɔlɔ ndɔɛnɛ Bɔkɔta wa Mungu.
english: Jesus answered him, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born anew, 3:3 he can’t see God’s Kingdom.”

lokele: Nikodemo loonga lande mbo— ¿Boto kokɔkɔlɔ nde ndootomo ani asoya inunu la moni? Atokɔkɔlɔ ndɔɔtɔ liasi nda sɔlɔ ya nyango wande la ndootomo?
english: Nicodemus said to him, “How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother’s womb and be born?”

lokele: Yesu lomutola mbo— Wewe, wewe, itoonga laɛ mbo, sakolo ko boto kootomo la balia la Bolimo, ani aitokɔkɔlɔ ndɔɔtɔ nda Bɔkɔta wa Mungu.
english: Jesus answered, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and Spirit, he can’t enter into God’s Kingdom.

lokele: Eyeotomu la bindo, ele ko bindo, la eyeotomu la Bolimo, yende ngo Bolimo.
english: That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

lokele: Omwalëke mbo iongiki mbo— Loengani nde lanu ndootomo lɔɔtɔ loa Use.
english: Don’t marvel that I said to you, ‘You must all be born anew.’

lokele: Lofofo lotofofa l’olo l’olo atosanga loao, la otoka limiki lia loao, nde otiluwe olo asokwi la loao, kwa olo atɔkɛ la loao; lole ongoma la boto la boto oyaotomu la Bolimo.
english: The wind 3:8 blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don’t know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit.”

lokele: Nikodemo lomutoel’Inde mbo— ¿Lotokɔkɔlɔ oyala ongoma moni?
english: Nicodemus answered him, “How can these things be?”

lokele: Yesu lomutoel’inde mbo— ¿Aɛ wende Boekesi wa Isalaele, nde otiluweke eloasɔ-lo?
english: Jesus answered him, “Are you the teacher of Israel, and don’t understand these things?

lokele: Wewe wewe, itoonga laɛ mbo tosoonga ko baoi ebasoluwak’iso, la tosokambekesa bato ko yao ebisɔɛn’iso; kongo ko ino botikulye inango shasu.
english: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know and testify of that which we have seen, and you don’t receive our witness.

lokele: Yekambes’ino eya ono se ani otiimele; ¿Otoimela to moni eya Use ebitokambesa’mi ino?
english: If I told you earthly things and you don’t believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?

lokele: La angwɛnɛ imɔ boto oyasoilama nda Use, sakolo ngo ko Inde oyasosulwa se nda Use, ako Wana wa Boto angɛnɛ.
english: No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.

lokele: Kwa iläkä Mɔsɛ njɔ nda liɔmbɛlɛ, ongoma loengani la Wana wa Boto mbo Inde ilomoko imɔ koilomo,
english: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,

lokele: ko mbo oyakalendeloko Inde ɛɔlɔkɔ nde liwawi lia loiko.
english: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

lokele: Mungu asamäkä to bato ba wenda la losamɔ loeta, eokao afäkä Wana ɔmwitoto wande mbo oyatolendelo Inde, atiangosɛɛsɛlɛkɛ, kongo ko ɛɔlɔkɔ nde liwawi lia loiko.
english: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born 3:16 Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

lokele: Mungu atiatomäkä Wana wande nda wenda ko mbo afeke bato ba wenda se, kangä mbo eba wenda buwesomoko ko lande.
english: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.

lokele: Oyakalendeloko Inde, aitofomo se, nde oyatialendeloko Inde akofomo se ko kwani, eoka atilendelo lina lia Wana ɔmwitoto wa Mungu.
english: He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the only born Son of God.

lokele: Lifomu se lina lile mbo löwa losoya nda wenda, kongo ko bato basosama lilima la losamɔ loeta eloa löwa, eoka bekeeli yau bende imɔ ibe.
english: This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light, for their works were evil.

lokele: Eoka boto la boto oyatokelaka bekeeli ya bɔwɛwɛ, atɔɛnɛ löwa mbo bobe, la aitoyaka nda löwa mbo bekeeli yande bitatombolomo;
english: For everyone who does evil hates the light and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.

lokele: nde inde oyatokelaka ko eya wewe, eyaka nde nda löwa, mbo bekeeli yande yɛnɛlɛkɛ fololo mbo bikelomu l’isosha sha Mungu. Yesu nda yese ya Yudea
english: But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his works may be revealed, that they have been done in God.”

lokele: Mbisa yamao Yesu la baeki bande lɔkɛ nda yese ya Yudea la Inde lolengela omao amamwito lau, Inde lolufia bato.
english: After these things, Jesus came with his disciples into the land of Judea. He stayed there with them and baptized.

lokele: Yoane imɔ lolufiaka bato omao nda Ainona tina la Salema eoka balia baaka wike omao, la bato lɔkɛsɛkɛnɛ end’inde ndokalufiomo,
english: John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. They came and were baptized;

lokele: ani Yoane akakushomu kɔni nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ.
english: for John was not yet thrown into prison.

lokele: Ongoma baeki ba Yoane la BaYuda bamɔi lofenyakana lioi loasɔ loa lisooli liko lilufi,
english: Therefore a dispute arose on the part of John’s disciples with some Jews about purification.

lokele: la iyo lɔkɛ ende Yoane, iyo loonga lande mbo— Labi, tɛnɛ ngo, Inde oyaaka laɛ fangi y’ona ya Yaledene, oyaongelak’aɛ eongel’Inde, atolufia bato la batotina batokɛkɛ end’Inde.
english: They came to John and said to him, “Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold, he baptizes, and everyone is coming to him.”

lokele: Yoane lomutola mbo— Boto angokɔkɔlɔ ndɔsɛlɛ isosha sakolo ko mbo shao kofomo inde ko la Use.
english: John answered, “A man can receive nothing unless it has been given him from heaven.

lokele: Ino angɛnɛ nd’atokɔcha lioi liami mbo iongiki mbo— Imi iti Masiya, kangä mbo yatomomökö oso wande.
english: You yourselves testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ,’ but, ‘I have been sent before him.’

lokele: Oyaundi bowai, ende ko bɔsɔngi; nde wina wa bɔsɔngi oyatoemala lande, atookaka inde lioi liande, inde koomala finɛ eoka ya limiki lia bɔsɔngi; eokao limɛngɔ liami nda loasɔ-lo lisɔɔlɔlɔ hɔlɔ.
english: He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice. Therefore my joy is made full.

lokele: Loengani nde lande mbo asɛngɛkɛ, nde lami mbo yɔndwɛkɛ se.
english: He must increase, but I must decrease.

lokele: Inde oyasokwi nda Use nd’alongeli batotina; nde oyasokwi ono se, nd’ayali ewa se la inde nd’atoonga eya ono se. Inde oyasokwi nda Use nd’alongeli batotina,
english: “He who comes from above is above all. He who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks of the earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.

lokele: la atoluwesa bato yao ebiɛni la ebiokak’Inde, kongo ko angwɛnɛ boto wokulya inango shande.
english: What he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and no one receives his witness.

lokele: Oyatoimela inango shande, ambo ona asokɔcha lioi mbo Mungu ende wewe.
english: He who has received his witness has set his seal to this, that God is true.

lokele: Oyatomomökö la Mungu, nd’atoonga inango sha Mungu la Mungu nd’atofaef’Inde Bolimo wande l’angwɛnɛ ikai.
english: For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.

lokele: Sango asoniya Wana la asɔsɛlɛ bitotina nda bosamba wande.
english: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.

lokele: Oyatolendelo Wana, ambo inde ayali la liwawi lia loiko, nde oyatotefola Wana, atilɛnɛkɛ liwawi, nde efango ya Mungu esɔɔnwelɔ inde.
english: One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys 3:36 the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.”

lokele: Aluwäkä Ngɛnɛ mbo BaFalusi bokäkä mbo Inde ako Yesu asɛli nde baeki wike la mbo asolufia bato bolongela Yoane,
english: Therefore when the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John

lokele: (nde Yesu angɛnɛ atialufiäkä, kanga baeki bande)
english: (although Jesus himself didn’t baptize, but his disciples),

lokele: Inde losokwa nda Yudea okakɛ liasi nda Ngalilai,
english: he left Judea and departed into Galilee.

lokele: la lɔkɛndɔ loeta la tukela ya Samalia.
english: He needed to pass through Samaria.

lokele: Inde loiya to nda bokenge wa Samalia boko Sukala, tina la botungu ewafäkä Yakobo ende wana wande ako Yosefa, la isolo sha Yakobo shaäkä omao.
english: So he came to a city of Samaria called Sychar, near the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.

lokele: Kwa alewäkä Yesu la lɔkɛndɔ, Inde loyala se tina la isolo sha balia ndɔɛuma ani buse bosoiya ifitika.
english: Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being tired from his journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour. 4:6

lokele: Otomali wa Samalia loya oyatoka balia. Yesu loonga lande mbo— Faka’mi sumbu imweke.
english: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, “Give me a drink.”

lokele: Baeki bande bakɛkɛ nda okenge okasomba bieka yola.
english: For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.

lokele: Botomali wa Samalia loonga to lande mbo— ¿Monito Aɛ ako WaYuda, nd’aombi balia bomwa ende’mi botomali wa Samalia? (Eoka BaYuda la BaSamalia angoluwana)
english: The Samaritan woman therefore said to him, “How is it that you, being a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)

lokele: Yesu lomutoel’inde mbo— Eya to mbo waluwa nde bofäfä wa Mungu, la waluwa Inde oyafeli nd’aɛ mbo Faka’mi imweke, ani aɛ nd’afelik’Inde la Inde nd’afiki aɛ balia ba liwawi.
english: Jesus answered her, “If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, ‘Give me a drink,’ you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water.”

lokele: Botomali loonga lande mbo— Bwana, oti la ɛɛngɔ yotoka balia la liyondo lile la bolundu; ¿Otɔɔsɔ to balia ba liwawi anima to?
english: The woman said to him, “Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. So where do you get that living water?

lokele: ¿Aɛ nd’alongeli Tata wasu ako Yakobo, oyafaefäk’iso eliyondo-li, la oyamwäkä balia ba liao inde la bana bande la mbolo yande lisanga?
english: Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did his children and his livestock?”

lokele: Yesu lomutola la botomali mbo— Oyatomwa ebalia-ba, eokaka yɛmɛ yomwa liasi,
english: Jesus answered her, “Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again,

lokele: nde oyatomwa balia ebakafeke’mi ef’inde, atilokek’imɔ yɛmɛ yomwa liasi, kongo ko balia ebakafeke’mi inde, bao koyalaka isolo sha balia esitofulwafulwa la liwawi lia lokato.
english: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.”

lokele: Botomali loonga lande mbo— Bwana, faka to’mi ebalia-ba mbo itaokak’imɔ yɛmɛ yomwa, mbo itayak’imɔ oyatoka balia eyamaya.
english: The woman said to him, “Sir, give me this water, so that I don’t get thirsty, neither come all the way here to draw.”

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— Kɛndɛkɛ okata bolome waɛ lioi, limɔ inwaka eya.
english: Jesus said to her, “Go, call your husband, and come here.”

lokele: Otomali lomutola mbo— Iti la bolome. Yesu mbo— Oongi nde wewe, mbo oti la bolome,
english: The woman answered, “I have no husband.” Jesus said to her, “You said well, ‘I have no husband,’

lokele: eoka oyaliki nde la batolome bɔɔmwi la botolome oyayali laɛ kwani, ati to ewaɛ bolome, ongoma oongi nde wewe.
english: for you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband. This you have said truly.”

lokele: Botomali loonga lande mbo— Bwana, isɔɛnɛ mbo Aɛ wende Bɔtɔndɔli;
english: The woman said to him, “Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.

lokele: bangau basu basemoläkä Mungu nda elöngo-lo nde ino BaYuda mbo Yelusaleme kongo ende elela eyengani mbo bato basemoleke Mungu.
english: Our fathers worshiped in this mountain, and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where people ought to worship.”

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— Botomali, imelaka’mi, mbile etoya eyeitosemol’ino Sango kwa ono nda elöngo-lo, kwa nda Yelusaleme;
english: Jesus said to her, “Woman, believe me, the hour is coming when neither in this mountain nor in Jerusalem will you worship the Father.

lokele: ino BaSamalia botosemola oyaitoluw’ino oluwa Inde, nde iso nd’asosemola inde oyasoluw’iso, eoka liuwesi litoya ko la BaYuda.
english: You worship that which you don’t know. We worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.

lokele: Kongo ko mbile eyaka, esoya nde kwani, eyetosemola bato ba wewe Mungu Sango ko la bolimo la wewe, eoka Mungu akoluka nde bɔfɔnɔ-bo wa bato mbo basemolek’Inde.
english: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshipers.

lokele: Mungu ende Bolimo, ebatosemol’Inde basemolek’Inde la bolimo la wewe.
english: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”

lokele: Botomali loonga lande mbo— Iluwi nde mbo Masiya (oyatangomu mbo Oyuchomu) atoya la akayek’Inde atokambes’iso bitotina.
english: The woman said to him, “I know that Messiah is coming, he who is called Christ. 4:25 When he has come, he will declare to us all things.”

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— Imi oyatoonga laɛ, yende Inde.
english: Jesus said to her, “I am he, the one who speaks to you.”

lokele: Lamao baeki bande loya, iyo lomwaala mbo atoongana la botomali, kongo ko angwɛnɛ angɔmɔi nd’afelak’Inde mbo— ¿Oluki nd’iye? kwa mbo— ¿Oongani nde lande moni?
english: Just then, his disciples came. They marveled that he was speaking with a woman; yet no one said, “What are you looking for?” or, “Why do you speak with her?”

lokele: Limɔ botomali lomacha wangola wande, inde lɔkɛ nda bokenge, inde loonga la bato mbo—
english: So the woman left her water pot, went away into the city, and said to the people,

lokele: Yauku oyɛnɛ boto oyakambesi nde’mi bitotina ebisokela’mi; eluwa Inde atayala Masiya?
english: “Come, see a man who told me everything that I have done. Can this be the Christ?”

lokele: Iyo lokuswaka nda bokenge, iyo lɔkɛsɛnɛ end’Inde.
english: They went out of the city, and were coming to him.

lokele: Nda mbile-ao baeki bande lolɔmbɔkɔl’Inde mbo— Labi, laka sumbu yeka.
english: In the meanwhile, the disciples urged him, saying, “Rabbi, eat.”

lokele: Nde Inde loonga lau mbo— Imi yende la bieka yola ebitiluwe ino.
english: But he said to them, “I have food to eat that you don’t know about.”

lokele: Eokao iyo longana mbo— ¿Mbo boto asoeshel’Inde bieka yola?
english: The disciples therefore said to one another, “Has anyone brought him something to eat?”

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— Bieka yami yende ndokela kwa asangi oyatomäkä’mi la ndɔɔlɔlɛsɛ eliande likuwa.
english: Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work.

lokele: Mbo ino oitoonga mbo— Ko tengai inɛi limɔ eula etoya? Tɛnɛ ngo, Imi mbo— Liolaka baiso banu, tichaka bilanga mbo bisotela kwani ko la eula.
english: Don’t you say, ‘There are yet four months until the harvest’? Behold, I tell you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields, that they are white for harvest already.

lokele: Oyatotenaka bangwindi asɔɔlɔ bieka la atosɔnja tuma konda liwawi lia loiko mbo bɔlɔi la oyatotwa eula basanganeke limɛngɔ.
english: He who reaps receives wages and gathers fruit to eternal life, that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.

lokele: Nda loasɔ-lo ikɔ̈kɔ sile wewe siko mbo— Ɔmɔi atɔlɔɔ, wasi kotwa eula.
english: For in this the saying is true, ‘One sows, and another reaps.’

lokele: Imi nd’atom’ino ndotwa eula ya elanga eyetikuwek’ino; basi nd’asokuwaka la ino nd’aɔli ebikuw’iyo.
english: I sent you to reap that for which you haven’t labored. Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor.”

lokele: Bato wike ba bokenge ona wa Samalia lolendelo Yesu eoka ya inango sha otomali oyaluwesak’iyo mbo— Akambesi nde’mi bitotina ebisokela’mi.
english: From that city many of the Samaritans believed in him because of the word of the woman, who testified, “He told me everything that I have done.”

lokele: Ayäkä to eba Samalia end’Inde, iyo lolɔmbɔkɔl’Inde mbo atikaleke lau la Inde lotikala omao bacho bambale.
english: So when the Samaritans came to him, they begged him to stay with them. He stayed there two days.

lokele: Limɔ basi wike loimela eoka ya lioi liande angɛnɛ,
english: Many more believed because of his word.

lokele: iyo loonga la botomali mbo— Eti imɔ eoka ya lioi liaɛ elisoimel’iso, eoka iso angɛnɛ nd’asoka la toluwi nde mbo Inde ona ende Bouwesi wa wenda bototina. Yesu lonyangelomo nda Ngalilai
english: They said to the woman, “Now we believe, not because of your speaking; for we have heard for ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world.”

lokele: Mbisa ya bacho bambale to, Inde losokwa omao okakɛ nda Ngalilai,
english: After the two days he went out from there and went into Galilee.

lokele: eoka Yesu angɛnɛ lokulia mbo Bɔtɔndɔli ati la lokuku nda yese yande angɛnɛ.
english: For Jesus himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.

lokele: Iyak’Inde nda Ngalilai, eba Ngalilai lonyangel’Inde eoka bɛnɛkɛ bitotina eyakeläk’Inde nda Yelusaleme nda Elambɔ eoka lau imɔ baɛkɛ omao nda Elambɔ.
english: So when he came into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast, for they also went to the feast.

lokele: Ani Inde loya liasi nda Kena ya Ngalilai, olo akindoläk’Inde balia liamɔ. Louweso loa wana wa Bonyafala Bonyafala ɔmɔi wa Bɔkɔta ayaläkä la wana wande botolome la loo nda Kafenauma.
english: Jesus came therefore again to Cana of Galilee, where he made the water into wine. There was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum.

lokele: Okäk’inde mbo Yesu asosokwa nda Yudea oyaiya nda Ngalilai inde lɔkɛ end’Inde la inde lolɔmbɔkɔl’Inde mbo aɛkɛ okuwesa wana wande, eoka inde loyala oko tina lowa.
english: When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to him and begged him that he would come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— Sakolo ko wɛnɛ ndembe la bisisho, ino angoimela.
english: Jesus therefore said to him, “Unless you people see signs and wonders, you will in no way believe.”

lokele: Bonyafala wa Bɔkɔta loonga lande mbo— Bwana, yauku to oso wa liwa lia wana wami.
english: The nobleman said to him, “Sir, come down before my child dies.”

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— Kɛndɛkɛ eyaɛ, wana waɛ akoyala la liwawi. Boto loimela lioi eliaongäkä Yesu lande, inde lɔkɛ.
english: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your son lives.” The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.

lokele: Aɛk’inde la mboka, bɛkɔwa yande loyatowana lande, iyo mbo wana wande akoyala la liwawi;
english: As he was going down, his servants met him and reported, saying “Your child lives!”

lokele: inde lofela to iyo mbile eyasäsäkä wana. Iyo lokambesa to inde mbo— Lɛlɛngɔ mbisa ya ifitika, etao lomach’inde.
english: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better. They said therefore to him, “Yesterday at the seventh hour, 4:52 the fever left him.”

lokele: Ongoma sango loluwa mbo yaaka ko mbile eyaongäka Yesu lande mbo— Wana waɛ akoyala la liwawi, la inde la bofindi wande bototina loimela Yesu.
english: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said to him, “Your son lives.” He believed, as did his whole house.

lokele: Eye yende ilombo sha tombale eshakeläkä Yesu, ani asokwäkä Inde nda Yudea ndokakɛ nda Ngalilai.
english: This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judea into Galilee.

lokele: Mbisa yamao yaäkä Elambɔ ya BaYuda la Yesu akɛndɛ̈kɛ̈ Yelusaleme.
english: After these things, there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

lokele: Nda bokenge wa Yelusaleme to, tina la liongo lia bɛkɔkɔ, loaaka lyaa lia balia eliatangomökö nda lioi lia BaYuda mbo Betesata, la yaäka la balɛlɛ bɔɔmwi ba batalɛ omao.
english: Now in Jerusalem by the sheep gate, there is a pool, which is called in Hebrew, “Bethesda”, having five porches.

lokele: Nda balɛlɛ ana likama lia bato ba kambo loingakala se, bako eba etuku, l’eba bikoti, l’ebalɛmbɛti.
english: In these lay a great multitude of those who were sick, blind, lame, or paralyzed, waiting for the moving of the water;

lokele: Boto ɔmɔi loyala nde amao oyaäkä la lokambo miaka kama isatɔ la bonanɛi.
english: A certain man was there who had been sick for thirty-eight years.

lokele: Yesu lɔɛnɛ inde ani aingal’inde se ina, la aluwäk’Inde mbo asoumwa mbile yumwa ongoma, Inde loonga lande mbo— ¿Olɛmbi nde ndɔɔlɔ bosäsu?
english: When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he had been sick for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be made well?”

lokele: Boto wa lokambo lomutoel’Inde mbo— Bwana, iti la boto bota’mi nda lyaa ani liela lia balia litoya, atɔkɛ’mi omao boto wasi atokwela’mi oso.
english: The sick man answered him, “Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, but while I’m coming, another steps down before me.”

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— Emalaka, ilaka tange yaɛ, tangwaka.
english: Jesus said to him, “Arise, take up your mat, and walk.”

lokele: Lisasaya inde losäsesomo, inde loila tange yande, inde lotangwaka. Lise lia Yenga Lise-ao liäkä nde elia Yenga.
english: Immediately, the man was made well, and took up his mat and walked. Now that day was a Sabbath.

lokele: Eokao BaYuda loonga la boto oyasäsesomökö mbo— Louse ende lise lia Yenga la lotiengane laɛ ndoilaka tange yaɛ.
english: So the Jews said to him who was cured, “It is the Sabbath. It is not lawful for you to carry the mat.”

lokele: Nde inde lomutola lau mbo— Oyasäsoliki’mi, nd’aongi lami mbo— Ilaka tange yaɛ, tangwaka.
english: He answered them, “He who made me well said to me, ‘Take up your mat and walk.’

lokele: Iyo lofel’inde mbo— ¿Boto ndai oyaongi laɛ mbo— Ilaka tange yaɛ, tangwaka?
english: Then they asked him, “Who is the man who said to you, ‘Take up your mat and walk’ ?”

lokele: Nde inde oyasäsesomökö atialuwäkä imɔ Inde, eoka Yesu loengwa bokamu wa bato omao.
english: But he who was healed didn’t know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, a crowd being in the place.

lokele: Mbisa yamao, Yesu looshana lande nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu, Inde loonga lande mbo— Tɛnɛ ngo, ososäsesomo, okelëk’imɔ bobe, mbo loasɔ lolongela loo la owau, lotawɛlɛmɛ end’aɛ.
english: Afterward Jesus found him in the temple and said to him, “Behold, you are made well. Sin no more, so that nothing worse happens to you.”

lokele: Boto lɔkɛ la inde lokambesa BaYuda mbo ale ko Yesu oyasäsesik’inde.
english: The man went away, and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.

lokele: Eokao BaYuda loakola ndokongola Yesu eoka atokelaka njasɔ-bi la lise lia Yenga.
english: For this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus and sought to kill him, because he did these things on the Sabbath.

lokele: Nde Yesu lomutoel’iyo mbo— Sango wami akokelaka likuwa liande, la Imi imɔ ikokeli likuwa liami.
english: But Jesus answered them, “My Father is still working, so I am working, too.”

lokele: Eoka ya baoi-ba to BaYuda lookel’Inde yɛmɛ yool’Inde, yoeta eya oso, inga eoka asotefola liti lia Yenga kongo, nde simbi to eoka atangi nde Mungu mbo Sango wande, anyo aenganesi Inde angɛnɛ la Mungu.
english: For this cause therefore the Jews sought all the more to kill him, because he not only broke the Sabbath, but also called God his own Father, making himself equal with God.

lokele: Yesu lomutoel’iyo to mbo— Wewe, wewe, itoonga lanu mbo Wana angokɔkɔlɔ okela loasɔ angolɔmoi ko Inde angɛnɛ, sakolo ko yao eyɛni Inde mbo Sango nd’akeli yao; eoka yao ebitokelaka Sango, Wana nd’atokela imɔ ko yao. Lioi lia Yesu eoka ya liwawi la liwa
english: Jesus therefore answered them, “Most certainly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father doing. For whatever things he does, these the Son also does likewise.

lokele: Sango asoniya Wana la atɔɛnɛsɛ Wana bitotina ebitokelak’Inde angɛnɛ la ɛnɛsɛkɛ Wana bekeeli yolongela-bi mbo ino omwaleke.
english: For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he himself does. He will show him greater works than these, that you may marvel.

lokele: Kwa atotɛmwɛse Sango ebawäkä la atofaef’iyo liwawi liasi, ko ongoma Wana atofaka liwawi ende bato ebakasangek’Inde ofa liao.
english: For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son also gives life to whom he desires.

lokele: Ati to Sango oyatoatela boto njasɔ, nde asofa Wana isosha sha liati lia njasɔ,
english: For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,

lokele: mbo batotina baliteseke Wana, kwani atolites’iyo olitesa Sango angɛnɛ. Oyaitolitesa Wana, ambo aitolitesa Sango oyatomäkä Wana.
english: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn’t honor the Son doesn’t honor the Father who sent him.

lokele: Wewe, wewe, itoonga lanu mbo oyatoka lioi liami la oyatolendelo Inde oyatomäkä’mi, ambo asɔɔlɔ liwawi lia loiko la atilaɔtɛkɛ nda liati, kongo ko asosokwa nda liwa okaɔtɔ nda liwawi.
english: “Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life, and doesn’t come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.

lokele: Wewe, wewe, itoonga lanu mbo mbile eyaka nde, eingo esoya kwani eyetokaka ebawi nde limiki lia Wana wa Mungu, la iyo ebatoka belayalaka la liwawi.
english: Most certainly I tell you, the hour comes, and now is, when the dead will hear the Son of God’s voice; and those who hear will live.

lokele: Kwa Sango to ayali ngɛnɛ wa liwawi, ongoma imɔ asofaefa Wana isosha shoyala ngɛnɛ wa liwawi;
english: For as the Father has life in himself, even so he gave to the Son also to have life in himself.

lokele: la Sango asofaef’Inde imɔ isosha shoataka njasɔ eoka Inde nd’ayali Wana wa Boto.
english: He also gave him authority to execute judgment, because he is a son of man.

lokele: Omwalëke eloasɔ-lo, eoka la mbile eyekayeke, batotina ebayali nda sai, belokaka limiki liande,
english: Don’t marvel at this, for the hour comes in which all who are in the tombs will hear his voice

lokele: la belatɛmwaka nda liwa okaɔtɔ nda loiko, bako bakelaki ba olau, nde bakelaki ba bobe belatɛmwaka ko ndofomo se. Likɔchi lia lioi lia Yesu
english: and will come out; those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of judgment.

lokele: Imi angɛnɛ itikɔkɔlɛ ndokela loasɔ ango lomɔi; ko ani atoka’mi, itoata ongoma, la liataki liami liengani nde, eoka iitofumba ndokelaka ko lisangi liami, kangä lisangi liande oyatomäkä’mi.
english: I can of myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge; and my judgment is righteous, because I don’t seek my own will, but the will of my Father who sent me.

lokele: Eya to mbo yetaka inango shami angɛnɛ, ambo inango shami siitokulyomo mbo wewe;
english: “If I testify about myself, my witness is not valid.

lokele: Wasi nd’atota inango eoka yami, la Imi nd’aluwi mbo inango esitot’Inde eoka yami, shende wewe.
english: It is another who testifies about me. I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true.

lokele: Ino watomäkä ende Yoane, la inde lotaka inango sha wewe,
english: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.

lokele: nde likulyi elisolɛmbɛ’mi liti elia bato, nde iongi nde lioi-li lia Yoane mbo buwesomoko.
english: But the testimony which I receive is not from man. However, I say these things that you may be saved.

lokele: Inde ayaläka nde faka eyonganäkä foi la bolangalangu la ino watalɛmbɛ̈kɛ̈ ndoyaimwa ko mbile ɛmɔi la bolangalangu wande.
english: He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.

lokele: Nde Imi nd’ayali la inango sholonga esha Yoane, eoka likuwa eliafäkä Mungu efa’mi mbo yɔlɔlɛsɛkɛ liao, liao kongo elikokela’mi oko kwani, liao lile inango mbo Sango nd’atomäkä’mi.
english: But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John; for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish, the very works that I do, testify about me, that the Father has sent me.

lokele: La oyatomäkä’mi ako Sango, Inde nd’atota inango loasɔ loami. Otioke limiki liande, otiɛnɛ bɔfɔnɔ wande,
english: The Father himself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.

lokele: la lioi liande litiingale nda betema yanu eoka otiimel’Inde oyatomomökö lande.
english: You don’t have his word living in you, because you don’t believe him whom he sent.

lokele: Ototangakela kasa ya Mungu, eoka otangi nde mbo bɔsɛlɛkɛ nde Liwawi ko la yao, kongo ko yao bitotaka inango loasɔ loami;
english: “You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify about me.

lokele: nde ino otilɛmbɛ ndoya ende’mi mbo bɔɔlɛkɛ Liwawi.
english: Yet you will not come to me, that you may have life.

lokele: Lokuku loa bato, itikulye loao.
english: I don’t receive glory from men.

lokele: Iluwi nde mbo ino oti la losamɔ loa Mungu nda betema yanu.
english: But I know you, that you don’t have God’s love in yourselves.

lokele: Isoya ko nda lina lia Sango wami, nde otinyangele’mi; wasi nde koya nda lina liande angɛnɛ, ani ino konyangela nde ona.
english: I have come in my Father’s name, and you don’t receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.

lokele: ¿Ino nd’atokɔkɔlɔ ndoimela la moni, ani otokulya liineli lia baina lanu, kongo ko otiluke liineli elitosokwa ko ende Mungu Ɔmwitoto?
english: How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don’t seek the glory that comes from the only God?

lokele: Otangëke mbo Imi nd’atof’ino se oso wa Sango, ende ko Mɔsɛ oyatof’ino se, la osokɛsɛkɛ tɔɛli twanu ko end’inde kongo.
english: “Don’t think that I will accuse you to the Father. There is one who accuses you, even Moses, on whom you have set your hope.

lokele: Eya to mbo wimeläkä nde Mɔsɛ, ani osoimela Imi, eoka inde nd’asɔnɔ̈kɔ̈ loaso loami nda Kasa.
english: For if you believed Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote about me.

lokele: ¿Eya to mbo otiimele eyasonɔ̈kɔ̈ inde, ani ino koimela ebami baoi la moni?
english: But if you don’t believe his writings, how will you believe my words?”

lokele: Mbisa yaamao, Yesu loleka eliya ya Ngalilai-eko eya Tibelia-
english: After these things, Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee, which is also called the Sea of Tiberias.

lokele: nde bikuke ya bato lotutak’Inde eoka bɛ̈nɛkɛ̈ tolombo etokelik’Inde ende eba kambo.
english: A great multitude followed him, because they saw his signs which he did on those who were sick.

lokele: Yesu lolila to nda löngo, Inde loyala se omao amamwito la baeki bande.
english: Jesus went up into the mountain, and he sat there with his disciples.

lokele: Elambɔ ya BaYuda, eko Lieti, yaaka tina.
english: Now the Passover, the feast of the Jews, was at hand.

lokele: Iläkä Yesu baiso, Inde loɛnɛ bikuke ina ya bato batoya end’Inde, Inde loonga la Filipo mbo— ¿Tosombeke batuma bolesa ebato-ba ko anima?
english: Jesus therefore, lifting up his eyes and seeing that a great multitude was coming to him, said to Philip, “Where are we to buy bread, that these may eat?”

lokele: Inde loonga la Filipo ongoma ndokɔtɔlɔ inde, eoka Inde angɛnɛ aluwi ani atokel’Inde.
english: He said this to test him, for he himself knew what he would do.

lokele: Filipo lomutola lande mbo— Batuma ba loketi loa falanga mia imbale angoengana l’ebato-ba mbo boto la boto aɔlɛkɛ ko sinyo.
english: Philip answered him, “Two hundred denarii 6:7 worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may receive a little.”

lokele: Ɔmɔi wa baeki bande, ako Andelo, etungani ya Simona Petelo, inde loonga lande mbo—
english: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to him,

lokele: Wainɛngɛ ale ono oyasɛli beila bɔɔmwi la swi imbale. ¿Kongo yende iye yokaela ende bato-ba wike?
english: “There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but what are these among so many?”

lokele: Yesu loonga mbo— Yalesak’iyo se. Twingi wike twäkä nda elela ena, iyo loyala to se, batolome benganäkä loketi loa bilɛfu bɔɔmwi.
english: Jesus said, “Have the people sit down.” Now there was much grass in that place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

lokele: Lamao Yesu lɔɔsɔ beila, Inde lofa kelekele, Inde lofaekefa bato ebayalaka se, la swi imɔ ongoma, kwa alɛmbɛk’iyo.
english: Jesus took the loaves, and having given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to those who were sitting down, likewise also of the fish as much as they desired.

lokele: Okanelöko iyo batotina, Inde loonga la baeki bande mbo— Sɔnjaka twinyo twa bieka ebitikali mbo yeka etalefana.
english: When they were filled, he said to his disciples, “Gather up the broken pieces which are left over, that nothing be lost.”

lokele: Eokao, iyo losɔnja, iyo lotumesa bisaka liu la imbale la twinyo twa beila bɔɔmwi etosotikala ende ebaläkä.
english: So they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with broken pieces from the five barley loaves, which were left over by those who had eaten.

lokele: Lamao ɛnɛkɛ bato ilombo eshakeläk’Inde, iyo mbo— Wewe, Inde ende Bɔtɔndɔli oyakayeke nda wenda.
english: When therefore the people saw the sign which Jesus did, they said, “This is truly the prophet who comes into the world.”

lokele: Aluwäkä to Yesu mbo basikioyaund’Inde mbo batalieke Inde Bɔkɔta, Inde loinwa mbisa okakɛ nda löngo ko Inde angɛnɛ. Yesu lotanda likolo lia balia
english: Jesus therefore, perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force to make him king, withdrew again to the mountain by himself.

lokele: Iläkä buse likɔlɔse, baeki bande lɔkɛ ko nda ngɔngɛ ya balia,
english: When evening came, his disciples went down to the sea.

lokele: iyo lokwa nda watɔ, iyo loilya owale okaleka eliya fangi ya Kafenauma. Nde akwäkä lilima se, l’ani Yesu akayi kɔni end’iyo;
english: They entered into the boat, and were going over the sea to Capernaum. It was now dark, and Jesus had not come to them.

lokele: eliya lokwelo batutu eoka lomba lofi lofofa.
english: The sea was tossed by a great wind blowing.

lokele: Alükak’iyo kilometa bɔɔmwi, iyo lɔɛnɛ Yesu atotandaka olikolo lia balia, tina la watɔ, iyo lowänga.
english: When therefore they had rowed about twenty-five or thirty stadia, 6:19 they saw Jesus walking on the sea See Job 9:8 and drawing near to the boat; and they were afraid.

lokele: Nde Yesu loonga lau mbo— Yende Imi, owangëke!
english: But he said to them, “It is I. 6:20 Don’t be afraid.”

lokele: Asangäk’iyo ndot’Inde nda watɔ, kwaamao watɔ loiya nda ngɔngɛ olo aɛk’iyo.
english: They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat. Immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.

lokele: Lɛlɛngɔ, batɔ ba ekuke ebatikaläkä fangi yasi ya eliya, iyo lɔɛnɛ mbo angwɛnɛ watɔ wasi, ko wao ebokwiki la baeki kongo, la mbo Yesu angɛnɛ atikwe lau nda watɔ, la mbo baeki bande basɔkɛ iyo angɛnɛ,
english: On the next day, the multitude that stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there, except the one in which his disciples had embarked, and that Jesus hadn’t entered with his disciples into the boat, but his disciples had gone away alone.

lokele: (Nde bitumbe bimɔi ya Tibelia loya oyaelama tina la elela olo aläkä bato beila mbisa ani Yesu lofa kelekëlë.)
english: However, boats from Tiberias came near to the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks.

lokele: Limɔ ɛnɛ̈k’iyo to mbo Yesu at’imɔ omao, la baeki bande imɔ ati omao, iyo lokwaka nda bitumbe bina, iyo lɔkɛ nda Kafenauma ndokaluke Yesu.
english: When the multitude therefore saw that Jesus wasn’t there, nor his disciples, they themselves got into the boats and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.

lokele: La oshak’iyo oosha Yesu fangi yasi ya eliya, iyo loonga lande mbo— ¿Labi, oyi nde eya l’eni to mbile? Lituma lia loiko
english: When they found him on the other side of the sea, they asked him, “Rabbi, when did you come here?”

lokele: Yesu lomutola lau mbo— Wewe, wewe, itoonga lanu mbo, otiye oyaluka Imi eoka ya ndembe ya tolombo eyɛnɛ̈k’ino, kangä eoka oliki nde batuma la okaneluku.
english: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, you seek me, not because you saw signs, but because you ate of the loaves and were filled.

lokele: Okuwelëke bieka ebitosɛɛsɛlɛ, kangä bieka ebitokata ko nda liwawi lia lokato, yao ebitofaefa Wana wa Boto efaef’ino, eoka Sango ako Mungu asot’Inde ndembe mbo asokuly’Inde.
english: Don’t work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give to you. For God the Father has sealed him.”

lokele: Limɔ iyo loonga lande mbo— Tokeleke to moni mbo bekeeli yasu biomaleseke Mungu?
english: They said therefore to him, “What must we do, that we may work the works of God?”

lokele: Yesu lomutoel’iyo mbo— Ebo bole bokeeli ebolɛmbi Mungu, boko mbo bolendeloko Inde oyatomomu la Mungu.
english: Jesus answered them, “This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent.”

lokele: Iyo loonga to lande, mbo— ¿Eokao, eni ndembe ya ilombo esitokel’Aɛ, mbo twɛnɛkɛ la twimeleke Aɛ; eni ndembe eyetokel’Aɛ?
english: They said therefore to him, “What then do you do for a sign, that we may see and believe you? What work do you do?

lokele: Batata basu baläkä Mana nda liɔmbɛlɛ, kwa atomöko nda Lokasa mbo— Afäk’iyo lituma eliasekwäkä nda Use mbo baleke.
english: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness. As it is written, ‘He gave them bread out of heaven 6:31 to eat.’” Exodus 16:4

lokele: Yesu loonga nde lau mbo— Wewe, wewe, itoonga lanu mbo— Atiäkä Mɔsɛ oyafäk’ino lituma lia Use, kangä Sango wami oyakof’ino lituma lia wewe elisosekwa nda Use.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, it wasn’t Moses who gave you the bread out of heaven, but my Father gives you the true bread out of heaven.

lokele: Lituma lia wewe liende liao elitosekwaka nde Use la elitofaka liwawi ende eba wenda.
english: For the bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven and gives life to the world.”

lokele: Iyo loonga to lande mbo— Ngɛnɛ, faefaka’iso litumali lise la lise.
english: They said therefore to him, “Lord, always give us this bread.”

lokele: Yesu loonga lau mbo— Imi yende Lituma lia liwawi. Inde oyatoya ende’mi atilokek’imɔ isiyɛ liasi, la inde oyatolendelo’mi, atilokek’imɔ yɛmɛ yomwa liasi.
english: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will not be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.

lokele: Nde yaongäkä lanu mbo osɔɛnɛ Imi, nde oitoimela.
english: But I told you that you have seen me, and yet you don’t believe.

lokele: Batotina ebatofa Sango ofa’mi, beyaka ende Imi la oyatoya ende Imi, Imi angofeka inde.
english: All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.

lokele: Eoka isokwi nde nda Use, inga ndoyakelaka lisangi liami angɛnɛ, kangä lisangi liande oyatomäkä Imi.
english: For I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.

lokele: Lisangi liande oyatomäkä’mi liko mbo itialefeseke angomwito wa batotina ebafäk’Inde ofa’mi, nde yetɛmwɛsɛk’iyo la liwawi nda lise lia liko.
english: This is the will of my Father who sent me, that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing, but should raise him up at the last day.

lokele: Eli liende lisangi lia Sango wami, liko mbo batotina ebatɔɛnɛ Wana la ebatolendelo Inde, ambo bɛɔlɔkɔ nde liwawi lia layalaya la mbo Imi yetɛmwɛsɛk’iyo la liwawi nda lise lia liko.
english: This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son and believes in him should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.”

lokele: Limɔ BaYuda loimaimel’Inde eoka aongäkä mbo Imi yende Lituma elisosekwa nda Use.
english: The Jews therefore murmured concerning him, because he said, “I am the bread which came down out of heaven.”

lokele: Iyo mbo— ?Oyo ati Yesu, wana wa Yosefa, toisoluwa sango la nyango wande? Monito asoonga kwani mbo— Isokwi nde nda Use?
english: They said, “Isn’t this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then does he say, ‘I have come down out of heaven’?”

lokele: Okimakimanëke;
english: Therefore Jesus answered them, “Don’t murmur among yourselves.

lokele: angwɛnɛ oto wokɔkɔlɔ oya ende’mi, sakolo ko Sango oyatomäkä’mi nd’asosuly’inde la Imi nd’atotɛmwɛsɛ inde la liwawi nda lise lia liko.
english: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him; and I will raise him up in the last day.

lokele: Losotomo nda Kasa ya batɔndɔli mbo— Batotina bekesomoko ko la Mungu. Oyasoka limiki lia Mungu la asoekesomo lande, inde atoya ende’mi.
english: It is written in the prophets, ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Isaiah 54:13 Therefore everyone who hears from the Father and has learned, comes to me.

lokele: Eti to mbo boto aɛni nde Sango, sakolo ngo ko Inde oyayali wa Mungu, Inde nd’ɛnɛ̈kɛ̈ Sango.
english: Not that anyone has seen the Father, except he who is from God. He has seen the Father.

lokele: Wewe, wewe itoonga lanu mbo— Oyasoimela asɔɔlɔ liwawi lia lokato.
english: Most certainly, I tell you, he who believes in me has eternal life.

lokele: Imi yende Lituma lia Liwawi;
english: I am the bread of life.

lokele: batata banu baläkä Mana nda liɔmbɛlɛ la bawäkä.
english: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness and they died.

lokele: Eli liende lituma lia Use elisulwi nde se mbo boto oyatola liao, angow’imɔ.
english: This is the bread which comes down out of heaven, that anyone may eat of it and not die.

lokele: Imi yende Lituma lia liwawi elisosokwa nda Use; eyambo boto elaka e-lituma-li, eyalaka nde la liwawi konda layalaya; la lituma elitofa’mi of’inde, liende bindo yami ebitofa’mi loasɔ loa loiko loa wenda.
english: I am the living bread which came down out of heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. Yes, the bread which I will give for the life of the world is my flesh.”

lokele: Eoka ya loao, BaYuda lowesakana, iyo mbo— ¿Botoyo atokɔkɔlɔ ndof’iso bindo yande yola ko moni?
english: The Jews therefore contended with one another, saying, “How can this man give us his flesh to eat?”

lokele: Yesu loonga to lau mbo— Wewe, wewe, itoonga lanu mbo, sakolo ko bola bindo ya Wana wa Boto la bomwa bakila bande, ani ot’imɔ la liwawi nd’atiteni yanu.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you don’t have life in yourselves.

lokele: Oyatolaka bindo yami la oyatomwaka bakila bami, inde asɛli nde liwawi lia loiko la yetɛmwɛsɛk’inde nda lise lia liko.
english: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.

lokele: Eoka bindo yami yende bieka ya wewe, la bakila bami bende limwi lia wewe.
english: For my flesh is food indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

lokele: Oyatolaka bindo yami la oyatomwaka bakila bami, atoyalaka lami la Imi nd’atoyalaka lande.
english: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.

lokele: Kwa atomäkä Sango, oyale la liwawi, otoma Imi, la iyali nde la liwawi ko l’eoka yande, ko ongoma oyatolaka’mi, eyalaka nde la liwawi ko l’eoka yami.
english: As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father, so he who feeds on me will also live because of me.

lokele: Eli liende lituma eliasekwaka nda Use, inga kwa elialäkä batata banu ebawäkä; oyatolaka lituma-li, eyalaka nde la liwawi konda layalaya.
english: This is the bread which came down out of heaven—not as our fathers ate the manna and died. He who eats this bread will live forever.”

lokele: Aongäkä baoi-ba ani atoekekesa bato nda ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ nda Kafenauma. Baeki bamɔi loɛnɛ tale nda liekesi
english: He said these things in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.

lokele: Ongoma baeki bande bamɔi, okakä’iyo elioi-li lia Yesu, iyo mbo— Elioi-li lile la tale finɛ. ¿Ndai to atɔkɔkɔlɔ ndokulya liao?
english: Therefore many of his disciples, when they heard this, said, “This is a hard saying! Who can listen to it?”

lokele: Aluwäkä to Yesu mbo baeki bande basoimaimela elioi-li, Inde loonga lau mbo— ¿Mbo elioi-li lisokes’ino botema wale?
english: But Jesus knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this, said to them, “Does this cause you to stumble?

lokele: ¿Eya to mbo wɛnɛ Wana wa Boto ani atoilama likolo olo ayaläk’Inde oso, ino moni?
english: Then what if you would see the Son of Man ascending to where he was before?

lokele: Bolimo nd’atosɛlɛ boto la liwawi, bindo kongo angosung’iso; baoi bami ebaongäkä’mi lanu, bao bende bolimo la liwawi end’ino.
english: It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.

lokele: Nde bende bamɔi banu ebaitoimela. Nde Yesu loluwa konda liako ebatiimeleke la oyakawambek’Inde;
english: But there are some of you who don’t believe.” For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who didn’t believe, and who it was who would betray him.

lokele: la Inde loonga mbo— Ko l’eokao yakambesak’ino mbo angwɛnɛ boto wokɔkɔlɔ ndoya ende’mi sakolo ko efomo isosha sha Sango.
english: He said, “For this cause I have said to you that no one can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father.”

lokele: Laamao baeki bamɔi wike loinwainwa la batikɛndɛ-kɛndɛk’imɔ lande.
english: At this, many of his disciples went back and walked no more with him.

lokele: Limɔ Yesu loonga la eba liu la ambale mbo— ¿La ino imɔ olɛmbi ko ndosokwa?
english: Jesus said therefore to the twelve, “You don’t also want to go away, do you?”

lokele: Simona Petelo lomutoel’Inde mbo— Ngɛnɛ, tɔɛkɛ to ende ndai? Aɛ wende la baoi boluwesa loiko loa layalaya,
english: Simon Peter answered him, “Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.

lokele: la iso nd’asoimela la toluwi nde kwani mbo Aɛ wende Ebotanu wa Mungu.
english: We have come to believe and know that you are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”

lokele: Yesu lomutola lau mbo— ¿Iisoaa ino, eba liu la ambale? Nde ɔmɔi wanu ende bolimo obe.
english: Jesus answered them, “Didn’t I choose you, the twelve, and one of you is a devil?”

lokele: Inde loonga loasɔ loa Yudasi wana wa Simona wa Keliota, eoka inde, ako ɔmɔi wa eba liu la ambale, akawambek’Inde ende BaYuda.
english: Now he spoke of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, for it was he who would betray him, being one of the twelve.

lokele: Mbisa yamao, Yesu akɛndɛkɛndɛ̈kɛ̈ nda Ngalilai; atilɛmbɛkɛ okɛndɛkɛndɛ nda Yudea eoka BaYuda loluka fofe yool’Inde.
english: After these things, Jesus was walking in Galilee, for he wouldn’t walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him.

lokele: Nde Elambɔ ya BaYuda eko eya Kumbo loya tina,
english: Now the feast of the Jews, the Feast of Booths, was at hand.

lokele: eokao bitungani yande loonga lande mbo— Sokwaka nda yese-ye, kɛndɛkɛ nda Yudea mbo baeki baɛ omao bɛnɛkɛ ebitokelak’Aɛ,
english: His brothers therefore said to him, “Depart from here and go into Judea, that your disciples also may see your works which you do.

lokele: eoka boto oyalɛmbi ndoluwana fololo, aitokelaka likuwa liande wisakumbo. Bokela yao, ɛnɛsɛkɛ Aɛ angɛnɛ nda wenda fololo.
english: For no one does anything in secret while he seeks to be known openly. If you do these things, reveal yourself to the world.”

lokele: Eoka bitungani yande angɛnɛ bitiimelek’Inde.
english: For even his brothers didn’t believe in him.

lokele: Yesu loonga to lau mbo— Yose yami ekayi kɔni, nde eyanu yengani mbile la mbile.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.

lokele: Bato ba wenda batikɔkɔlɛ ndoiyana lanu, batoiya nde Imi eoka Imi nd’atokambes’iyo wewe mbo bekeeli yau bende ibe.
english: The world can’t hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.

lokele: Ino kɛndɛkɛ nda Elambɔ, Imi ititakɛ kɔni nda Elambɔ-ye eoka mbo yose yami ekiiyeli kɔni.
english: You go up to the feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, because my time is not yet fulfilled.”

lokele: Aongäk’Inde ongoma ani Inde loyala kɔni nda Ngalilai. Yesu lɔkɛ nda Elambɔ ya Kumbo
english: Having said these things to them, he stayed in Galilee.

lokele: Nde asiläkä bitungani yande ndɔkɛ Yelusaleme nda Elambɔ, limɔ Inde imɔ lɔkɛ, inga to fololo, kangä wisakumbo.
english: But when his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.

lokele: BaYuda loakola ndoluk’Inde nda Elambɔ, iyo mbo— ¿Boto ona ale to anima?
english: The Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, “Where is he?”

lokele: Bato ba bikuke angɛnɛ loimaima finɛ loasɔ loande; bamɔi loonga mbo— Ale boto olau. Nde basi mbo— Mba, atolimbaka bato!
english: There was much murmuring among the multitudes concerning him. Some said, “He is a good man.” Others said, “Not so, but he leads the multitude astray.”

lokele: Kongo ko angwɛnɛ boto woonga loasɔ loande fololo eoka bawangi nde BaYuda.
english: Yet no one spoke openly of him for fear of the Jews.

lokele: Lise limɔi atiteni ya Elambɔ, Yesu lɔkɛ nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu la Inde loakola ndoekekesa bato ina.
english: But when it was now the middle of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and taught.

lokele: Eokao BaYuda lomwaala, iyo mbo— ¿Boto-yo aluwi nde kasa la moni ani atiayaläkä boeki wewe?
english: The Jews therefore marveled, saying, “How does this man know letters, having never been educated?”

lokele: Eokao Yesu lomutola lau mbo— Eliami liekesi-li liti liami angɛnɛ, kangä lia Oyatomäkä’mi.
english: Jesus therefore answered them, “My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.

lokele: Boto esanga nde ndokela lisangi lia Mungu, atoluwa kwa mbo liekesi liami liende lia Mungu, kwa mbo isoonga l’isosha shami angɛnɛ.
english: If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God or if I am speaking from myself.

lokele: Oyatoekesa la isosha shande angɛnɛ, ona atoluka tala yande angɛnɛ; nde oyatoluka ko tala ya oyatomäk’Inde, ona ale wewe; atitefole Bikela.
english: He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

lokele: ¿Ati Mɔsɛ oyafäk’ino Bikela? Nde angwɛnɛ angɔmɔi wanu oyatolitesa Bikela. ¿Ɔlɛmbi nde ndoola’mi eoka iye to?
english: Didn’t Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?”

lokele: Bato ba ekuke loonga mbo— Wende la bolimo obe; ¿Ndai alɛmbi nde ndool’Aɛ?
english: The multitude answered, “You have a demon! Who seeks to kill you?”

lokele: Yesu lomutoel’iyo mbo— Likuwa limwito kongo elikeliki’mi, la batotina banu basomwaala;
english: Jesus answered them, “I did one work and you all marvel because of it.

lokele: Mɔsɛ afäk’ino liteni lia itombe (nde litiäkä elia Mɔsɛ, kangä elia batata banu) la nda lise lia yenga ototena boto itombe.
english: Moses has given you circumcision (not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers), and on the Sabbath you circumcise a boy.

lokele: ¿Boto etenomo to itombe la lise lia yenga mbo Bikela ya Mɔsɛ bitatefolomo, ino ososomaka lami moni ani isosäsesa bindo bitotina ya boto la lise lia yenga?
english: If a boy receives circumcision on the Sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me because I made a man completely healthy on the Sabbath?

lokele: Watëke loasɔ faufau, kangä la liengani lilau!
english: Don’t judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.”

lokele: Bato bamɔi ba Yelusaleme loonga mbo— ¿Mbo oyo ati Inde oyatoluka bamɔi mbo bolek’Inde?
english: Therefore some of them of Jerusalem said, “Isn’t this he whom they seek to kill?

lokele: Tɛnɛ ngo, atonangola fololo, nde baitoonga lande lioi. ¿Ende to wewe mbo Bekumi nd’aluwi mbo Oyo ende Masiya?
english: Behold, he speaks openly, and they say nothing to him. Can it be that the rulers indeed know that this is truly the Christ?

lokele: Nde toluwi olo asokwi nde boto-yo, nde akayeke Masiya, angwɛnɛ boto woluwa olo akasokwek’Inde.
english: However, we know where this man comes from, but when the Christ comes, no one will know where he comes from.”

lokele: Eokao Yesu loanjanja nda liekesi liande nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu, mbo— Oluwi nde Imi la oluwi imɔ olo asokwaka’mi, la itiye la isosha shami angɛnɛ, kangä la shao sha wewe sha Inde oyatomäkä’mi, ino angoluw’Inde.
english: Jesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, “You both know me, and know where I am from. I have not come of myself, but he who sent me is true, whom you don’t know.

lokele: Imi nd’aluw’Inde, eoka isokwi nde end’Inde la Inde nd’atomi Imi.
english: I know him, because I am from him, and he sent me.”

lokele: Limɔ iyo loluka fofe yound’Inde nde angwɛnɛ boto wotel’Inde bosamba eoka lisho liande likayi kɔni.
english: They sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.

lokele: Nde bato wike lolendelo Inde, iyo mbo— ¿Akayeke Masiya, ekelaka nde ndembe ya tolombo yolongela yao ebisokela boto-yo?
english: But of the multitude, many believed in him. They said, “When the Christ comes, he won’t do more signs than those which this man has done, will he?”

lokele: BaFalusi looka ani atoimaimaka bato loasɔ loande, limɔ kanga ebieti la BaFalusi lotoma benyafala ya betingani mbo baundesek’Inde.
english: The Pharisees heard the multitude murmuring these things concerning him, and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him.

lokele: Limɔ Yesu loonga mbo— Ko mbile sinyo kongo itoyala lanu lamao itɔkɛ end’Inde oyatomäkä’mi.
english: Then Jesus said, “I will be with you a little while longer, then I go to him who sent me.

lokele: Bolukaka’mi nde otiɛnɛkɛ’mi; la olo atoyalaka’mi ino angokɔkɔlɔ ndoiya omao.
english: You will seek me and won’t find me. You can’t come where I am.”

lokele: Eokao BaYuda loongana mbo— Boto-yo asangɔkɛ to anima mbo iso angoosh’Inde? ¿Atɔkɛ to ende ebasomelana okalimela nda yese ya BaHela, okaekesa BaHela omao?
english: The Jews therefore said among themselves, “Where will this man go that we won’t find him? Will he go to the Dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks?

lokele: ¿Lioi-li moni eliongi nd’Inde mbo— Bolukaka’mi nde otiɛnɛkɛ’mi; la olo atoyalaka’mi ino angokɔkɔlɔ ndoiya omao? Balia ba Loiko
english: What is this word that he said, ‘You will seek me, and won’t find me;’ and ‘Where I am, you can’t come’ ?”

lokele: Nda lise lia liko lia Elambɔ elile lise lifi, Yesu loemakala, inde loanjanja mbo— Boto eoka yɛmɛ yomwa ayeke to ende’mi la amweke.
english: Now on the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink!

lokele: Oyatolendelo’mi, baande ba balia ba liwawi bechaka nde okuswa nda botema wande, kwa aongäkä Lokasa loa Mungu.
english: He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.”

lokele: Ongoma, Yesu loonga loasɔ loa Bolimo ebokaɔlɛkɛ ebatolendelo Inde, eoka Bolimo bokafomu kɔni ende bato, eoka Yesu akaɔli kɔni tala yande.
english: But he said this about the Spirit, which those believing in him were to receive. For the Holy Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus wasn’t yet glorified.

lokele: Okäkä to bamɔi ba ekuke ebaoi-ba, iyo mbo— Wewe, Oyo ende Bɔtɔndɔli.
english: Many of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, “This is truly the prophet.”

lokele: Bamɔi mbo— Oyo ende Masiya. Nde basi mbo— ¿Mbo Masiya atosokwa nda Ngalilai?
english: Others said, “This is the Christ.” But some said, “What, does the Christ come out of Galilee?

lokele: ¿Lokasa loa Mungu lotiaongäkä mbo Masiya eotomoko nde nda bɔkɔ̈kɔ wa Dawidi, nda bokenge wa Betelehemu, ewayaeläkä Dawidi?
english: Hasn’t the Scripture said that the Christ comes of the offspring 7:42 of David, 2 Samuel 7:12 and from Bethlehem, Micah 5:2 the village where David was?”

lokele: Eokao bato ba ekuke angokulyana loasɔ loande;
english: So a division arose in the multitude because of him.

lokele: bamɔi bau balɛmbɛkɛ ndoundes’Inde, nde angwɛnɛ boto wotel’Inde bosamba.
english: Some of them would have arrested him, but no one laid hands on him.

lokele: Benyafala ya betingani loinwa to ende kanga ebieti la BaFalusi, iyo loonga lau mbo— ¿Monito otiesh’Inde?
english: The officers therefore came to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said to them, “Why didn’t you bring him?”

lokele: Benyafala lomutola mbo— Angwɛnɛ ango oto woonga kwa asoonga eboto-yo.
english: The officers answered, “No man ever spoke like this man!”

lokele: Eokao, BaFalusi lomutoel’iyo mbo— La ino imɔ osolimbakomo?
english: The Pharisees therefore answered them, “You aren’t also led astray, are you?

lokele: ¿Oni to wa bekumi kwa wa BaFalusi oyasolendelo Inde?
english: Have any of the rulers or any of the Pharisees believed in him?

lokele: Kongo ko bato ba ekuke-ye batiluwe Bikela, basosendomo bieo!
english: But this multitude that doesn’t know the law is cursed.”

lokele: Nikodemo (ako inde oyaɛkɛ ende Yesu oso la ocho) oyaäkä ɔmɔi wau, inde loonga mbo—
english: Nicodemus (he who came to him by night, being one of them) said to them,

lokele: ¿Bikela yasu bitofa nde oto se, oso ani totitaoke ani atoong’inde, la ndoluwa ebitokel’inde?
english: “Does our law judge a man unless it first hears from him personally and knows what he does?”

lokele: Iyo lomutoel’inde mbo— ¿Laɛ imɔ wende wa Ngalilai? Tatangaka nda Lokasa, wɛnɛ nde mbo angwɛnɛ Bɔtɔndɔli bokuswa nda Ngalilai.
english: They answered him, “Are you also from Galilee? Search and see that no prophet has arisen out of Galilee.” See Isaiah 9:1

lokele: Limɔ iyo lomelana oto la oto ko nda ndakɔ eyande.
english: Everyone went to his own house,

lokele: Nde Yesu lɔkɛ nda löngo loa Elaya.
english: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.

lokele: Lɛlɛngɔ la nɔngɔ Inde lɔɔtɔ liasi nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu la batotina loya end’Inde omao, Inde loyala se ndoekes’iyo.
english: Now very early in the morning, he came again into the temple, and all the people came to him. He sat down and taught them.

lokele: Batikasa la BaFalusi loeshel’Inde otomali oyaoshomu lau ani asotwa nyongo. Iyo loemesa botomali atiteni yau,
english: The scribes and the Pharisees brought a woman taken in adultery. Having set her in the middle,

lokele: limɔ iyo loonga la Yesu mbo— Boekesi, botomali-bo looshomo ani akotwa nyongo;
english: they told him, “Teacher, we found this woman in adultery, in the very act.

lokele: Mɔsɛ nda Bikela lotel’iso ndola mbo tooleke ebɔfɔnɔ-bo wa boto ko la fëngu ya batalɛ; ¿Aɛ nd’atoonga moni loasɔ loande?
english: Now in our law, Moses commanded us to stone such women. Leviticus 20:10 What then do you say about her?”

lokele: Iyo loonga ongoma ko ndokɔtɔlɔ Inde mbo bɛnɛkɛ loasɔ lowanjel’Inde. Nde Yesu lotulama se, Inde lotaka ndembe nda nyɛlɛ la isangakala;
english: They said this testing him, that they might have something to accuse him of. But Jesus stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.

lokele: nde afelakäk’iyo imɔ liasi, Inde loila botö liasi, Inde loonga lau mbo— Boto ona wanu oyati la litwanelo, atakushaka litalɛ lia oso.
english: But when they continued asking him, he looked up and said to them, “He who is without sin among you, let him throw the first stone at her.”

lokele: Limɔ Inde lotulama se liasi ndotaka ndembe nda nyɛlɛ.
english: Again he stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.

lokele: Okäk’iyo ani, iyo loakola ndokuswakuswa, oso biange limɔ basi, ko nd’atikaläkä ko Yesu angɛnɛ la otomali omao nd’atiteni.
english: They, when they heard it, being convicted by their conscience, went out one by one, beginning from the oldest, even to the last. Jesus was left alone with the woman where she was, in the middle.

lokele: Yesu loilaka botö, Inde loonga lande mbo— ¿Botomali, bende to anima; Angwɛnɛ botö wofa aɛ se?
english: Jesus, standing up, saw her and said, “Woman, where are your accusers? Did no one condemn you?”

lokele: Botomali loonga mbo— Angwɛnɛ oto, Bwana. Yesu mbo— Imi imɔ, iitof’aɛ se; kɛndɛkɛ eyaɛ, okelëk’imɔ obe liasi. Löwa loa Wenda
english: She said, “No one, Lord.” Jesus said, “Neither do I condemn you. Go your way. From now on, sin no more.” 8:11

lokele: Yesu loonga lau liasi, Inde mbo— Imi yende Löwa loa wenda; boto oyatotuta’mi, aitokɛndɛkɛndɛ nda lilima, kongo ko atoyalaka nda löwa loa loiko.
english: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. Isaiah 60:1 He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”

lokele: Eokao BaFalusi loonga lande mbo— Otokambesa bato loaso loaɛ angɛnɛ, inango shaɛ siti to wewe.
english: The Pharisees therefore said to him, “You testify about yourself. Your testimony is not valid.”

lokele: Yesu lomutoel’iyo mbo— Ambo yekambesa to bato loasɔ loami angɛnɛ, inango shami shende wewe, eoka iluwi nde olo asokwäkä lami la olo akaɛkɛ lami, nde ino otiluwe olo asokwäkä lami la olo akaɛkɛ lami.
english: Jesus answered them, “Even if I testify about myself, my testimony is true, for I know where I came from, and where I am going; but you don’t know where I came from, or where I am going.

lokele: Ino osoata loasɔ kwa asɔɛnɛ ino lokomba loa oto, nde Imi angoata loasɔ loa oto angɔmɔi;
english: You judge according to the flesh. I judge no one.

lokele: nde ambo yeata loasɔ, liati eliami liengani nde, eoka itiyale ko Imi kongo, kangä Imi la Inde imɔ oyatomäkä’mi.
english: Even if I do judge, my judgment is true, for I am not alone, but I am with the Father who sent me.

lokele: Nda Bikela yanu angɛnɛ losotomo mbo tonango twa bato ambale tole wewe.
english: It’s also written in your law that the testimony of two people is valid. Deuteronomy 17:6

lokele: Imi nd’atota inango loasɔ loami angɛnɛ, la Inde oyatomäkä’mi ako Sango atota inango sha’mi.
