english: I am one who testifies about myself, and the Father who sent me testifies about me.”

lokele: Iyo loonga to lande mbo— ¿Sango waɛ ende to anima? Yesu mbo— Otiluwe ango Imi, angoko Sango wami; eya boluwa nde Imi, ani boluwa imɔ ko Sango wami.
english: They said therefore to him, “Where is your Father?” Jesus answered, “You know neither me nor my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also.”

lokele: Yesu loonga ebaoi-ba tina la ɛsɔnjɛlɔ ya lifaefi ani aekesak’iyo nda ndakɔ ya Mungu, nde boto angɔmɔi woundes’Inde eoka likayi eliande lisho. Wike lolendelo Yesu
english: Jesus spoke these words in the treasury, as he taught in the temple. Yet no one arrested him, because his hour had not yet come.

lokele: Yesu loonga lau liasi mbo— Im’itosokwa eyamaya, limɔ ino bolukaka’mi la bowaka nde nda obe wanu. Olo akaɛkɛ lami, ino botiakɔkɔlɛkɛ ndoya.
english: Jesus said therefore again to them, “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go, you can’t come.”

lokele: Eokao BaYuda loonga mbo— Mbo atokakwa linga eoka Inde mbo, Olo akaɛkɛ lami, ino botiakɔkɔlɛkɛ ndoya?
english: The Jews therefore said, “Will he kill himself, because he says, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come’ ?”

lokele: Yesu loonga lau mbo— Ino wende ba ono se, Imi yende w’olikolo; ino wende wa ewenda-bo, Im’iti wa ewenda-bo.
english: He said to them, “You are from beneath. I am from above. You are of this world. I am not of this world.

lokele: Iongi nde lanu mbo bowaka nde nda obe wanu, eyambo botiimele mbo yende Inde, ambo ino kowa nda obe ebotokelak’ino.
english: I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am 8:24 he, you will die in your sins.”

lokele: Lamao iyo loonga lande mbo— ¿Aɛ wende ndai? Yesu loonga lau mbo— Ko nda liako, kwa aongiki’mi lanu oso.
english: They said therefore to him, “Who are you?” Jesus said to them, “Just what I have been saying to you from the beginning.

lokele: Yende la wike woonga loaso loanu la ndoatakel’ino. Nde oyatomäkä’mi ende wewe la yao eyaokäkä’mi end’Inde ambo yao ebitokambesa’mi nda wenda. (
english: I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you. However, he who sent me is true; and the things which I heard from him, these I say to the world.”

lokele: Nde batialuwäkä mbo aongäkä lau loaso loa Sango.)
english: They didn’t understand that he spoke to them about the Father.

lokele: Akilek’ino Wana wa Boto, ani boluwaka nde mbo yende Inde, la mbo iitokela loasɔ ko la isosha shami angɛnɛ, kangä kwa aekesäkä Sango oekesa’mi, ambo Imi nd’atoonga ko ongoma.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he, and I do nothing of myself, but as my Father taught me, I say these things.

lokele: Inde oyatomäkä’mi ale amamwito lami, atimache Imi ikɛndi, eoka Imi nd’atokelaka ko yao ebitoomales’Inde.
english: He who sent me is with me. The Father hasn’t left me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to him.”

lokele: Aongäkä’Inde ongoma, bato wike loimela Inde. Bana ba Abalayama bende bandai?
english: As he spoke these things, many believed in him.

lokele: Eokao Yesu loakola ndoonga la BaYuda ebimeläk’Inde, mbo— Bokɔkɔmɔ to nda lioi liami, ambo wayala nde baeki bami wewe,
english: Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him, “If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples.

lokele: la ongoma waluwa nde njasɔ ya wewe, la wewe botokindol’ino toote.
english: You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.” Psalms 119:45

lokele: Iyo lomutola lande mbo— Iso twende eba lioti lia Abalayama, totiayaläkä bɛkɔwa ya boto. ¿Monito osoonga mbo— Botokindolomo toote?
english: They answered him, “We are Abraham’s offspring, and have never been in bondage to anyone. How do you say, ‘You will be made free’ ?”

lokele: Yesu lomutola lau mbo— Wewe, wewe itoonga lanu mbo oyatokelaka bobe ende ko bɔkɔwa wa obe.
english: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, everyone who commits sin is the bondservant of sin.

lokele: Bɔkɔwa aitoyalaka to nda litumbe lia Ngɛnɛ layalaya, kangä wana nd’atoyalaka layalaya.
english: A bondservant doesn’t live in the house forever. A son remains forever.

lokele: Eokao, eya to mbo Wana ekindol’ino toote, ambo wende toote wewe.
english: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.

lokele: Iluwi nde mbo wende lioti lia Abalayama, kongo ko otoluka nde fofe yoola’mi, eoka mbo Lioi liami liti la elela nda betema yanu.
english: I know that you are Abraham’s offspring, yet you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.

lokele: Imi nd’atoonga loasɔ loa yao eyɛnɛkɛ’mi ende Sango wami, nde ino nd’atokelaka ko yao ebisok’ino ende ewanu sango.
english: I say the things which I have seen with my Father; and you also do the things which you have seen with your father.”

lokele: Iyo lomutola lande mbo— Abalayama ende sango wasu. Yesu loonga lau mbo— Eya mbo boyala bana ba Abalayama, ani bokelaka nde yao eyakeläkä imɔ Abalayama.
english: They answered him, “Our father is Abraham.” Jesus said to them, “If you were Abraham’s children, you would do the works of Abraham.

lokele: Kwani to wende la yɛmɛ yoola’mi oyasokambes’ino eya wewe ebiaokäkä’mi ende Mungu, Abalayama atiakeläkä ongoma.
english: But now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth which I heard from God. Abraham didn’t do this.

lokele: Ino nd’atokelaka bekeeli ya sango wanu. Iyo loonga lande mbo— Iso totiaotomökö la nyongo, tole la Sango ɔmɔi ako Mungu.
english: You do the works of your father.” They said to him, “We were not born of sexual immorality. We have one Father, God.”

lokele: Yesu loonga lau mbo— Mungu eyala nde Sango wanu, ani ososama nde Imi, eoka yasekwäkä nde ende Mungu, la yende eya; itiayäkä l’isosha shami angɛnɛ, nde Inde nd’atomäkä Imi.
english: Therefore Jesus said to them, “If God were your father, you would love me, for I came out and have come from God. For I haven’t come of myself, but he sent me.

lokele: ¿Monito otiluwe litina lia lioi liami? ende eoka otikɔkɔlɛ ndooka lioi liami.
english: Why don’t you understand my speech? Because you can’t hear my word.

lokele: Ino wende bana ba sango wanu ako Satana, la ino ososanga ko ndokelaka yɛmɛ yande. Ona ayaläkä ko booli w’ato konda liakoli, inde atiyale fii nda wewe, eoka angwɛnɛ wewe end’inde ango sinyo. Atotak’inde nanga, wende ko boyaeli wande, eoka inde ende boti wa nanga la ende ko sango wa lolanga.
english: You are of your father the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and doesn’t stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks on his own; for he is a liar, and the father of lies.

lokele: Nde atoonga Imi ko wewe, otiimele Imi.
english: But because I tell the truth, you don’t believe me.

lokele: ¿Ndai wanu atotombola’mi nda bekeeli ibe? Yeonga nde la wewe, monito ino otiimele’mi?
english: Which of you convicts me of sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe me?

lokele: Oyayali ewa Mungu, inde atooka nde baoi ba Mungu; ¿Monito ino otioke bao? Ambo otiyale eba Mungu.
english: He who is of God hears the words of God. For this cause you don’t hear, because you are not of God.”

lokele: BaYuda lomutoel’Inde mbo— ¿Iso toisoonga wewe mbo wende Ewa Samalia la ole la bolimo obe?
english: Then the Jews answered him, “Don’t we say well that you are a Samaritan, and have a demon?”

lokele: Yesu lomutola mbo— Im’iti la bolimo obe, nde itolitesa Sango wami, la ino ototefwesa’mi.
english: Jesus answered, “I don’t have a demon, but I honor my Father and you dishonor me.

lokele: Im’itiluke nde tala yami angɛnɛ, nde Ɔmɔi nd’atoluka yao, Inde nd’atoata loasɔ loami.
english: But I don’t seek my own glory. There is one who seeks and judges.

lokele: Wewe, wewe, itoonga lanu mbo— Boto elitesa lioi liami, atilɛnɛkɛ imɔ liwa.
english: Most certainly, I tell you, if a person keeps my word, he will never see death.”

lokele: BaYuda loonga lande mbo— Kwani toluwi nde mbo wende la bolimo obe. Abalayama lowa la Batɔndɔli imɔ nde Aɛ nd’atoonga mbo— Boto elitesa lioi liami, atilawek’imɔ.
english: Then the Jews said to him, “Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham died, as did the prophets; and you say, ‘If a man keeps my word, he will never taste of death.’

lokele: ¿Aɛ nd’alongeli to sango wasu ako Abalayama oyawäkä? Batɔndɔli lowa imɔ kowa; ¿Otangi nde mbo wende ndai to?
english: Are you greater than our father Abraham, who died? The prophets died. Who do you make yourself out to be?”

lokele: Yesu lomutola mbo— Yetalia ko Imi angɛnɛ, tala yami eti eya wewe. Ende Sango wami oyatotalia’mi tala, ako Inde oyatangi ino mbo ende Mungu wanu,
english: Jesus answered, “If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father who glorifies me, of whom you say that he is our God.

lokele: l’ani otiluw’Inde. Nde Imi nd’aluwi Inde la yeonga mbo itiluw’Inde, ambo yeyala kwa ayali ino, ako ewa lolanga; kongo ko isoluw’Inde la itolitesa lioi liande.
english: You have not known him, but I know him. If I said, ‘I don’t know him,’ I would be like you, a liar. But I know him and keep his word.

lokele: Tata wanu ako Abalayama loomala mbo elɛnɛkɛ mbile yami, la inde lɔɛnɛ la okäkä limɛngɔ.
english: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day. He saw it and was glad.”

lokele: BaYuda loonga to lande mbo— Okiyeli kɔni miaka kama bɔɔmwi la Aɛ mbo Abalayama ɛnɛ̈kɛ̈ nd’Aɛ?
english: The Jews therefore said to him, “You are not yet fifty years old! Have you seen Abraham?”

lokele: Yesu loonga lau mbo— Wewe, wewe itoonga lanu mbo, oso wa Abalayama, Imi nd’ayali.
english: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, before Abraham came into existence, I AM. Exodus 3:14

lokele: Kwaamao iyo loilaka batalɛ mbo bakushelek’Inde, nde Yesu loisamel’iyo, Inde losokwa nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu.
english: Therefore they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus hid himself and went out of the temple, having gone through the middle of them, and so passed by.

lokele: Etäkä Yesu nda mboka, Inde lɔɛnɛ boto oyaäkä la botuku konda baotelo bande,
english: As he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.

lokele: la baeki bande lofel’Inde mbo— ¿Labi, ndai yakeläkä obe, kwa botoyo kwa ebaot’inde, mbo aotomökö la botuku?
english: His disciples asked him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”

lokele: Yesu lomutola mbo— Ati ango inde angɛnɛ, ango ebaoti inde lokela bobe kangä mbo ebikakeleke Mungu yɛnɛlɛkɛ end’inde.
english: Jesus answered, “This man didn’t sin, nor did his parents, but that the works of God might be revealed in him.

lokele: Lole loami ndokela yao ya Inde oyatomäkä’mi ani löwa lokoyali; akayeke lilima lia bocho, boto angokɔkɔlɔ ndokela likuwa.
english: I must work the works of him who sent me while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.

lokele: Akoyali’mi nda wenda, yende löwa loa wenda.
english: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”

lokele: Aongäk’Inde ongoma, Inde lotwɛlɛ sɔi nda nyɛlɛ ndokela baïti, Inde lolɔɔkɔ inde baïti nda baiso.
english: When he had said this, he spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, anointed the blind man’s eyes with the mud,

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— Kɛndɛkɛ okasoola bindo yaɛ nda lyaa liko Siloa (litina mbo Oyatomomu), inde lɔkɛ to inde losoola bindo, inde losokwa omao ani akɔɛnɛ liasi.
english: and said to him, “Go, wash in the pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). So he went away, washed, and came back seeing.

lokele: Bayalani lande la bato ebɛnɛ̈k’inde oso mbo Ewa shomba, iyo lofelana mbo— ¿Ati ona oyayalakäkä se nda mboka shomba yeka?
english: Therefore the neighbors and those who saw that he was blind before said, “Isn’t this he who sat and begged?”

lokele: Bamɔi mbo— Ale ko inde. Basi mbo— Mba, nde akwelu nde bɔfɔnɔ wande. Nde boto angɛnɛ loonga mbo— Imi-yo.
english: Others were saying, “It is he.” Still others were saying, “He looks like him.” He said, “I am he.”

lokele: Limɔ iyo lofel’inde mbo— Baiso baɛ to baliolomu nde moni?
english: They therefore were asking him, “How were your eyes opened?”

lokele: Inde lomutola lau mbo— Boto oyatangomu mbo Yesu lokela baïti, Inde lolɔɔkɔ bao nda baiso bami, Inde loonga lami mbo— Kɛndɛkɛ nda Siloa, soolaka bindo omao; imi lɔkɛ to, la asoolaka’mi, imi lɔɛnɛ liasi.
english: He answered, “A man called Jesus made mud, anointed my eyes, and said to me, ‘Go to the pool of Siloam and wash.’ So I went away and washed, and I received sight.”

lokele: Limɔ iyo lofel’inde mbo ¿Boto ona ale to anima? Inde mbo— Itiluwe.
english: Then they asked him, “Where is he?” He said, “I don’t know.”

lokele: Iyo loesha oyayaliki oso la botuku ende BaFalusi.
english: They brought him who had been blind to the Pharisees.

lokele: Lise lina eliakeläkä Yesu baiti, la elialioläk’Inde baiso bande, liaäkä elia Yenga.
english: It was a Sabbath when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.

lokele: Eokao BaFalusi imɔ lofel’inde liasi ani ɛnɛsɔmɔ̈kɔ̈ inde. Inde loonga to lau mbo— Inde lota baïti nda baiso bami, imi losoola bao la kwani itɔɛnɛ.
english: Again therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he received his sight. He said to them, “He put mud on my eyes, I washed, and I see.”

lokele: Bamɔi ba BaFalusi to loonga mbo— Ona ako Yesu ati wa Mungu, eoka atilitese lise lia Yenga. Nde basi bamɔi mbo— Boto oyatokelaka obe nd’atokɔkɔlɔ ndokela ndembe ya ilombo ya bɔfɔnɔ-bo? Ongoma iyo batisangane kuko.
english: Some therefore of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, because he doesn’t keep the Sabbath.” Others said, “How can a man who is a sinner do such signs?” So there was division among them.

lokele: Eokao iyo lofelaka ewa botuku liasi mbo— ¿Aɛ angɛnɛ nd’atoonga iye loasɔ loande, eoka alioliki nde ebaɛ baiso? Inde mbo— Ende Bɔtɔndɔli.
english: Therefore they asked the blind man again, “What do you say about him, because he opened your eyes?” He said, “He is a prophet.”

lokele: Nde BaYuda batiaimeläkä mbo ayaläkä la botuku la mbo ɛnɛsɔmɔkɔ̈ liasi, kond’atäk’iyo ebaot’inde lioi, ako oyaɛnɛsɔmɔ̈kɔ̈ liasi,
english: The Jews therefore didn’t believe concerning him, that he had been blind and had received his sight, until they called the parents of him who had received his sight,

lokele: iyo lofela iyo mbo— ¿Oyo ende to wana wanu oyatoong’ino mbo aotomökö la botuku? ¿Asɔɛnɛ to kwani la moni?
english: and asked them, “Is this your son, whom you say was born blind? How then does he now see?”

lokele: Ebaot’inde lomutola mbo— Toluwi nde mbo ende wana wasu la mbo aotomökö nde la botuku,
english: His parents answered them, “We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind;

lokele: nde totiluwe ani asɔɛnɛ inde oko liasi, la iso angɛnɛ totiluwe oyaliolik’inde baiso; felak’inde angɛnɛ, ende otowange, atoaolel’inde angɛnɛ.
english: but how he now sees, we don’t know; or who opened his eyes, we don’t know. He is of age. Ask him. He will speak for himself.”

lokele: Ebaot’inde loonga ongoma eoka bawangakäkä BaYuda, eoka BaYuda lotwana kuko mbo boto eaola mbo Yesu ende Masiya, ambo ona kosokolomo nda ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ.
english: His parents said these things because they feared the Jews; for the Jews had already agreed that if any man would confess him as Christ, he would be put out of the synagogue.

lokele: Liao to lile litina eliongiki ebaot’inde mbo— Ale otowange, felak’inde angɛnɛ.
english: Therefore his parents said, “He is of age. Ask him.”

lokele: Eokao iyo lota oyaäkä la botuku, lita lia ambale, iyo loonga lande mbo— Ongaka ko wewe wa Mungu, eoka iso nd’aluwi mbo eboto-yo atokelaka bobe.
english: So they called the man who was blind a second time, and said to him, “Give glory to God. We know that this man is a sinner.”

lokele: Boto loonga to mbo— Eya boto oyatokelaka obe, im’itiluwe, loasɔ lɔmɔi eloluwi nde imi, loko mbo yaäkä la botuku, nde kwani isɔɛnɛ.
english: He therefore answered, “I don’t know if he is a sinner. One thing I do know: that though I was blind, now I see.”

lokele: Iyo lofela inde mbo— ¿Akeeliki nd’aɛ moni? ¿Alioliki nde baiso baɛ l’iye?
english: They said to him again, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?”

lokele: Inde lomutoel’iyo mbo— Ikambesiki nd’ino, nde otiokeke; ¿Olɛmbi nde ndoka liasi moni? Mbo ino imɔ nd’alɛmbi oyala baeki bande?
english: He answered them, “I told you already, and you didn’t listen. Why do you want to hear it again? You don’t also want to become his disciples, do you?”

lokele: Limɔ iyo lomɔl’inde, iyo mbo— Aɛ wende boeki wa boto ona, nde iso nd’ayali baeki ba Mɔsɛ.
english: They insulted him and said, “You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.

lokele: Iso nd’aluwi mbo Mungu aongäkä la Mɔsɛ, kongo ko loasɔ loa oyo-boto-yo totiluwe ango olo asokwäkä lande.
english: We know that God has spoken to Moses. But as for this man, we don’t know where he comes from.”

lokele: Boto lomutola lau mbo— Loasɔ lomwaalomo to loko mbo ino angoluwa olo asokwaka lande, l’ani alioli nde baiso bami!
english: The man answered them, “How amazing! You don’t know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.

lokele: Toluwi nde mbo Mungu angolaila ebatokelaka bobe; nde boto esemolak’Inde, ekelaka lisangi liande, ambo Mungu kolail’inde ona.
english: We know that God doesn’t listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshiper of God and does his will, he listens to him. Psalms 66:18

lokele: Ko layalaya lotiaokomökö mbo boto nd’alioläkä baiso ba boto oyaotomu la botuku.
english: Since the world began it has never been heard of that anyone opened the eyes of someone born blind.

lokele: Aenaka mbo boto ona ayäkä ende Mungu, ani Inde angokɔkɔlɔ okela yeka.
english: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing.”

lokele: BaFalusi lomutoel’inde mbo— Ko la obe aɛ nd’aotomökö fɛɛ! ¿Aɛ nd’atoekes’iso? Limɔ iyo losokol’inde nda ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ.
english: They answered him, “You were altogether born in sins, and do you teach us?” Then they threw him out.

lokele: Okäkä Yesu mbo basosokol’inde la oshäkä Yesu oosh’inde, Yesu loonga lande mbo— ¿Osolendelo to Wana wa Mungu?
english: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, and finding him, he said, “Do you believe in the Son of God?”

lokele: Boto ona loonga mbo— ¿Bwana, ale to ndai mbo ilendeloko Inde?
english: He answered, “Who is he, Lord, that I may believe in him?”

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— Osɔɛnɛ Inde la akoonga imɔ laɛ kwani, Inde kongo.
english: Jesus said to him, “You have both seen him, and it is he who speaks with you.”

lokele: Inde mbo— Bwana, isoimela. Inde lotulamela Yesu se.
english: He said, “Lord, I believe!” and he worshiped him.

lokele: Limɔ Yesu loonga mbo— Imi nd’asoya nda wenda-bo ndoyaataka wao, mbo ebatiɛnɛ, bɛnɛkɛ, la mbo ebatɔɛnɛ bakinjweke eba botuku.
english: Jesus said, “I came into this world for judgment, that those who don’t see may see; and that those who see may become blind.”

lokele: Okäkä BaFalusi bamɔi ebayaläkä lande ebaoi-ba, iyo loonga lande mbo— ¿Iso imɔ twende eba botuku?
english: Those of the Pharisees who were with him heard these things, and said to him, “Are we also blind?”

lokele: Yesu lomutola lau mbo— Wayala nde la botuku, ani otiyaleke bato ba obe, nde kwaani atoong’ino mbo, Totɔɛnɛ; ambo ino okoyali bato ba obe.
english: Jesus said to them, “If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, ‘We see.’ Therefore your sin remains.

lokele: Wewe, wewe, itoonga lanu mbo— Boto oyaitɔɔtɔkɔ ko la bome nda likula lia bɛkɔkɔ, kangä ndoakala liao la elela yasi, ambo ona ende wiya la booni,
english: “Most certainly, I tell you, one who doesn’t enter by the door into the sheep fold, but climbs up some other way, is a thief and a robber.

lokele: nde oyatɔɔtɔkɔ kola bome ende botingani wa bɛkɔkɔ.
english: But one who enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

lokele: Bolambi wa bome atoliokoel’inde bome la bɛkɔkɔ bitoka limiki liande; atotaka eyande bɛkɔkɔ lina, ɔmɔi l’ɔmɔi, limɔ atotol’iyo oso ko lousa.
english: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.

lokele: Asoumesa eyande bɛkɔkɔ lousa; limɔ atoeteel’iyo oso la bɛkɔkɔ bitotutak’inde eoka bisoluwa limiki liande,
english: Whenever he brings out his own sheep, he goes before them; and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.

lokele: biitotuta bɔɛnda; bitokwel’inde botili eoka bitiluwe limiki lia bɔɛnda.
english: They will by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him; for they don’t know the voice of strangers.”

lokele: Yesu lotel’iyo bombila-bo, kongo ko batialuwäkä litina eliaongäk’Inde lau.
english: Jesus spoke this parable to them, but they didn’t understand what he was telling them.

lokele: Eokao Yesu loonga lau liasi mbo— Wewe, wewe itoonga lanu mbo Imi yende bome ende bɛkɔkɔ.
english: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Most certainly, I tell you, I am the sheep’s door.

lokele: Batoti ebayäkä oso wami bende biya la beoni, kongo ko bɛkɔkɔ bitioke bamiki bau.
english: All who came before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep didn’t listen to them.

lokele: Imi yende Bome; boto ɛɔtɔkɔ ko lami, inde kotekama, atɔɔtɔkɔ la atokuswakuswa, l’ani atoosha bieka yola.
english: I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out and will find pasture.

lokele: Wiya aitoya sakolo ngo mbo iyeke la mbo aoleke la mbo asɛɛsɛlɛsɛkɛ bɛkɔkɔ; Imi nd’ayiki mbo bayaleke la liwawi la bayaleke la lilya.
english: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.

lokele: Imi yende Botingani bolau; Botingani bolau atomacha liwawi liande ko ndowela bɛkɔkɔ.
english: “I am the good shepherd. Isaiah 40:11 The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

lokele: Bokuwi wa bosombo oyati botingani, oyatisɛlɛ bɛkɔkɔ eyande angɛnɛ, atɔɛn’inde ngɔi etoya, inde komacha bɔkɔkɔ, kokwa botili; limɔ ngɔi koungwakela bɛkɔkɔ, inde komelekesa yao mya.
english: He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who doesn’t own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and flees. The wolf snatches the sheep and scatters them.

lokele: Atokwa botili ongoma eoka ale ko bokuwi wa bosombo, aitotakela bɛkɔkɔ bolenda.
english: The hired hand flees because he is a hired hand and doesn’t care for the sheep.

lokele: Nde Imi yende Botingani Bolau la iluwi nde eyami bɛkɔkɔ la eyami nd’aluwi ko Imi;
english: I am the good shepherd. I know my own, and I’m known by my own;

lokele: kwa Sango nd’aluwi Imi, ko Imi imɔ nd’aluwi Sango la isomacha liwawi liami ko ndowela bɛkɔkɔ.
english: even as the Father knows me, and I know the Father. I lay down my life for the sheep.

lokele: Yende imɔ la bɛkɔkɔ yasi ebiti ya e-liasa-li, lole loami ndotola imɔ ko yao oso la bɛkɔkɔ yokaka nde limiki liami, limɔ beyalaka nde ko liasa limwito la Botingani ko ɔmwito.
english: I have other sheep which are not of this fold. Isaiah 56:8 I must bring them also, and they will hear my voice. They will become one flock with one shepherd.

lokele: Eokao Sango asoniya Imi eoka Imi nd’amachi liwawi liami mbo yɔlɛkɛ liao liasi.
english: Therefore the Father loves me, because I lay down my life, Isaiah 53:7-8 that I may take it again.

lokele: Angwɛnɛ boto wɔnɔkɔlɔ liao ende’mi, nde Imi nd’atomacha liao ko Imi angɛnɛ. Yende l’isosha shomacha liao la yende imɔ l’isosha shɔɔlɔ liao liasi. Sango angɛnɛ nd’atelaka’mi ekela-ye.
english: No one takes it away from me, but I lay it down by myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. I received this commandment from my Father.”

lokele: Eoka ya baoi-ba BaYuda batisanganeke kuko ko liasi;
english: Therefore a division arose again among the Jews because of these words.

lokele: wike loonga mbo— Asɔɔtɛlɔmɔ la bolimo obe, ongoma asowa loseka. ¿Otok’Inde ko l’eoka iye to?
english: Many of them said, “He has a demon and is insane! Why do you listen to him?”

lokele: Nde basi mbo— Tonango twande toti twa boto oyaɔtɛlɔmu la bolimo obe. ¿Bolimo obe nd’atokɔkɔlɔ oliola baiso ba eba botuku? BaYuda lokota ndoundesa Yesu
english: Others said, “These are not the sayings of one possessed by a demon. It isn’t possible for a demon to open the eyes of the blind, is it?” Exodus 4:11

lokele: Yaäkä nde mbile ya Elambɔ ya Liuchi lia Ndakɔ ya Mungu nda Yelusaleme nda mbile ya bondiya,
english: It was the Feast of the Dedication 10:22 at Jerusalem.

lokele: Yesu lɔkɛndɛkɛndɛ nda lilɛlɛ lia Ndakɔ ya Mungu, liko elia Solomo.
english: It was winter, and Jesus was walking in the temple, in Solomon’s porch.

lokele: Lamao BaYuda lolingel’Inde, iyo loongaka lande mbo— ¿Otoeyaeyesa betema yasu konda eni to mbile? Aɛ boyala Masiya, kambesak’iso fololo.
english: The Jews therefore came around him and said to him, “How long will you hold us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly.”

lokele: Yesu lomutola lau mbo— Isokambes’ino, nde otiimele. Bekeeli ebitokelaka’mi nda lina lia Sango wami, yao nd’atokambes’ino loasɔ loami.
english: Jesus answered them, “I told you, and you don’t believe. The works that I do in my Father’s name, these testify about me.

lokele: Kongo ko ino otiimele eoka oti bɛkɔkɔ yami.
english: But you don’t believe, because you are not of my sheep, as I told you.

lokele: Bɛkɔkɔ yami bitokaka limiki liami, la Imi nd’asoluwa yao la bitotutaka’mi;
english: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.

lokele: Imi nd’atofaefayao liwawi lia layalaya, bitilasɛɛsɛlɛkɛ la angwɛnɛ boto wɔnɔkɔlɔ yao nda bosamba wami.
english: I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.

lokele: Sango wami oyafäkä’mi yao, alongeli nde batotina, angwɛnɛ angɔmɔi wokɔkɔlɔ ndɔɔnɔkɔlɔ ango yeka nda bosamba wande.
english: My Father who has given them to me is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father’s hand.

lokele: Imi la Sango twende ko ɔmwito.
english: I and the Father are one.”

lokele: BaYuda loilaka batalɛ liasi mbo bakushelek’Inde bao.
english: Therefore the Jews took up stones again to stone him.

lokele: Yesu loonga to lau mbo— Isotambel’ino bekeeli bilau wike ko l’isosha sha Sango, otokushela’mi batalɛ loasɔ loa boni to bokeeli?
english: Jesus answered them, “I have shown you many good works from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?”

lokele: BaYuda lomutoel’Inde mbo— Toitokushel’Aɛ batalɛ loasɔ loa bokeeli bolau kangä loasɔ loa lisɛɔli lia Mungu, eoka Aɛ ako boto kongo, nd’aenganesi Aɛ angɛnɛ la Mungu.
english: The Jews answered him, “We don’t stone you for a good work, but for blasphemy, because you, being a man, make yourself God.”

lokele: Yesu lomutola lau mbo— ¿Lotitomo nde nda Lokasa loa Bikela yanu mbo— Imi mbo— Wende BaMungu?
english: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t it written in your law, ‘I said, you are gods’? Psalms 82:6

lokele: ¿Eya to mbo batangomökö BaMungu ebafomökö isosha sha Mungu l’ani Lokasa loa Mungu angotombolomo,
english: If he called them gods, to whom the word of God came (and the Scripture can’t be broken),

lokele: monito ino koonga lami oyuchomu la Sango la oyatomomökö lande nda wenda, mbo— Ososɛɔlɔ Mungu, eoka mbo iongiki mbo Yende Wana wa Mungu?
english: do you say of him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, ‘You blaspheme,’ because I said, ‘I am the Son of God’?

lokele: Eya to mbo itikele bekeeli ya Sango wami, wimelëke’mi.
english: If I don’t do the works of my Father, don’t believe me.

lokele: Kongo ko eya mbo yekelaka yao, otiimeleke’mi, imelaka ngo ko bekeeli angɛnɛ mbo boluweke la mbo wimelek’imɔ mbo Sango ale lami la Imi nd’ayali la Sango.
english: But if I do them, though you don’t believe me, believe the works, that you may know and believe that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.”

lokele: Eokao iyo loluka fofe youndes’Inde liasi, nde Inde loowana nda besamba yau.
english: They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.

lokele: Limɔ Inde lɔkɛ okaleka Yaladene liasi nda elela olo alufiäkä Yoane olufia bato oso, Inde lotikala omao;
english: He went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was baptizing at first, and he stayed there.

lokele: la bato wike lɔkɛkɛ end’Inde, iyo loonga mbo— Yoane atiakelaka ndembe y’esisho, nde bitotina ebiaongaka Yoane eoka ya e-boto-yo yende wewe.
english: Many came to him. They said, “John indeed did no sign, but everything that John said about this man is true.”

lokele: La bato wike lolendelo Inde omao.
english: Many believed in him there.

lokele: Boto ɔmɔi ayalaka la loo, ako Lasalo wa Betania, bokenge wa Malia la boloo Wande ako Maleta.
english: Now a certain man was sick, Lazarus from Bethany, of the village of Mary and her sister, Martha.

lokele: Malia aaka nde otomali oyasingɔlɔkɔ Ngɛnɛ la baningo ba liɛsɛ, la oyaɔmbɔkɔlɔkɔ batindi bande la swee yande la Lasalo oyaaka la loo aaka welo wande.
english: It was that Mary who had anointed the Lord with ointment and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.

lokele: E-baelo-ba lotomela Yesu wɛndi mbo— Ngɛnɛ, oyasamomu laɛ ale la loo.
english: The sisters therefore sent to him, saying, “Lord, behold, he for whom you have great affection is sick.”

lokele: Okakä Yesu ongoma, Inde loonga mbo— E-loo-lo loti to eloa liwa, kangä elɔɛnɛsɛ tala ya Mungu mbo Wana wa Mungu ataliomoko tala ko la loao.
english: But when Jesus heard it, he said, “This sickness is not to death, but for the glory of God, that God’s Son may be glorified by it.”

lokele: Yesu asamaka Maleta la etungani yande la Lasalo,
english: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.

lokele: okakä to Inde mbo Lasalo ale la loo, Inde lotatikala kɔni bacho bambale omao nda elela eyayalak’Inde.
english: When therefore he heard that he was sick, he stayed two days in the place where he was.

lokele: Mbisa yaamao Inde loonga la baeki mbo— Tɔɛkɛ nda Yudea liasi.
english: Then after this he said to the disciples, “Let’s go into Judea again.”

lokele: Baeki loonga lande mbo— Labi, ko kwani kongo, BaYuda lokota ndokushel’Aɛ batalɛ; ¿Otoinwa k’omao liasi?
english: The disciples asked him, “Rabbi, the Jews were just trying to stone you. Are you going there again?”

lokele: Yesu lomutola mbo— ¿Saa biisoyala liu la imbale la löwa? Boto ɛkɛndɛkɛndɛ la löwa, aitowa likulia, eoka atɔɛnɛ nde löwa loa e-wenda-bo,
english: Jesus answered, “Aren’t there twelve hours of daylight? If a man walks in the day, he doesn’t stumble, because he sees the light of this world.

lokele: nde ɛkɛndɛkɛndɛ la ocho, inde kowa likulia eoka löwa loti lande.
english: But if a man walks in the night, he stumbles, because the light isn’t in him.”

lokele: Inde loonga ongoma, limɔ mbisa Inde loonga lau mbo— Wina lasu ako Lasalo asokwa ilɔ, nde isɔkɛ okasisɔl’inde.
english: He said these things, and after that, he said to them, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I am going so that I may awake him out of sleep.”

lokele: Baeki loonga to lande mbo— Ngɛnɛ, eya to mbo asokwa ilɔ, ambo esäsaka nde.
english: The disciples therefore said, “Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will recover.”

lokele: Yesu loonga loasɔ loa liwa liande nde iyo loenyela mbo aongi nde loasɔ loa lɔɛumɔ nda ilɔ.
english: Now Jesus had spoken of his death, but they thought that he spoke of taking rest in sleep.

lokele: Eokao Yesu lokambes’iyo fololo mbo— Lasalo asokwela se,
english: So Jesus said to them plainly then, “Lazarus is dead.

lokele: la isooka limɛngɔ loasɔ loanu mbo itiyaleke omao, mbo wimeleke; kongo ko tɔɛkɛ end’inde.
english: I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, so that you may believe. Nevertheless, let’s go to him.”

lokele: Eokao Tomasa, oyatangomu mbo Liasa, loonga la baina lande bako baeki, mbo— Tɔkɛsɛnɛkɛ lande imɔ mbo toweke amamwito lande.
english: Thomas therefore, who is called Didymus, 11:16 said to his fellow disciples, “Let’s also go, that we may die with him.”

lokele: Iyakä to Yesu omao, Inde loosha Lasalo asoingala oko bacho basatɔ nda losai.
english: So when Jesus came, he found that he had been in the tomb four days already.

lokele: Betania waaka tina la Yelusaleme, esika kwa yiso bilɛfu imbale,
english: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia 11:18 away.

lokele: la wike wa BaYuda loya ende Maleta la Malia ndɔɔnjɔnj’iyo nda ewa ya welo wau.
english: Many of the Jews had joined the women around Martha and Mary, to console them concerning their brother.

lokele: Okakä to Maleta mbo Yesu asoya, inde lɔkɛ okatowana lande, ani Malia akoyala se nda ndakɔ.
english: Then when Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went and met him, but Mary stayed in the house.

lokele: Maleta loonga to la Yesu mbo— Ngɛnɛ, yambo wayala eyamaya, ani welo wami atikwelo se.
english: Therefore Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.

lokele: Nde ango kwani iluwi nde mbo lona elokafelek’Aɛ Mungu, Inde kofa aɛ ngo ko loao.
english: Even now I know that whatever you ask of God, God will give you.”

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— Welo waɛ atotɛmwa liasi la liwawi.
english: Jesus said to her, “Your brother will rise again.”

lokele: Maleta loonga lande mbo— Iluwi nde mbo atotɛmwa nda litɛmwi lia lise lia liko.
english: Martha said to him, “I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.”

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— Imi yende litɛmwi la liwawi; oyatolendelo Imi, eyambo ekwela se, inde koyala la liwawi.
english: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.

lokele: Boto la boto oyayali la liwawi la elendelo Imi, atilawek’imɔ layalaya. ¿Oimeli nde ongoma?
english: Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”

lokele: Inde loonga la Yesu mbo— Eingo, Ngɛnɛ. Imi nd’aimeli mbo Aɛ wende Masiya, Wana wa Mungu oyatoya nda wenda.
english: She said to him, “Yes, Lord. I have come to believe that you are the Christ, God’s Son, he who comes into the world.”

lokele: Limɔ aongak’inde ongoma, Maleta lɔkɛ okata etungani yande ako Malia lioi wisisa, inde mbo— Boekesi ale eya la asofel’aɛ.
english: When she had said this, she went away and called Mary, her sister, secretly, saying, “The Teacher is here and is calling you.”

lokele: Okakä Malia ongoma, inde loemala lisasaya okakɛ ende Yesu.
english: When she heard this, she arose quickly and went to him.

lokele: Nde Yesu atitiyeke nda okenge, nde akoyali nda elela ena olo atowanak’Inde la Maleta.
english: Now Jesus had not yet come into the village, but was in the place where Martha met him.

lokele: BaYuda ebayalaka nda ndakɔ amamwito la Malia ndɔɔnjɔnj’inde, ɛnɛk’iyo mbo aemali futuku, la mbo asokuswa, iyo lotutak’inde, eoka batangaka nde mbo atɔkɛ nda losai okalela ina.
english: Then the Jews who were with her in the house and were consoling her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up quickly and went out, followed her, saying, “She is going to the tomb to weep there.”

lokele: Ayaka to Malia nda elela olo ayali Yesu, la ɛnɛkɛ̈ Malia wɛnɛ Inde, inde loswa balui se nda bakolo bande, inde loonga lande mbo— Ngɛnɛ, yambo wayala eyamaya, ani welo wami atikwelo se.
english: Therefore when Mary came to where Jesus was and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying to him, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.”

lokele: Limɔ ɛnɛkɛ̈ Yesu kwa atolela Malia la BaYuda imɔ ebayali lande, Inde losumasuma la Inde looka ngandi finɛ,
english: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit and was troubled,

lokele: Inde mbo— ¿Osoinges’inde anima to? Iyo loonga lande mbo— Ngɛnɛ, yauku oyɛnɛ.
english: and said, “Where have you laid him?” They told him, “Lord, come and see.”

lokele: Yesu lolela foo.
english: Jesus wept.

lokele: BaYuda loonga to mbo— Tɛnɛ, aina losamɔ elosam’Inde la Lasalo!
english: The Jews therefore said, “See how much affection he had for him!”

lokele: Nde bamɔi bau loonga mbo— ¿Oyalioliki nde baiso ba boto wa botuku, inde angokɔkɔlɔ ango okufesa mbo e-boto-yo ataweke?
english: Some of them said, “Couldn’t this man, who opened the eyes of him who was blind, have also kept this man from dying?”

lokele: Limɔ Yesu losumasuma liasi l’ikɛnɛnɛ, Inde lɔkɛ konda losai loko lowa la litalɛ lifi lolinjaka loao.
english: Jesus therefore, again groaning in himself, came to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone lay against it.

lokele: Yesu loonga mbo— Sokolaka litalɛ! Welo wa oyawi nde, ako Maleta, loonga mbo— Ngɛnɛ, asokungwa oko litï eoka asowa ko bacho banɛi!
english: Jesus said, “Take away the stone.” Martha, the sister of him who was dead, said to him, “Lord, by this time there is a stench, for he has been dead four days.”

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— ¿Itionge laɛ mbo wimela ani wɛnɛkɛ nde tala ya Mungu?
english: Jesus said to her, “Didn’t I tell you that if you believed, you would see God’s glory?”

lokele: Limɔ iyo losokola to litalɛ. Lamao Yesu loila baiso likolo, Inde mbo— Sango, isofaef’Aɛ kelekëlë eoka osooka Imi.
english: So they took away the stone from the place where the dead man was lying. 11:41 Jesus lifted up his eyes and said, “Father, I thank you that you listened to me.

lokele: Iluwi nde mbo otokaka’mi mbile la mbile, kongo ko isoonga ongoma ko l’eoka ya ekuke ya bato ebemali tina mbo bimeleke mbo Aɛ nd’atomaka’mi.
english: I know that you always listen to me, but because of the multitude standing around I said this, that they may believe that you sent me.”

lokele: Aongaka’Inde ongoma, Inde loamama la limiki lifi mbo— Lasalo, kuswaka lousa!
english: When he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”

lokele: Inde oyawiki lokuswa ani akandomu la besamba la bakolo la bisinda la bɔmbɔ wande bolinjomu la itambala. Yesu loonga lau mbo— Faikolak’inde la machak’inde akɛkɛ eyande.
english: He who was dead came out, bound hand and foot with wrappings, and his face was wrapped around with a cloth. Jesus said to them, “Free him, and let him go.”

lokele: Wike wa BaYuda ebayaka nda ndeli ende Malia, ɛnɛkɛ̈ iyo eloakelaka Yesu, iyo lolendelo Inde,
english: Therefore many of the Jews who came to Mary and saw what Jesus did believed in him.

lokele: nde bamɔi bau lokakɛ ende BaFalusi, la iyo lokambesa iyo loasɔ eloakelaka Yesu. Ikumbɛ sha BaYuda eoka ya bisisho ya Yesu
english: But some of them went away to the Pharisees and told them the things which Jesus had done.

lokele: Eokao Kanga ebieti la BaFalusi lɔsɔngɔmɛsɛ ikumbɛ lamao iyo loonga mbo— ¿Totokela nd’iye, eoka boto-yo nd’atokelaka ndembe ya bisisho wike?
english: The chief priests therefore and the Pharisees gathered a council, and said, “What are we doing? For this man does many signs.

lokele: Tomach’Inde ongoma, batotina batolendelo Inde, limɔ BaLoma beyaka nde oyasokoel’iso elela la yakakaelo yasu.
english: If we leave him alone like this, everyone will believe in him, and the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.”

lokele: Limɔ ɔmɔi wau ako Kayafa oyayalaka Kanga eyeti nda mwaka ona, inde loonga lau mbo— Ino b’ikumbɛ otiluwe loasɔ ango sinyo,
english: But a certain one of them, Caiaphas, being high priest that year, said to them, “You know nothing at all,

lokele: otienye mbo loengani nde mbo boto ɔmɔi kongo aweleke bato batotina la mbo tukela yasu etotina etasɛɛsɛlɛ.
english: nor do you consider that it is advantageous for us that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation not perish.”

lokele: Ationge ongoma l’isosha shande angɛnɛ, kongo ko kwa ayalak’inde Kanga eyeti nda mwaka-ao atɔndɔlɔ̈kɔ̈ mbo Yesu ewelaka ngo ko tukela etotina,
english: Now he didn’t say this of himself, but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus would die for the nation,

lokele: inga eoka ya tukela ya BaYuda kongo, kangä mbo awacheke la tukela ɛmwito ko bana ba Mungu ebamelakana nda wenda.
english: and not for the nation only, but that he might also gather together into one the children of God who are scattered abroad.

lokele: Ongoma konda lise lina, iyo lotwana kuko mbo bolek’Inde.
english: So from that day forward they took counsel that they might put him to death.

lokele: Eokao Yesu atiakendɛlɛk’imɔ sisi ya BaYuda nde Inde losokwa omao okakɛ nda okenge boko Efulaima tina la yese ya liɔmbɛlɛ; Inde lotikala omao amamwito la baeki bande.
english: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews, but departed from there into the country near the wilderness, to a city called Ephraim. He stayed there with his disciples.

lokele: Elambɔ ya Lieti ya BaYuda yaaka nde tina la bato wike ba yese lɔkɛ nda Yelusaleme oso wa Elambɔ ndokasaesomo.
english: Now the Passover of the Jews was at hand. Many went up from the country to Jerusalem before the Passover, to purify themselves.

lokele: Iyo loluka to Yesu omao la aemelak’iyo nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu, iyo lofelakana mbo— ¿Oenyeli nde moni; mbo aitoya nda Elambɔ?
english: Then they sought for Jesus and spoke with one another as they stood in the temple, “What do you think—that he isn’t coming to the feast at all?”

lokele: Kanga ebieti la BaFalusi bataka ndola mbo boto eluwa olo ayali Yesu, akambeseke iyo, mbo baundesek’Inde.
english: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had commanded that if anyone knew where he was, he should report it, that they might seize him.

lokele: Yesu loya nda Betania becho liambɛ oso wa Elambɔ ya Lieti, okenge ona olo ayalaka Lasalo oyatɛmɔlɔkɔ Inde nda liwa.
english: Then, six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, who had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.

lokele: Iyo lokomiela to Yesu bieka ya ocho, la Maleta lotel’iyo yao nda mɛsa olo ayalaka imɔ ko Lasalo amamwito lande.
english: So they made him a supper there. Martha served, but Lazarus was one of those who sat at the table with him.

lokele: Malia lɔɔsɔ isakɔ sha baningo ba liɛsɛ ba loketi lofi fafo, inde losingɔlɔ batindi ba Yesu, inde lɔɔmbɔkɔlɔ batindi bande la swee yande la ndakɔ lotuma la liɛsɛ lia baningo.
english: Therefore Mary took a pound 12:3 of ointment of pure nard, very precious, and anointed Jesus’ feet and wiped his feet with her hair. The house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment.

lokele: Nde ɔmɔi wa baeki bande, ako Yudasi wa Keliote oyakawambek’Inde, inde mbo—
english: Then Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, one of his disciples, who would betray him, said,

lokele: ¿Monito e-baningo-ba batitambesomo nda bieto mia isatɔ la yao kofaefomo eba touwe?
english: “Why wasn’t this ointment sold for three hundred denarii 12:5 and given to the poor?”

lokele: Inde loonga ongoma, inga eoka mbo atakeli nde eba touwe bolenda, kangä eoka aaka wiya la ɔsɔkɔkɔ̈ bieto eyatakomokö nda sanduku eyaundak’inde.
english: Now he said this, not because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, used to steal what was put into it.

lokele: Yesu loonga to mbo— Machaka otomali, mbo atinganeke la bao konda liombomu liami;
english: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. She has kept this for the day of my burial.

lokele: eoka wende l’eba touwe lanu mbile bitotina, kongo ko oti lami amamwito lanu mbile bitotina.
english: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.”

lokele: Aluwaka ekuke efi ya BaYuda mbo Yesu ale omao, iyo loya, inga oyɛnɛ Yesu kongo, kangä Lasalo imɔ oyatɛmɔlɔmɔ̈kɔ̈ la Yesu nda liwa.
english: A large crowd therefore of the Jews learned that he was there; and they came, not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

lokele: Ongoma Kanga ebieti lokuliana l’ikumbɛ mbo beolaka imɔ ko Lasalo,
english: But the chief priests conspired to put Lazarus to death also,

lokele: eoka ko loasɔ loa Lasalo BaYuda wike losokwa end’iyo okalendelo Yesu.
english: because on account of him many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus.

lokele: Lɛlɛngɔ ekuke efi ya bato wike ebayaka nda Elambɔ looka mbo Yesu atoya nda Yelusaleme,
english: On the next day a great multitude had come to the feast. When they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,

lokele: iyo lɔɔsɔ bakanga ba batoko, iyo lokuswa okatowana lande. Iyo lɔwɛlɛkɛ lielo mbo— Hosana! Limɛngɔ la Bolau ende Inde oyasoya nda lina lia Ngɛnɛ, Ende Bɔkɔta wa Isalaele.
english: they took the branches of the palm trees and went out to meet him, and cried out, “Hosanna! 12:13 Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord, Psalms 118:25-26 the King of Israel!”

lokele: Limɔ Yesu loosha efembeli ya punda, Inde loyala se nda yao, kwa loatomoko nda Lokasa mbo—
english: Jesus, having found a young donkey, sat on it. As it is written,

lokele: Boseka wa Siona, owangëke! Tɛnɛ, Bɔkɔta waɛ atoya, Ani atalemi nda efembeli ya punda!
english: “Don’t be afraid, daughter of Zion. Behold, your King comes, sitting on a donkey’s colt.” Zechariah 9:9

lokele: Baeki bande atialuwaka litina lia baoi-ba oso, nde akataliomoko Yesu tala, limɔ iyo loenyela mbo ebaoi-ba batomökö nda Lokasa loasɔ loande la mbo bakeelak’Inde ko ongoma.
english: His disciples didn’t understand these things at first, but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written about him, and that they had done these things to him.

lokele: Bato ebayalaka lande nda mbile eyataka Yesu ota Lasalo lioi liokuswa nda losai, la ani atɛmɔlɔkɔ Yesu ɛtɛmɔl’inde nda liwa, iyo lokambekesa bato ongoma.
english: The multitude therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from the dead was testifying about it.

lokele: Liao liaaka litina eliakɛkɛ ekuke okatowana lande, eoka mbo basooka mbo Yesu akeliki nde e-ndembe-ye ya ilombo.
english: For this cause also the multitude went and met him, because they heard that he had done this sign.

lokele: BaFalusi loongana to mbo— Ɔsɔɛnɛ to mbo ebitokel’iso bende ko likeela, tɛnɛ ngo wenda bototina bosotut’Inde. Yesu la BaHela
english: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, “See how you accomplish nothing. Behold, the world has gone after him.”

lokele: Bamɔi ebayaka nda Elambɔ bayalaka to BaHela,
english: Now there were certain Greeks among those who went up to worship at the feast.

lokele: eokao iyo lɔkɛ ende Filipo wa bokenge wa Betesaida nda Ngalilai, iyo lofel’inde mbo— Bwana, tolɛmbi nde ndoyɛnɛ Yesu.
english: Therefore, these came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”

lokele: Filipo lokakambesa Andelo, limɔ la Andelo la Filipo lokambesa Yesu.
english: Philip came and told Andrew, and in turn, Andrew came with Philip, and they told Jesus.

lokele: Yesu lomutola lau mbo— Mbile esoya to eyetotaliomo Wana wa boto tala;
english: Jesus answered them, “The time has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.

lokele: wewe, wewe itoonga lanu mbo— Loköto loa bofonga, sakolo ko lokwa nda nyɛlɛ ko ndowa, ani loyalaka ngo ko lokötö ko lɔmwito kongo, nde eyambo lowa ndowa, ani loao koota befonga wike.
english: Most certainly I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.

lokele: Oyasami nde liwawi liande angɛnɛ, atolefesa nde liao, nde oyatoiyela liwawi liande nda wenda-bo, ambo inde koikesa liao nda loiko.
english: He who loves his life will lose it. He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.

lokele: Boto ɛlɛmbɛ ndoyala bokuwi wami, atuteke ngo ko Imi, limɔ olo ayali nde Imi, ko omao imɔ nd’atoyalaka bokuwi wami. Boto ekuwela’mi, Sango wami koinel’inde.
english: If anyone serves me, let him follow me. Where I am, there my servant will also be. If anyone serves me, the Father will honor him.

lokele: Kwani botema wami bosowa ngandi finɛ; ¿Iongeke to moni? ¿Mbo uwesaka’mi nda bifembi ya mbile-ye; kongo ko Imi nd’asoiya nda mbile-ye ko l’eoka ya litina-li. Sango, taliaka to lina liaɛ tala. Limɔ limiki losokwa nda use mbo— Isotalia liao tala, la yetaliaka nde liao ko liasi.
english: “Now my soul is troubled. What shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this time’? But I came to this time for this cause.

lokele: Ekuke ya bato ebaemalakä omao ebokakä liao, iyo loonga mbo ende elundi eyesokuma, nde bamɔi mbo bokitomo aongi nde lande.
english: Therefore the multitude who stood by and heard it said that it had thundered. Others said, “An angel has spoken to him.”

lokele: Yesu nde lomutola mbo— Limiki-li litiye l’eoka yami, kangä ko l’eoka yanu.
english: Jesus answered, “This voice hasn’t come for my sake, but for your sakes.

lokele: Ko kwani eba wenda batoatomo njasɔ, ko kwani Bɔkɔta wa wenda-bo atoumbolomo lousa,
english: Now is the judgment of this world. Now the prince of this world will be cast out.

lokele: nde Imi angɛnɛ, atoilomo Imi likolo, yelutaka bato batotina ende’mi.
english: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”

lokele: Yesu loonga ongoma ndoluwesa bato bɔfɔnɔ wa liwa elikaweke Inde.
english: But he said this, signifying by what kind of death he should die.

lokele: Bato ba ekuke lomutola lande mbo— Toeki nde nda Lokasa loa Bikela mbo Masiya elayalaka nde ko layalaya; ¿Monito Aɛ nd’atoonga mbo loengani nde la Wana wa boto mbo ailomoko? ¿E-Wana wa boto ende to ndai?
english: The multitude answered him, “We have heard out of the law that the Christ remains forever. Isaiah 9:7 How do you say, ‘The Son of Man must be lifted up’ ? Who is this Son of Man?”

lokele: Yesu loonga to lau mbo— Ko mbile sinyo löwa lokoyala kɔni sisi yanu, Takɛndɛkɛ to nda lowa ani lokoyala lanu mbo lilima litaosh’ino, eoka oyatokɛndɛ nda lilima aitoluwa olo atɔkɛ lande.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness doesn’t overtake you. He who walks in the darkness doesn’t know where he is going.

lokele: Akoyali nde löwa lanu, lendeloko ko loao mbo bokinjweke bana ba löwa. Aongakä Yesu ebaoi-ba, Inde losokwa okaisamel’iyo.
english: While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become children of light.” Jesus said these things, and he departed and hid himself from them.

lokele: Kwa akelaka Inde ndembe ya bisisho wike oso wau, iyo angolendelo Inde
english: But though he had done so many signs before them, yet they didn’t believe in him,

lokele: la ongoma baoi ba Bɔtɔndɔli ako Yesaya lokɔchɔmɔ mbo— ¿Ndai asoimela wɛndi wasu, Bosamba wa Ngɛnɛ bosɔɛnɛlɛ ende ndai?
english: that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke: “Lord, who has believed our report? To whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?” Isaiah 53:1

lokele: Eoka ya litina-li batiakɔkɔlɔkɔ ndoimela eoka Yesaya nd’aongakä liasi mbo—
english: For this cause they couldn’t believe, for Isaiah said again:

lokele: Asotufesa baiso bau la botuku, Asɔsɛlɛ betema yau la botufele Mbo batɛnɛ la baiso bau la Mbo bataluwa litina nda betema yau, Mbo batakikwa ende’mi mbo itasäses’iyo.
english: “He has blinded their eyes and he hardened their heart, lest they should see with their eyes, and perceive with their heart, and would turn, and I would heal them.” Isaiah 6:10

lokele: Yesaya loonga baoi-ba eoka ɛnɛkɛ̈ nde tala yande la aongaka loasɔ loande.
english: Isaiah said these things when he saw his glory, and spoke of him. Isaiah 6:1

lokele: Wike w’eba tososha lolendelo Yesu; kongo ko eoka ya BaFalusi batiaaolakä Inde eoka iyo lowanga mbo batasokolomo nda ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ
english: Nevertheless, even many of the rulers believed in him, but because of the Pharisees they didn’t confess it, so that they wouldn’t be put out of the synagogue,

lokele: basamakä nde loinelomo loa bato oso wa eloa Mungu angɛnɛ.
english: for they loved men’s praise more than God’s praise.

lokele: Limɔ Yesu loamama mbo— Oyatolendelo Imi, aitolendelo ko Imi kongo, kangä ko Inde oyatomakä’mi,
english: Jesus cried out and said, “Whoever believes in me, believes not in me, but in him who sent me.

lokele: la oyatɔɛnɛ Imi, atɔɛnɛ imɔ ko Inde oyatomaka’mi.
english: He who sees me sees him who sent me.

lokele: Imi nd’asoya nda wenda-bo kwa Lowa, mbo oyatolendelo ko Imi, atiayalek’imɔ nda lilima.
english: I have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.

lokele: Eyambo boto eokaka baoi bami nde angolitesa bao, Imi angoata loasɔ loande, eoka itiye ndoyaatakela wenda-bo kangä mbo yuweseke wao.
english: If anyone listens to my sayings and doesn’t believe, I don’t judge him. For I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

lokele: Oyatotefokola’mi la atikulie baoi bami, ale la ɔmɔi oyatoatakel’inde njasɔ, ako lioi angɛnɛ elisoonga’mi, liao kongo litoatakel’inde nda lise lia liko.
english: He who rejects me, and doesn’t receive my sayings, has one who judges him. The word that I spoke will judge him in the last day.

lokele: Eoka Imi itionge ko l’isosha shami angɛnɛ, kangä Sango oyatomakä’mi nd’afaka’mi ekela yotel’ino la baoi boonga lanu.
english: For I spoke not from myself, but the Father who sent me gave me a commandment, what I should say and what I should speak.

lokele: La iluwi nde mbo ekela yande ele ko loiko loa layalaya ende bato; eokao lioi elitoongaka’mi, itoonga lioi kwa aongaka nde Sango lami.
english: I know that his commandment is eternal life. The things therefore which I speak, even as the Father has said to me, so I speak.”

lokele: Loaaka nde oso wa Elambɔ ya Lieti mbo Yesu aluwakä mbo mbile esoya eyetosokwa lande nda wenda-bo ndoinwa ende Sango; asamaka nde baina lande nda wenda-bo, Inde lɔɔlwa osamak’iyo hɔlɔɔ.
english: Now before the feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his time had come that he would depart from this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.

lokele: Alak’iyo bieka ya ocho, ani Satana asosila ndofɔɔlɔ botema wa Yudasi wa Keliote, wana wa Simona, mbo awambeke Yesu,
english: During supper, the devil having already put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him,

lokele: l’ani Yesu aluwakä mbo Sango asofaef’Inde bitotina nda besamba yande, la mbo asokwak’Inde ende Sango la mbo atoinwa imɔ ko ende Sango,
english: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he came from God and was going to God,

lokele: limɔ Inde losokwa nda bieka, Inde lowatola kanjo, Inde lɔɔsɔ itambala ndowata shao nda lɔtɛta.
english: arose from supper, and laid aside his outer garments. He took a towel and wrapped a towel around his waist.

lokele: Inde lɔwɛlɛ balia nda isako, Inde loakola okasöökole batindi ba baeki bande la ndɔɔmbɔkɔlɔ bao la itambala esiwati Inde nda lɔtɛta.
english: Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples’ feet and to wipe them with the towel that was wrapped around him.

lokele: Nde iyak’Inde ende Simona Petelo, Petelo loonga lande mbo— ¿Ngɛnɛ, Aɛ nd’atosööla batindi bami?
english: Then he came to Simon Peter. He said to him, “Lord, do you wash my feet?”

lokele: Yesu lomutola lande mbo— Elotokela nde Imi kwani, otiluwe, nde mbisa boluwaka nde litina.
english: Jesus answered him, “You don’t know what I am doing now, but you will understand later.”

lokele: Petelo loonga lande mbo— Otiasööle batindi bami ko layalaya. Nde Yesu lomutoel’inde mbo— Eyambo itisööle aɛ, ambo otisangane lami.
english: Peter said to him, “You will never wash my feet!” Jesus answered him, “If I don’t wash you, you have no part with me.”

lokele: Simona Petelo loonga lande mbo— Ngɛnɛ, inga to batindi bami kongo, kangä imɔ besamba la botö.
english: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head!”

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— Oyasokwa ikuli ati la boeno bosöölomo, sakolo ko batindi, nde asotana bindo fee; ino nd’atani nde inga to batotina.
english: Jesus said to him, “Someone who has bathed only needs to have his feet washed, but is completely clean. You are clean, but not all of you.”

lokele: Eoka aluwaka nde oyakawambek’Inde, ko la litina-li Inde mbo— etiango ino yaatotina nd’ayali batanu.
english: For he knew him who would betray him; therefore he said, “You are not all clean.”

lokele: Asilakä Yesu ndosööla batindi bau, Inde lowata esinda yande, Inde loyala se liasi; Inde loonga lau mbo— ¿Oluwi nde litina lia loao elosokeela’mi okeel’ino?
english: So when he had washed their feet, put his outer garment back on, and sat down again, he said to them, “Do you know what I have done to you?

lokele: Ino osotanga’mi mbo Boekesi, la Ngɛnɛ, ongoma osokela olau eoka yende ongoma.
english: You call me, ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord.’ You say so correctly, for so I am.

lokele: Eya to mbo Imi ako Ngɛnɛ la Boekesi, nd’asosööla batindi banu, ambo lole lanu ndosöölana batindi.
english: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.

lokele: Isotamb’ino etichelo, mbo ino imɔ okeleke kwa akeliki nde Imi end’ino.
english: For I have given you an example, that you should also do as I have done to you.

lokele: Wewe, wewe itoonga lanu mbo bɔkɔwa aitolongela ngɛnɛ wande la oyatomomu aitolongela oyatom’inde.
english: Most certainly I tell you, a servant is not greater than his lord, neither is one who is sent greater than he who sent him.

lokele: Boluwa to njasɔ-bi, wende la limɛngɔ ani otokɔcha to yao.
english: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.

lokele: Itionge to loasɔ loanu yaatoti, isoluwa ebasoaa’mi ndoaa iyo, nde yende kwa atomoko nda Lokasa mbo bikɔchɔmɔkɔ biko mbo— Oyasola lituma liami, atoilia Imi la batindi.
english: I don’t speak concerning all of you. I know whom I have chosen; but that the Scripture may be fulfilled, ‘He who eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me.’ Psalms 41:9

lokele: Isokambes’ino loao ko kwani, oso ani lokayi, mbo akayeke loao, ino koimela mbo Imi nd’ayali ko Inde kongo.
english: From now on, I tell you before it happens, that when it happens, you may believe that I am he.

lokele: Wewe, wewe itoonga lanu mbo— Oyatoaela oyakatomeke’mi, ambo aeli nde Imi angɛnɛ; la oyatoaela Imi, ambo aeli nde Inde oyatomakä Imi. Yudasi losokwa nda Elambɔ
english: Most certainly I tell you, he who receives whomever I send, receives me; and he who receives me, receives him who sent me.”

lokele: Aongaka Yesu ongoma Inde looka ngandi finɛ, Inde loonga liölo mbo— Wewe, wewe itoonga lanu mbo ɔmɔi wanu nd’atowamba’mi.
english: When Jesus had said this, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”

lokele: Limɔ baeki lotichakana, iyo lotana fee mbo ndai wau asoongelomo lande.
english: The disciples looked at one another, perplexed about whom he spoke.

lokele: Ɔmɔi wa baeki bande ako oyasamomu la Yesu, aɛkɛmɛkɛ nda bokuku wande;
english: One of his disciples, whom Jesus loved, was at the table, leaning against Jesus’ chest.

lokele: Simona Petelo lomekoel’inde mbo akambeseke to inde oyatoongomo la Yesu.
english: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, and said to him, “Tell us who it is of whom he speaks.”

lokele: Aɛkɛmɛkɛ to inde tina la bokuku wa Yesu, inde loonga lande mbo— Ngɛnɛ, ale to ndai?
english: He, leaning back, as he was, on Jesus’ chest, asked him, “Lord, who is it?”

lokele: Yesu lomutola mbo— Ale boto ona oyatofaefami ofaef’inde yaki eyetolufiela’mi; la Inde lolufia yaki ya lituma nda bosusu limɔ Inde lofaefa Yudasi wana wa Simona wa Keliote.
english: Jesus therefore answered, “It is he to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it.” So when he had dipped the piece of bread, he gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.

lokele: Mbisa ya yaki, Satana lɔɔtɛlɛ Yudasi. Yesu loonga to lande mbo— Elotokel’aɛ, kelaka oko lisasaya.
english: After the piece of bread, then Satan entered into him. Then Jesus said to him, “What you do, do quickly.”

lokele: Nde angwɛnɛ ɔmɔi wa ebayalaka nda bieka oyaluwaka litina eliaongaka Yesu lande;
english: Now nobody at the table knew why he said this to him.

lokele: bamɔi loenyela mbo Yesu loonga lande mbo— Sombeläk’iso yao ebile lasu la boeno nda Elambɔ; kwa mbo afeke eba touwe bieto, eoka Yudasi atolaka sanduku ya bieto.
english: For some thought, because Judas had the money box, that Jesus said to him, “Buy what things we need for the feast,” or that he should give something to the poor.

lokele: Ongoma aelaka Yudasi yaki la lituma, kwaamao inde louma lousa la yaaka mbile ya ocho. Baoi ba Yesu ende Baeki bande liu la ɔmɔi
english: Therefore having received that morsel, he went out immediately. It was night.

lokele: Asilaka Yudasi ndokuswa, Yesu loonga lau mbo— Kwani Wana wa boto asotaliomo tala, la Mungu imɔ asotaliomo imɔ ko lande,
english: When he had gone out, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.

lokele: la Mungu etaliomo ko lande, Mungu imɔ atotalia Inde tala eyande angɛnɛ la atotalia Inde kwanikwani.
english: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and he will glorify him immediately.

lokele: Bana ba booi, ko mbile sinyo Imi ikoyali lanu, bolukaka’mi nde kwa aongaka’mi la BaYuda mbo— Olo akaɛkɛ lami, ino botiakɔkɔlɛkɛ ndoya; kwa atoonga’mi lanu imɔ ko kwani.
english: Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come,’ so now I tell you.

lokele: Isofaef’ino ekela eyai, eko mbo— Samanaka, kwa asosama’mi osam’ino.
english: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.

lokele: Bosamakana, ambo lisamakani lianu koyala ndembe yoluwesa bato batotina mbo wende baeki bami.
english: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”

lokele: Simona Petelo loonga lande mbo— Ngɛnɛ, ɔtɔkɛ to anima? Yesu lomutola mbo— Olo atɔkɛ lami, aɛ angokɔkɔlɔ otuta’mi kwani, nde botutaka mbisa.
english: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you can’t follow now, but you will follow afterwards.”

lokele: Nde Petelo loonga lande mbo— ¿Ngɛnɛ, monito itikɔkɔlɛ ndotut’Aɛ ko kwanikwani? Yemachaka nde liwawi liami ko l’eoka yaɛ!
english: Peter said to him, “Lord, why can’t I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.”

lokele: Yesu lomutola mbo— ¿Bomachaka nde liwawi liaɛ ko l’eoka yami? Wewe, wewe itoonga laɛ mbo— Kɔkɔ angota lɔkɔkɔlɔkɔ oso ani okaanganyi’mi baanganya basatɔ.
english: Jesus answered him, “Will you lay down your life for me? Most certainly I tell you, the rooster won’t crow until you have denied me three times.

lokele: Omachëke mbo botema botatemeke; lendeloko Mungu la lendeloko imɔ ko Imi.
english: “Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.

lokele: Nda ndakɔ ya Sango wami biyaelo wike biyali; etiyale nde ongoma, ani isokambesa nd’ino, eoka itɔkɛ okatonjel’ino elela.
english: In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you.

lokele: Yɛkɛ okatonjel’ino elela, yelainwaka ndoyɔs’ino olo eyami, mbo olo atoyala Imi, ino koyala imɔ ko omao. Ino oluwi nde olo atɔkɛ lami la oluwi imɔ ko mboka.
english: If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.

lokele: Tomasa loonga lande mbo— Ngɛnɛ, totiluwe olo atɔkɛ laɛ, totoluwa to mboka la moni?
english: Thomas said to him, “Lord, we don’t know where you are going. How can we know the way?”

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— Imi yende Mboka la Wewe la Loiko, angwɛnɛ boto wɔkɛ ende Sango, sakolo ngo ko ɛkɛ ko lami.
english: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.

lokele: Boluwa Imi, ani ino koluwa imɔ ko Sango wami; ko kwani osoluw’Inde, osɔɛnɛ Inde.
english: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on, you know him and have seen him.”

lokele: Filipo loonga lande mbo— Ngɛnɛ, ɛnɛsɛkɛ to iso Sango limɔ betema bitoa se.
english: Philip said to him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.”

lokele: Yesu lomutola lande mbo— ¿Kwani asoumwa Imi amamwito lanu ko mbile yumwa, mbo aɛ Filipo otiluwe’mi? Oyasɔɛnɛ’mi asɔɛnɛ imɔ ko Sango; ¿Monito aɛ otofela mbo ɛnɛsɛkɛ iso Sango?
english: Jesus said to him, “Have I been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, Philip? He who has seen me has seen the Father. How do you say, ‘Show us the Father’?

lokele: ¿Oitoimela mbo Imi yende la Sango la mbo Sango ale imɔ lami? Baölo ebatoonga’mi eonga lanu, itionge lanu l’isosha shami angɛnɛ, nde Sango oyayali lami, Inde nd’atokelaka bekeeli yande.
english: Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell you, I speak not from myself; but the Father who lives in me does his works.

lokele: Imelaka to Imi mbo Imi yende la Sango la Sango imɔ lami; ango ko l’eoka ya bekeeli angɛnɛ ebitokelaka’mi.
english: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me; or else believe me for the very works’ sake.

lokele: Wewe, wewe itoonga lanu mbo— Oyatolendelo Imi, ko bekeeli ebitokelaka’mi, inde kokelaka imɔ ko yao, la inde kokela imɔ ko bekeeli yolongela yao, eoka ikokɛndɛ ende Sango.
english: Most certainly I tell you, he who believes in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works than these, because I am going to my Father.

lokele: La bitotina ebikafelek’ino ko la lina liami, Imi kokela ngo ko yao, mbo Sango ataliomoko tala ko la Wana.
english: Whatever you will ask in my name, I will do it, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

lokele: Bofela’mi yeka ko la lina liami, Imi nd’atokela yao.
english: If you will ask anything in my name, I will do it.

lokele: Bosama’mi, ambo bolitesaka nde bikela yami,
english: If you love me, keep my commandments.

lokele: limɔ Imi nd’atofela Sango, la Inde efaefak’ino wasi oyatoyala Boongeli Boongeli angoko Bosungi. wanu woyalaka lanu layalaya
english: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, 14:16 that he may be with you forever:

lokele: ako Bolimo wa wewe; eba wenda batikɔkɔlɛ ndofomo Bolimo-bo, eoka baitoɛnɛ Inde la baitoluwa Inde, nde ino nd’aluwi Inde, eoka Inde ayali lanu la eyalaka lanu.
english: the Spirit of truth, whom the world can’t receive, for it doesn’t see him and doesn’t know him. You know him, for he lives with you and will be in you.

lokele: Iitomach’ino kwa bana ba booi, yeyaka nde end’ino.
english: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.

lokele: Ko mbile sinyo kongo, limɔ wenda botiɛnɛkɛ imɔ Imi, nde ino wɛnɛkɛ nde Imi; eoka Imi yende la liwawi, ino imɔ boyalaka nde la liwawi.
english: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.

lokele: La lise-ao, ino boluwaka mbo Imi yende la Sango, la mbo ino wende lami la Imi imɔ lanu.
english: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.

lokele: Inde oyalitesi nde bikela yami, ambo inde ona oyatosama Imi, oyatosama’mi esamomoko nde la Sango wami; yesamaka inde la yɛnɛnɛkɛ Imi angɛnɛ end’inde fololo.
english: One who has my commandments and keeps them, that person is one who loves me. One who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will reveal myself to him.”

lokele: Yudasi-inga ewa Keliote-lofela Inde mbo— ¿Ngɛnɛ, loyi nde moni mbo wɛnɛnɛkɛ Aɛ angɛnɛ end’iso fololo, inga to ende eba wenda?
english: Judas (not Iscariot) said to him, “Lord, what has happened that you are about to reveal yourself to us, and not to the world?”

lokele: Yesu lomutola lande mbo— Boto esamaka nde Imi, ani elitesaka lioi liami limɔ Sango wami esamaka nde inde la iso toyaka nde end’inde la tosɛlɛkɛ inde kwa eyaelo yasu.
english: Jesus answered him, “If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our home with him.

lokele: Oyatisame Imi, aitolitesa baoi bami; nde lioi elitokak’ino liti liami kangä elia Sango oyatomakä’mi.
english: He who doesn’t love me doesn’t keep my words. The word which you hear isn’t mine, but the Father’s who sent me.

lokele: Isoonga ebaoi-ba lanu ani ikoyali lanu.
english: “I have said these things to you while still living with you.

lokele: Nde Boongeli ako Bolimo Botanu oyakatomeke Sango otomel’ino ko la lina liami, Inde nd’atoekekes’ino bitotina la eenyelesak’ino bitotina eyakambesak’ino Imi angɛnɛ.
english: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I said to you.

lokele: Isotikel’ino lilatemi, isofaef’ino eliami lilatemi; nde itifaef’ino kwa akafeke wenda of’ino. Omachëke mbo botema botatemeke, ofëfëke la bɔwa.
english: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.

lokele: Osooka kwa aongiki’mi lanu mbo isɔkɛ la yeinwa end’ino liasi; eyambo wasamaka Imi, ani wokaka limɛngɔ eoka isɔkɛ ende Sango; eoka Sango alongeli nde Imi.
english: You heard how I told you, ‘I am going away, and I will come back to you.’ If you loved me, you would have rejoiced because I said ‘I am going to my Father;’ for the Father is greater than I.

lokele: Isotakambes’ino oso ani lokayi, mbo akayeke loao, wimeleke nde Imi.
english: Now I have told you before it happens so that when it happens, you may believe.

lokele: Itiaong’imɔ lanu baoi wike, eoka Bokakalesi wa wenda-bo atoya, nde ati lami la loasɔ ango lɔmɔi;
english: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.

lokele: kongo ko itokelaka ngo kwa atelaka Sango otela’mi bikela mbo wenda boluweke mbo isosamaka Sango. Emalaka to, totangweke!
english: But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded me, even so I do. Arise, let’s go from here.

lokele: Imi yende Boliki wa tuma, ewa wewe, la Sango wami ende Ngɛnɛ wa elanga.
english: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.

lokele: Bota wami ako Boliki, botite tuma, Inde atotena wao; nde bota ebotota tuma, Inde kotonjaka wao la kɛmbɛ mbo boteke tuma twasi.
english: Every branch in me that doesn’t bear fruit, he takes away. Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear more fruit.

lokele: Ino nd’asotanesomo ongoma ko l’eoka ya lioi eliaongaka’mi lanu.
english: You are already pruned clean because of the word which I have spoken to you.

lokele: Watemaka mbate lami la Imi ko lanu. Kwa bota botikɔkɔlɛ ndotaka tuma ko wao angɛnɛ sakolo ko bowatema la boliki, ko ongoma ino imɔ otikɔkɔlɛ ndotaka tuma, sakolo ko bowatema nde lami.
english: Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can’t bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me.

lokele: Imi yende boliki, ino wende beta; oyatoyala lami la Imi imɔ lande, ko inde kongo nd’atotaka tuma wike, nde bosɛnyana lami shɛi, ino angokɔkɔlɔ yeka.
english: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.

lokele: Oyatiyale mbate lami, ekushomoko tungi kwa bota la atobɛɛlɛ; limɔ batosɔnjaka beta, batokusha yao nda bösä limɔ betofya.
english: If a man doesn’t remain in me, he is thrown out as a branch and is withered; and they gather them, throw them into the fire, and they are burned.

lokele: Ino boyala mbate lami la tonango twami totikala nda betema yanu, felaka ebikalɛmbɛk’ino, la yao kokeelomo ino.
english: If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.

lokele: Sango wami atotaliomo tala ngo ko la litina-li, liko mbo boteke tuma wike la boyalaka nde ebami baeki.
english: “In this my Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit; and so you will be my disciples.

lokele: Kwa Sango nd’asami Imi, Imi imɔ nd’asami ko ino, tikalaka nda losamɔ loami.
english: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.

lokele: Bolitesa bikela yami, ino kotikala nda losamɔ loami, kwa Imi nd’asolitesa bikela ya Sango wami la isotikala nda losamɔ loande.
english: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love, even as I have kept my Father’s commandments and remain in his love.

lokele: Isoonga baoi-ba end’ino mbo limɛngɔ liami liyaleke lanu la mbo limɛngɔ lianu liiyeleke.
english: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.

lokele: Ekela yami yende mbo bosamaneke kwa asosama’mi osam’ino.
english: “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.

lokele: Angwɛnɛ boto oyatoyala la losamɔ loeta e-losamɔ-lo, loko mbo boto komacha liwawi liande ko l’eoka ya baina lande.
english: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.

lokele: Ino nd’atoyala baina lami eya mbo otokelaka ebitotela Imi otel’ino ekela.
english: You are my friends if you do whatever I command you.

lokele: Imi iitotang’ino imɔ mbo bɛkɔwa, eoka bɔkɔwa atiluwe lona elotokela ngɛnɛ wande, nde isotang’ino mbo baina eoka bitotina eyokakä’mi ende Sango wami, isoluwes’ino yao.
english: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.

lokele: Ino botiaaka nde Imi, kongo ko Imi yaaka nd’ino la Imi yüchak’ino mbo bɔɛkɛ okata tuma, la mbo tuma tumweke yumwa la mbo lona elokafelek’ino ofela Sango nda lina liami, Inde kofaef’ino loao.
english: You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.

lokele: Isotel’ino bikela-bi mbo bosamaneke.
english: “I command these things to you, that you may love one another.

lokele: Eyambo eba wenda beiyana lanu, luwaka to mbo basotaiyana lami oso;
english: If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.

lokele: eya mbo wayala eba wenda, ani eba wenda basosama ko ewau angɛnɛ, nde eoka mbo oti ba wenda-bo la mbo isoaa ino nda wenda-bo, ongoma to eba wenda basoiyana lanu.
english: If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, since I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.

lokele: Enyelaka to liölo elisoonga’mi end’ino mbo— Bɔkɔwa aitolongela ngɛnɛ wande; eyambo bakongoli Imi, ani bekongolaka imɔ ko ino. Eya mbo balitesi lioi liami, ani belitesa imɔ ko elianu.
english: Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his lord.’ John 13:16 If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they kept my word, they will also keep yours.

lokele: Nde batokeelak’ino bitotina-bi ko l’eoka ya lina liami eoka batiluwe oyatomaka’mi.
english: But they will do all these things to you for my name’s sake, because they don’t know him who sent me.

lokele: Aenaka yayaka oyaonga lau, ani batiayalaka la batwanelo, nde kwani bati ango la lioi liomɛsɛl’iyo batwanelo bau.
english: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.

lokele: Oyatoiyela’mi, asoiyela imɔ ko Sango wami.
english: He who hates me, hates my Father also.

lokele: Aenaka yakelaka bikeeli ya bɔfɔɔnɔ ebotiakelaka boto wasi, ani batiayalaka la batwanelo, nde basɔɛnɛ la basoiyela la Imi la imɔ ko Sango wami lisanga.
english: If I hadn’t done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn’t have had sin. But now they have seen and also hated both me and my Father.

lokele: Ongoma to lioi elisotomo nda Lokasa loa Bikela yau lisokɔchɔmɔ, liko mbo— Basoiyana lami ko l’angwɛnɛ eoka. Bolimo Botanu ako Boongeli la Bosungi
english: But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’ Psalms 35:19

lokele: Akayeke Boongeli Boongeli angoko Bosungi. ako Bolimo wa wewe, oyatotoma’mi otom’Inde ende ino, atosokwa ko ende Sango, Inde oyatokuswa ende Sango, nd’atokambesa bato loasɔ loami;
english: “When the Counselor 15:26 has come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me.

lokele: la ino imɔ wende to ebatokambekesa bato loasɔ loami, eoka osoyalaka lami ko nda liakoli.
english: You will also testify, because you have been with me from the beginning.

lokele: Isoonga lanu ongoma mbo botaoka botema wale wa toloi,
english: “I have said these things to you so that you wouldn’t be caused to stumble.

lokele: eoka batosokol’ino nda bisɔngɔmɛlɔ la mbile eyaka nde ani oyatool’ino, inde kotanga nde mbo asokuwela Mungu.
english: They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time is coming that whoever kills you will think that he offers service to God.

lokele: Bekelaka nde ongoma eoka batiluwe ango ko Sango ango Imi.
english: They will do these things 16:3 because they have not known the Father nor me.

lokele: Nde isotakambes’ino njasɔ-bi mbo akayeke mbile ya yao, ino boenyeleke mbo Imi nd’aongaka lanu ongoma.
english: But I have told you these things so that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I didn’t tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.

lokele: Itiaongaka nde lanu nda yao la liakoli eoka yayalaka lanu, nde kwani isoinwa end’Inde oyatomaka’mi la angwɛnɛ angɔmɔi wanu oyatofela’mi mbo— ¿Ɔtɔkɛ to anima?
english: But now I am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’

lokele: Nde ko l’eoka mbo isokambes’ino njasɔ-bi, ikɛnɛnɛ sisotumesa betema yanu.
english: But because I have told you these things, sorrow has filled your heart.

lokele: Kongo ko isoonga lanu wewe mbo bolau end’ino mbo isokweke eoka eyambo itisokwe, ani Boongeli Boongeli angoko Bosungi. atiayeke end’ino; nde yɛkɛndɛkɛ limɔ yetomaka nde Inde end’ino.
english: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is to your advantage that I go away; for if I don’t go away, the Counselor won’t come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.

lokele: Akayek’Inde, atotombola eba wenda loasɔ loa batwanelo la liengani la loasɔ loa likomyi imɔ;
english: When he has come, he will convict the world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment;

lokele: loasɔ loa batwanelo mbo batialendeloko’mi;
english: about sin, because they don’t believe in me;

lokele: loasɔ loa liengani mbo isɔkɛ ende Sango la oitɔɛnɛ imɔ Imi;
english: about righteousness, because I am going to my Father, and you won’t see me any more;

lokele: loasɔ loa likomyi mbo bokakalesi wa wenda-bo asofomo se.
english: about judgment, because the prince of this world has been judged.

lokele: Yende la njasɔ wike yoonga lanu, nde boitokɔkɔlɔ ndokaka yao kwani,
english: “I still have many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.

lokele: nde akayeke Inde, ako Bolimo wa wewe, atotol’ino oso nda mboka ya wewe bototi; eoka aitoonga l’isosha shande angɛnɛ nde yao ebikokek’Inde, ko yao ebitoongaka’Inde la atotaluwes’ino yao ebikayeke kɔni.
english: However, when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself; but whatever he hears, he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming.

lokele: Atotalia’mi tala, eoka atɔɔsɔ eyami limɔ atoluwes’ino ko yao.
english: He will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine and will declare it to you.

lokele: Bitotina ebisɛli nde Sango, yende eyami, eokao yongiki mbo asɔɔsɔ eyami atoluwes’ino ko yao.
english: All things that the Father has are mine; therefore I said that he takes 16:15 of mine and will declare it to you.

lokele: Ko mbile sinyo, limɔ oitɔɛnɛ’mi, mbile yasi sinyo limɔ wɛnɛkɛ nde Imi liasi.
english: “A little while, and you will not see me. Again a little while, and you will see me.”
