lokele: Eokao bamɔi ba baeki bande lofelana mbo— Iye to eyetoonga Inde lasu mbo Mbile sinyo la oitɔɛnɛ’mi, limɔ mbile yasi sinyo la wɛnɛkɛ nde Imi liasi? la imɔ mbo Isɔkɛ ende Sango, ende to iye?
english: Some of his disciples therefore said to one another, “What is this that he says to us, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me;’ and, ‘Because I go to the Father’ ?”

lokele: Iyo loonga imɔ mbo— ¿Iye eyetoong’Inde, mbo Mbile sinyo? Totiluwe litina elisoong’Inde.
english: They said therefore, “What is this that he says, ‘A little while’ ? We don’t know what he is saying.”

lokele: Aluwaka to Yesu mbo balɛmbɛkɛ̈ ndofelak’Inde, limɔ Inde loonga lau mbo— ¿Osofelakana loasɔ loa lioi eliongiki’mi mbo Mbile sinyo la oitɔɛnɛ’mi, limɔ mbile sinyo la wɛnɛkɛ nde Imi liasi?
english: Therefore Jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them, “Do you inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me’?

lokele: Wewe, wewe itoonga lanu mbo otoleela la ngandi la ndeli ani eba wenda batoomakala. Ino bowaka nde l’ikɛnɛnɛ sifi, kongo ko ikɛnɛnɛ shanu sikindolomoko limɛngɔ fuu.
english: Most certainly I tell you that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.

lokele: Botomali nda iyelo atookaka ikɛnɛnɛ sifi, eoka mbile yande esoengana, kongo ko asoot’inde wana, atienyel’imɔ iyelo eoka ya linɛngina mbo boto asoya okenge.
english: A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn’t remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.

lokele: Lanu imɔ eoka kwani wende l’ikɛnɛnɛ sifi, nde yɛnɛkɛ ino liasi, limɔ betema yanu beomakaleke la angwɛnɛ boto angɔmɔi wosokoel’ino limɛngɔ lianu.
english: Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.

lokele: Limɔ nda lise lina otiafeleke nde Imi loasɔ ango lɔmwito nde wewe wewe itoonga lanu mbo boömba Sango yeka, Inde kofaef’ino nda lina liami.
english: “In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you.

lokele: Konda kwani okömbi yeka nda lina liami, ömbaka, limɔ ino kɔɔlɔ mbo limɛngɔ lianu liɔlwɛkɛ hɔlɔɔ.
english: Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.

lokele: Isokambes’ino njasɔ-bi ko la bembila nda mboka nde mbile etoya eyetokambesa’mi ino njasɔ ya Sango ko fololo, angoonga imɔ lanu la bembila.
english: “I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But the time is coming when I will no more speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the Father.

lokele: Nda lise lina boombaka nda lina liami nde itionge lanu mbo yesombokolaka Sango loasɔ loanu,
english: In that day you will ask in my name; and I don’t say to you that I will pray to the Father for you,

lokele: eoka Sango, Inde angɛnɛ asami nd’ino eoka ino nd’asamaka’mi la ino nd’asoimela mbo Imi yasokwaka ko ende Sango.
english: for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came from God.

lokele: Yasokwaka ende Sango la yayaka nda wenda-bo; itosokwa nda wenda la itɔkɛ ende Sango liasi.
english: I came from the Father and have come into the world. Again, I leave the world and go to the Father.”

lokele: Baeki bande loonga mbo— Tɛnɛngɔ, kwani otoonga nde fololo, oitoonga imɔ nda bembila.
english: His disciples said to him, “Behold, now you are speaking plainly, and using no figures of speech.

lokele: Kwani tosoluwa mbo oluwi nde bitotina, boto ati ango la boeno wofelak’Aɛ felo, ko ongoma tosoimela mbo wasokwaka ende Mungu.
english: Now we know that you know all things, and don’t need for anyone to question you. By this we believe that you came from God.”

lokele: Yesu lomutola lau mbo— Wimela nde kwani,
english: Jesus answered them, “Do you now believe?

lokele: tɛnɛ, mbile eyaka nde, esoya oko kwani eyekamelesomoko lanu boto la boto eyande la bomachaka Imi ko ikɛndi nde Imi iti ikɛndi, eoka Sango ale nde lami.
english: Behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place, and you will leave me alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

lokele: Isokambes’ino njasɔ-bi mbo ino bɔɔlɛkɛ lilatemi ko lami, nde nda wenda-bo bɔɔlɛkɛ to bemusi, nde sambokolaka betema yanu eoka Imi nd’asolonga wenda.
english: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”

lokele: Aongakä Yesu ongoma, limɔ Inde loila baiso bande nda use, Inde mbo— Sango, mbile esoya, taliaka to Wana waɛ tala mbo Wana atalieke Aɛ tala;
english: Jesus said these things, then lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, “Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may also glorify you;

lokele: kwa afakä Aɛ of’Inde isosha sholongela bato batotina mbo afeke loiko loa layalaya ende batotina ebafak’Aɛ of’Inde.
english: even as you gave him authority over all flesh, so he will give eternal life to all whom you have given him.

lokele: Loiko loa layalaya lole ko ndoluwa Aɛ, Mungu Ɔmwitoto wa Wewe la oyatomomu laɛ ako Yesu Masiya.
english: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.

lokele: Imi nd’asotalia Aɛ tala ono se, isokela yao eyafak’Aɛ ofaefa’mi ndokela.
english: I glorified you on the earth. I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do.

lokele: Kwani to Sango taliaka Imi tala amamwito laɛ, ko la tala eyaɔlɔkɔ Imi amamwito laɛ oso wa loyaleso loa wenda-bo.
english: Now, Father, glorify me with your own self with the glory which I had with you before the world existed.

lokele: Ende bato ebafak’Aɛ ofa’mi nda wenda, isoisola lina liaɛ. Baaka nde ebaɛ, la wafaka’mi iyo, la basolitesa lioi liaɛ.
english: “I revealed your name to the people whom you have given me out of the world. They were yours, and you have given them to me. They have kept your word.

lokele: Kwani basoluwa mbo bitotina eyefak’Aɛ efaefa’mi, biasokwaka ko ende Aɛ;
english: Now they have known that all things whatever you have given me are from you,

lokele: eoka isofaef’iyo liekesi eliafak’Aɛ efaefa’mi la basoimela liao, la basoluwa wewe mbo yasokwaka end’Aɛ la basoimela mbo Aɛ nd’atomaka Imi.
english: for the words which you have given me I have given to them; and they received them, and knew for sure that I came from you. They have believed that you sent me.

lokele: Isosomboel’iyo, iitosomboela wenda kangä ko loasɔ loa bato ebafak’Aɛ efaefa’mi,
english: I pray for them. I don’t pray for the world, but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours.

lokele: bende to ebaɛ la bitotina ebisɛli nde Imi, yende imɔ ko eyaɛ, la ebile eyaɛ yende imɔ eyami la isotaliomo tala ko lau.
english: All things that are mine are yours, and yours are mine, and I am glorified in them.

lokele: Nde kwani iti’mɔ nda wenda-bo, kongo ko iyo bakoyali nda wenda ani Imi nd’atoya end’Aɛ, Sango Botanu, tɛmyak’iyo nda lina liaɛ eliafaefak’Aɛ efaefa’mi mbo bayaleke ko ɔmwito, kwani ayali ko Iso ɔmwito.
english: I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them through your name which you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are.

lokele: Ayalakä Imi amamwito lau, Imi yatɛmyak’iyo tɛmya nda lina eliafak’Aɛ ofaefa’mi la yatinganaka lau, angwɛnɛ ɔmɔi wau wosɛɛsɛlɛ sakolo ngo ko wana ona wa losɛɛsɛlɔ, mbo lioi lia Lokasa loa Mungu likɔchɔmɔkɔ kɔkɛ.
english: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name. I have kept those whom you have given me. None of them is lost except the son of destruction, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.

lokele: Nde kwani isoya end’Aɛ, nde itoonga baoi-ba ani ikoyali nda wenda mbo baɔlɛkɛ limɛngɔ liami liotumesa betema yau fuu.
english: But now I come to you, and I say these things in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.

lokele: Isofaef’iyo lioi liaɛ la eba wenda basoiyana lau eoka mbo bati ba e-wenda-bo, kwa Imi angɛnɛ iti wa e-wenda-bo.
english: I have given them your word. The world hated them because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

lokele: Itisomboel’Aɛ mbo osokolek’iyo nda wenda, kangä mbo otekames’iyo ende ewa bobe.
english: I pray not that you would take them from the world, but that you would keep them from the evil one.

lokele: Bati ba wenda-bo kwa Imi angɛnɛ iti wa wenda-bo.
english: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

lokele: Uchak’iyo nda Wewe; Lioi liaɛ liende Wewe.
english: Sanctify them in your truth. Your word is truth. Psalms 119:142

lokele: Kwa atomak’Aɛ otoma’mi nda wenda, ko ongoma Imi isotoma iyo nda wenda,
english: As you sent me into the world, even so I have sent them into the world.

lokele: la isüchama Imi angɛnɛ mbo iyo imɔ büchomoko lisanga nda Wewe.
english: For their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.

lokele: Itisomboel’iyo kongo, kangä imɔ ko ebakalendeloko Imi ko l’eoka ya lioi liau,
english: “Not for these only do I pray, but for those also who will believe in me through their word,

lokele: mbo iyo yaatotina bayaleke ko ɔmwito, kwa Aɛ Sango, wende lami ko ɔmwito, lami yende laɛ ko ɔmwito mbo iyo imɔ bayaleke ɔmwito lasu mbo eba wenda bimeleke mbo Aɛ nd’atomaka’mi.
english: that they may all be one; even as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us; that the world may believe that you sent me.

lokele: Imi nd’asofaef’iyo tala eyafak’Aɛ efaefa’mi, mbo bayaleke ɔmwito kwa ayali imɔ ko Iso Ɔmwito.
english: The glory which you have given me, I have given to them, that they may be one, even as we are one,

lokele: Imi batebate lau, l’Aɛ batebate lami mbo baɔlɔlɔkɔ oyala ko ɔmwito mbo wenda boluweke mbo Aɛ nd’atomaka’mi la mbo Aɛ nd’asosamak’iyo kwa asosamak’Aɛ osama’mi.
english: I in them, and you in me, that they may be perfected into one, that the world may know that you sent me and loved them, even as you loved me.

lokele: Sango, Ilɛmbi nde mbo iyo imɔ ebafak’Aɛ efaefa’mi bayaleke amamwito lami olo akayaleke’mi, mbo bɛnɛkɛ tala eyataliak’Aɛ etalia’mi ani wasamaka’mi oso wa baswelo ba e-wenda-bo.
english: Father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am, that they may see my glory which you have given me, for you loved me before the foundation of the world.

lokele: E Sango wa Liengani, ko wenda angɛnɛ angoluw’Aɛ, kangä Imi nd’asoluw’Aɛ, la eba basoluwa mbo Aɛ nd’atomaka Imi;
english: Righteous Father, the world hasn’t known you, but I knew you; and these knew that you sent me.

lokele: la isoluwes’iyo lina liaɛ la yeluwesak’iyo ngo ko ongoma, mbo losamɔ eloasamak’Aɛ osamaka’mi loyaleke nda betema yau la mbo Imi iyaleke ngo ko nda betema yau.
english: I made known to them your name, and will make it known; that the love with which you loved me may be in them, and I in them.”

lokele: O Asilaka Yesu e-lisomboli-li, Inde lokuswa amamwito la baeki bande okaleka botima boko Kedelona olo ayalaka elanga, la Inde la baeki bande lɔɔtɔ omao.
english: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went out with his disciples over the brook Kidron, where there was a garden, into which he and his disciples entered.

lokele: Yudasi imɔ oyasokawamb’Inde aluwaka elela-ao eoka Yesu lotowakanaka la baeki bande omao.
english: Now Judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place, for Jesus often met there with his disciples.

lokele: Ongoma Yudasi lokɔsɔ botuka wa basilikani la polisi ya kanga ebieti la BaFalusi, iyo loya omao la tomwɛli la täla la biɛla.
english: Judas then, having taken a detachment of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, came there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.

lokele: Yesu aluwaka bitotina ebisamboya end’inde limɔ Inde lokuswa nda elanga okaonga lau mbo— ¿Otoluka to ndai?
english: Jesus therefore, knowing all the things that were happening to him, went out and said to them, “Who are you looking for?”

lokele: Iyo lomutola mbo— Yesu wa Nasaleta. Inde loonga lau mbo— Imi-yo. Yudasi oyawamb’Inde loemala amamwito lau;
english: They answered him, “Jesus of Nazareth.” Jesus said to them, “I am he.” Judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with them.

lokele: aongaka to Yesu mbo— Imi-yo, iyo loinwa mbisa, iyo loomana la se.
english: When therefore he said to them, “I am he,” they went backward and fell to the ground.

lokele: Eokao Yesu lofel’iyo liasi mbo— ¿Otoluka to ndai? Iyo loonga mbo— Yesu wa Nasaleta.
english: Again therefore he asked them, “Who are you looking for?” They said, “Jesus of Nazareth.”

lokele: Yesu lomutola mbo— Isokambes’ino mbo Imi-yo. Eya mbo boluka nde Imi, machaka e-bato-ba bakɛkɛ eyau.
english: Jesus answered, “I told you that I am he. If therefore you seek me, let these go their way,”

lokele: Mbo lioi lia Lokasa loa Mungu likɔchɔmɔkɔ liko mbo— Itilefese ango ɔmwito w’ebafak’Aɛ efaefa Imi.
english: that the word might be fulfilled which he spoke, “Of those whom you have given me, I have lost none.” John 6:39

lokele: Petelo to oyasɛli ambɔtɛ lɔɔmɔlɔ wao, inde loswa bɔkɔwa wa kanga eyeti, inde lotinyel’inde litoi lia fangi y’olome; lina lia bɔkɔwa liko Maluku.
english: Simon Peter therefore, having a sword, drew it, struck the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.

lokele: Yesu loonga to la Petelo mbo— Ɔtɛsɛkɛ ambɔtɛ nda ekoko. ¿Imi angomwa kɔpɔ ya bomusi eyesofa Sango efaefa’mi. Yesu oso wa Kanga ebieti
english: Jesus therefore said to Peter, “Put the sword into its sheath. The cup which the Father has given me, shall I not surely drink it?”

lokele: Limɔ botuka wa basilikani la Komanda wau la polisi ya BaYuda lounda Yesu, iyo lokand’Inde.
english: So the detachment, the commanding officer, and the officers of the Jews seized Jesus and bound him,

lokele: Iyo loesh’Inde oso ende Ana eoka inde ako Ana aaka boili wa Kayafa ako Kanga eyeti nda mwaka-ao.
english: and led him to Annas first, for he was father-in-law to Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.

lokele: Aaka nde Kayafa oyaongaka la BaYuda nda ikumbɛ mbo loengani nde mbo boto ɔmɔi aweleke bato batotina. Lianganyi lia Petelo
english: Now it was Caiaphas who advised the Jews that it was expedient that one man should perish for the people.

lokele: Simona Petelo la boeki wasi lotutaka Yesu; boeki ona loluwana la Kanga eyeti to, ongoma inde lɔɔtɔ amamwito la Yesu ko nda lɔ̈mbɔ loa Kanga eyeti,
english: Simon Peter followed Jesus, as did another disciple. Now that disciple was known to the high priest, and entered in with Jesus into the court of the high priest;

lokele: nde Petelo loemala lousa tina la bome. Limɔ boeki ona oyaluwanaka la Kanga eyeti lokuswa, inde loonga la boseka oyalambaka bome, limɔ inde lɔɔtɛse Petelo.
english: but Peter was standing at the door outside. So the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to her who kept the door, and brought in Peter.

lokele: Kongo boseka oyalambaka bome loonga la Petelo mbo— ¿L’aɛ imɔ oti boeki wa boto ona? Inde loonga mbo— Iti wande.
english: Then the maid who kept the door said to Peter, “Are you also one of this man’s disciples?” He said, “I am not.”

lokele: Nde bɛkɔwa la polisi ebemalaka omao, iyo loanesa bosa wa baäla eoka bocho waaka la bondiya, limɔ iyo lɔtɔ wao; la Petelo loemakala imɔ omao amamwito lau ndɔtɔ bosa.
english: Now the servants and the officers were standing there, having made a fire of coals, for it was cold. They were warming themselves. Peter was with them, standing and warming himself.

lokele: Limɔ Kanga eyeti lokɔtɔlɔ Yesu loasɔ loa baeki bande la liekesi liande.
english: The high priest therefore asked Jesus about his disciples and about his teaching.

lokele: Yesu lomutoel’inde mbo— Imi isoonga fololo ende eba wenda, isoekekesa mbile la mbile la nda ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ la nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu olo atosɔngɔkɔmɔ BaYuda batotina, itiekekese ango lomɔi wisakumbo.
english: Jesus answered him, “I spoke openly to the world. I always taught in synagogues and in the temple, where the Jews always meet. I said nothing in secret.

lokele: ¿Otofela to Imi moni? Felaka ebokaka njasɔ eyaekekesaka Imi oekes’iyo; tɛnɛ baluwi nde eyaongaka’mi.
english: Why do you ask me? Ask those who have heard me what I said to them. Behold, they know the things which I said.”

lokele: Aongaka Yesu ongoma, polisi ɔmɔi oyaemali tina, inde looma Yesu lobaka, inde mbo— Otomutola la Kanga eyeti ongoma?
english: When he had said this, one of the officers standing by slapped Jesus with his hand, saying, “Do you answer the high priest like that?”

lokele: Yesu lomutola lande mbo— Eya mbo iongi nde lioi libe, kambesaka to liao. Nde eya mbo lilau, monito osooma’mi lobaka?
english: Jesus answered him, “If I have spoken evil, testify of the evil; but if well, why do you beat me?”

lokele: Lamao Ana lotoma Inde ani akandomu ende Kayafa ako Kanga eyeti.
english: Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas, the high priest.

lokele: Petelo akoemali to ndɔtɔ bosa, bato loonga to lande mbo— ¿Aɛ imɔ oti ɔmɔi wa baeki bande? Inde loanganya mbo— Iti wande.
english: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said therefore to him, “You aren’t also one of his disciples, are you?” He denied it and said, “I am not.”

lokele: Bɔkɔwa ɔmɔi wa Kanga eyeti, oyayali wa bofindi wa boto oyatenomoko litoi la Petelo, inde loonga la Petelo mbo— ¿Imi iisɔɛnɛ aɛ amamwito lande nda elanga?
english: One of the servants of the high priest, being a relative of him whose ear Peter had cut off, said, “Didn’t I see you in the garden with him?”

lokele: Petelo loanganya to liasi, lisasaya kɔkɔ lota lɔkɔkɔlɔkɔ. Yesu la Pilato
english: Peter therefore denied it again, and immediately the rooster crowed.

lokele: Iyo lɔkɛsɛ to Yesu nda ndakɔ ya Komanda ani basokwaka ende Kayafa, yaaka nda mbile ya bakangwelo ba use. BaYuda angɛnɛ batiaɔtɔkɔ nda ndakɔ ya Komanda mbo batawa bokili kangä mbo baleke Elambɔ ya Lieti.
english: They led Jesus therefore from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. It was early, and they themselves didn’t enter into the Praetorium, that they might not be defiled, but might eat the Passover.

lokele: Eokao to Pilato angɛnɛ lokuswa lousa end’iyo la inde loonga mbo— ¿Otowanjela e-boto-yo nda loni to loasɔ?
english: Pilate therefore went out to them and said, “What accusation do you bring against this man?”

lokele: Iyo lomutoel’inde mbo— Aenaka mbo boto-yo ende boto obe, ani iso angoyamach’Inde end’aɛ.
english: They answered him, “If this man weren’t an evildoer, we wouldn’t have delivered him up to you.”

lokele: Pilato loonga to lau mbo— Ino angɛnɛ undaka to Inde la ataka loasɔ loande ko la Bikela yanu. BaYuda loonga lande mbo— Iso toti la isosha shoola boto.
english: Pilate therefore said to them, “Take him yourselves, and judge him according to your law.” Therefore the Jews said to him, “It is illegal for us to put anyone to death,”

lokele: Ongoma lioi eliaongaka Yesu loasɔ loa bɔfɔɔnɔ wa liwa elikaweke’Inde likɔchɔmɔkɔ.
english: that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spoke, signifying by what kind of death he should die.

lokele: Limɔ Pilato lɔɔtɔ liasi nda ndakɔ ya Komanda, inde lota Yesu lioi, inde loonga lande mbo— ¿Aɛ wende Bɔkɔta wa BaYuda?
english: Pilate therefore entered again into the Praetorium, called Jesus, and said to him, “Are you the King of the Jews?”

lokele: Yesu lomutola mbo— ¿Oongi nde ongoma ko loasɔ loaɛ angɛnɛ, kwa mbo basi nd’aongi laɛ loasɔ loami?
english: Jesus answered him, “Do you say this by yourself, or did others tell you about me?”

lokele: Pilato mbo— ¿Imi yende to waYuda? Bende bato ba yese yaɛ angɛnɛ la Kanga ebieti basomach’Aɛ nda besamba yami. ¿End’iye eyekeli Aɛ?
english: Pilate answered, “I’m not a Jew, am I? Your own nation and the chief priests delivered you to me. What have you done?”

lokele: Yesu lomutoel’inde mbo— Yakakaelo yami etiomane la e-wenda-bo; eya to ya wenda-bo ani basungi bami konanakela’mi la bafumbaka mbo BaYuda bataundesa’mi, nde kwanio yakakaelo eyami eti ya wenda.
english: Jesus answered, “My Kingdom is not of this world. If my Kingdom were of this world, then my servants would fight, that I wouldn’t be delivered to the Jews. But now my Kingdom is not from here.”

lokele: Pilato loonga to lande mbo— ¿Oisoyala to Bokota, ako Aɛ? Yesu lomutola mbo— Aɛ nd’aongi mbo yende Bokota; Imi nd’aotomoko la yayaka nda wenda mbo ikambekeseke bato loasɔ loa Wewe. Batotina ebale bana ba Wewe batokaka limiki liami.
english: Pilate therefore said to him, “Are you a king then?” Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. For this reason I have been born, and for this reason I have come into the world, that I should testify to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth listens to my voice.”

lokele: Pilato loonga lande mbo— ¿Iye ende Wewe? la aongak’inde ongoma inde lokuswa lousa liasi ende BaYuda, inde loonga lau mbo— Imi itiɛnɛ litwanelo angolimwito ende Inde.
english: Pilate said to him, “What is truth?” When he had said this, he went out again to the Jews, and said to them, “I find no basis for a charge against him.

lokele: Bole to boyaeli wanu mbo ifaikoelek’ino boto ɔmɔi la mbile ya Elambɔ ya Lieti; ¿Olɛmbi to mbo ifaikoelek’ino Bɔkɔta wa BaYuda?
english: But you have a custom that I should release someone to you at the Passover. Therefore, do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”

lokele: Iyo loamama liasi la limiki lifi mbo— Mba, inga oyo, kangä Balaba! Balaba ayalaka to booni.
english: Then they all shouted again, saying, “Not this man, but Barabbas!” Now Barabbas was a robber.

lokele: Limɔ Pilato loundesa Yesu ndonyɔlɔ Inde la tososola
english: So Pilate then took Jesus and flogged him.

lokele: la basilikani lotaka likala lia kɛ̈kɛ̈, iyo lotel’Inde liao nda botö, iyo lowates’Inde esinda etelu;
english: The soldiers twisted thorns into a crown and put it on his head, and dressed him in a purple garment.

lokele: iyo lokɛkɛ end’Inde okaonga mbo— Liseeli end’Aɛ Bɔkɔta wa BaYuda! Limɔ iyo loomak’Inde mbaka.
english: They kept saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!” and they kept slapping him.

lokele: Pilato lokuswa lousa ko liasi, inde loonga lau mbo— Tɛnɛ ngo, isoeshel’ino Inde lousa ndoluwes’ino mbo itiɛnɛ litwanelo angolimwito ende Inde.
english: Then Pilate went out again, and said to them, “Behold, I bring him out to you, that you may know that I find no basis for a charge against him.”

lokele: Yesu lokuswa to lousa ani awati likala lia kɛ̈kɛ̈ la esinda etelu, limɔ Pilato loonga lau mbo— Ɛnɛkɛ to boto!
english: Jesus therefore came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment. Pilate said to them, “Behold, the man!”

lokele: Nde ɛnɛkɛ̈ Kanga ebieti la polisi wɛnɛ Yesu, iyo loamama likama mbo— Bola nda lieka, bola nda lieka! Pilato mbo— Ino angɛnɛ undesak’Inde okaol’Inde nda lieka, eoka imi angɛnɛ itiɛnɛ litwanelo end’Inde.
english: When therefore the chief priests and the officers saw him, they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify!” Pilate said to them, “Take him yourselves and crucify him, for I find no basis for a charge against him.”

lokele: BaYuda lomutoel’inde mbo— Iso twende l’eyasu ekela, la ko la ekela ena aengani ko ndowa, eoka mbo asokelaka kwa mbo ende Wana wa Mungu.
english: The Jews answered him, “We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.”

lokele: Okakä to Pilato e-lioi-li, inde lowanga la bɔwa loeta,
english: When therefore Pilate heard this saying, he was more afraid.

lokele: inde loinwa liasi nda ndakɔ ya Komanda, inde loonga la Yesu mbo— ¿Osokwi to l’anima? Nde Yesu atiafek’inde limutoli.
english: He entered into the Praetorium again, and said to Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus gave him no answer.

lokele: Ongoma Pilato loonga lande mbo— ¿Oitoonga lami? ¿Otiluwe mbo yende l’isosha shota Aɛ se la isosha shool’Aɛ nda lieka?
english: Pilate therefore said to him, “Aren’t you speaking to me? Don’t you know that I have power to release you and have power to crucify you?”

lokele: Yesu lomutola mbo— Otiyaleke l’isosha ende’mi sakolo ngo ko wafomo shao ko la Use; eokao oto ona oyati nde Imi nda besamba yaɛ, inde nd’ayali la loasɔ eloeta.
english: Jesus answered, “You would have no power at all against me, unless it were given to you from above. Therefore he who delivered me to you has greater sin.”

lokele: Kwaamao Pilato lokotaka ndofaikola Yesu, nde BaYuda loamama mbo— Bofaikola Oyo, aɛ oti wina la Kaisala; oyatolukaka inde angɛnɛ oyala Bɔkɔta, inde nd’atotefokola Kaisala.
english: At this, Pilate was seeking to release him, but the Jews cried out, saying, “If you release this man, you aren’t Caesar’s friend! Everyone who makes himself a king speaks against Caesar!”

lokele: Nde okaka Pilato ebaoi-ba, inde loesha Yesu lousa, limɔ Pilato loyala se nda kɛka ya likɔmɔnyi, nda elela eyatangomu Lɔ̈mbɔ-loa-batalɛ (BaYuda mbo Ngabata).
english: When Pilate therefore heard these words, he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called “The Pavement”, but in Hebrew, “Gabbatha.”

lokele: Liaaka nde lise liotonja Elambɔ ya Lieti la saa liambɛ. Limɔ Pilato loonga la BaYuda mbo— Ɛnɛkɛ to Bɔkɔta wanu!
english: Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover, at about the sixth hour. 19:14 He said to the Jews, “Behold, your King!”

lokele: Iyo loamama to mbo— Sokola, sokola, bola Inde nda lieka! Pilato loonga lau mbo— ¿Yoleke Bɔkɔta wanu nda lieka? Kanga ebieti lomutola mbo— Toti ango la Bɔkɔta sakolo ko Kaisala.
english: They cried out, “Away with him! Away with him! Crucify him!” Pilate said to them, “Shall I crucify your King?” The chief priests answered, “We have no king but Caesar!”

lokele: Lamao Pilato lomach’Inde nda besamba yau mbo aolomoko nda lieka. Liwa nda Lieka
english: So then he delivered him to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus and led him away.

lokele: Iyo loundesa to Yesu, la Inde lotola lieka liande angɛnɛ, Inde lokuswa nda okenge okakɛ nda elela eyatangomu mbo Ngolongota nda baoi ba BaYuda, litina mbo Elela ya longö loa otö.
english: He went out, bearing his cross, to the place called “The Place of a Skull”, which is called in Hebrew, “Golgotha”,

lokele: Omao iyo loanyames’Inde nda lieka amamwito la bato basi bambale, oyo nda fangi, oyo nda fangi eyɛmɔi la Yesu atiteni yau.
english: where they crucified him, and with him two others, on either side one, and Jesus in the middle.

lokele: La Pilato lota nda lionga mbo— Yesu wa Nasaleta, Bɔkɔta wa BaYuda; inde lowacha loao nda lieka.
english: Pilate wrote a title also, and put it on the cross. There was written, “JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

lokele: Wike wa BaYuda lotanga baoi nda lionga eoka elela olo aolomöko Yesu nda lieka yaaka tina la bokenge, la baoi basɔngɔmɔ̈kɔ̈ nda lioi lia BaEbele, la elia BaLoma, la elia BaHela.
english: Therefore many of the Jews read this title, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in Hebrew, in Latin, and in Greek.

lokele: Eokao Kanga ebieti ya BaYuda loonga la Pilato mbo— Ɔsɔnɛ̈kɛ mbo Bɔkɔta wa BaYuda, kangä mbo— Oyo asoonga mbo Imi yende Bɔkɔta wa BaYuda.
english: The chief priests of the Jews therefore said to Pilate, “Don’t write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but, ‘he said, “I am King of the Jews.”’”

lokele: Pilato lomutola mbo— Isosɔnɔ ko liao elisɔni nde’mi.
english: Pilate answered, “What I have written, I have written.”

lokele: Awachaka basilikani owacha Yesu nda lieka, iyo lɔɔsɔ bisinda yande, iyo lokaa yao bakaɔ banɛi, bosilikani likaɔ, bosilikani likaɔ, la kanjo lisanga; nde kanjo etiaaka l’ɛsɔlɛlɔ, yasɔlɔmɔkɔ ko likolo ko se, ko esinda ɛmwito.
english: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also the tunic. Now the tunic was without seam, woven from the top throughout.

lokele: Eokao iyo loongana mbo— Osalakëke yao, nde toteke ngongo nda yao ndoluwa oyakaɔlɛkɛ yao. Ongoma lioi lia Lokasa loa Mungu liakɔchɔmɔkɔ mbo— Basokaana bisinda yami bakaɔ, ebiwati’mi basotela yao ngongo.
english: Then they said to one another, “Let’s not tear it, but cast lots for it to decide whose it will be,” that the Scripture might be fulfilled, which says, “They parted my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.” Psalms 22:18 Therefore the soldiers did these things.

lokele: Basilikani lokela ngo ko ongoma. Baemalakä nde tina la lieka lia Yesu, la nyango wande, la etungani ya nyango, la Malia wali wa Kelofa, la Malia wa Mangandala.
english: But standing by Jesus’ cross were his mother, his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.

lokele: Ɛnɛkɛ̈ to Yesu nyango wande la boeki ona oyasamak’Inde bemesani tina, Inde loonga la nyango mbo— Iya, tɛnɛ wana waɛ-yo!
english: Therefore when Jesus saw his mother, and the disciple whom he loved standing there, he said to his mother, “Woman, behold, your son!”

lokele: Limɔ Inde loonga la boeki ona mbo— Tɛnɛ nyango waɛ-yo! Ko la mbile ena boeki ona lɔkɛ lande nda ndakɔ yande angɛnɛ.
english: Then he said to the disciple, “Behold, your mother!” From that hour, the disciple took her to his own home.

lokele: Mbisa yamao, aluwakä Yesu mbo bitotina bisoiyela mbo lioi lia Lokasa loa Mungu likɔchɔmɔkɔ, Inde mbo— Isoka yɛmɛ yomwa.
english: After this, Jesus, seeing 19:28 that all things were now finished, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, said, “I am thirsty!”

lokele: Tei eyetumi la bänä ba ngai lɔsɛlɔmɔ omao, iyo lofɔɛsɛ lilamba nda bänä, lota liao nda ifende, iyo lotamb’Inde liao nda bɔnɔkɔ.
english: Now a vessel full of vinegar was set there; so they put a sponge full of the vinegar on hyssop, and held it at his mouth.

lokele: Aelaka Yesu bänä ongoma, Inde loonga mbo— Lososila! Limɔ Inde lotulia botö se, Inde loinola bolimo wande.
english: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, “It is finished!” Then he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.

lokele: Eoka lise lina liaaka eliotonja Elambɔ, BaYuda batialɛmbɛkɛ̈ mbo belyo bitikaleke nda baeka nda lise lia Yenga (eoka yenga-ao yaaka nde Yenga efi), iyo lofela Pilato mbo bakolo bau baunakomoko la mbo belyo bisokolomoko.
english: Therefore the Jews, because it was the Preparation Day, so that the bodies wouldn’t remain on the cross on the Sabbath (for that Sabbath was a special one), asked of Pilate that their legs might be broken and that they might be taken away.

lokele: Eokao basilikani loya, iyo louna bakolo ba ewa oso la bao ba oy’ɔmɔi, bako ebolomökö nda baeka amamwito lande.
english: Therefore the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first and of the other who was crucified with him;

lokele: Nde iyaka iyo ende Yesu, ɛnɛkɛ̈ iyo mbo asokwelo oko se, batiaunaka bakolo bande.
english: but when they came to Jesus and saw that he was already dead, they didn’t break his legs.

lokele: Nde ɔmɔi wa basilikani loswa Yesu likonga nda likuka, lisasaya bakila la balia losɛnjwa se.
english: However, one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.

lokele: Boto oyɛnɛkɛ̈ nde la baiso nd’asokambesa loasɔ-lo, la likambesi liande liende ngo ko wewe, la aluwi nde mbo asoonga nde wewe ko mbo ino wimeleke.
english: He who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, that you may believe.

lokele: Bitotina-bi yakelomoko mbo lioi lia Lokasa loa Mungu likɔchɔmɔkɔ, liko mbo— Ikwa shande ango simɔi sitilaunomoko.
english: For these things happened that the Scripture might be fulfilled, “A bone of him will not be broken.” Exodus 12:46

lokele: La lioi liasi lia Lokasa loa Mungu, liko mbo— Betichaka nde Inde oyasotwɛlɛ iyo otwɛlɛ Inde. Liombomu lia Yesu
english: Again another Scripture says, “They will look on him whom they pierced.” Zechariah 12:10

lokele: Mbisa yamao, Yosefa wa Alimatayo oyayali boeki wa Yesu ko wisakumbo eoka awangaka BaYuda, inde lofela Pilato isosha shosokola bolyo wa Yesu la Pilato lokulia. Eokao Yosefa loya oyasokola bolyo wande.
english: After these things, Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, asked of Pilate that he might take away Jesus’ body. Pilate gave him permission. He came therefore and took away his body.

lokele: La Nikodemo imɔ loya oyayaka ende Yesu oso ko la ocho, inde loesha lisɔbyi lia baningo la baɛsɛ, bolito wa kilo kama inɛi.
english: Nicodemus, who at first came to Jesus by night, also came bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred Roman pounds. 19:39

lokele: Iyo lɔɔsɔ bolyo wa Yesu la iyo lokandaka wao la totambala twa bisinda amamwito la lisɔbyi lia baɛsɛ, kwa ayali boömbeli wa BaYuda.
english: So they took Jesus’ body, and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as the custom of the Jews is to bury.

lokele: Elanga yaaka omao nda elela olo aolomoko Inde nda lieka, la nda elanga losai loyai olo angotaömbomo kɔni oto.
english: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden. In the garden was a new tomb in which no man had ever yet been laid.

lokele: Eoka mbo lise lina liyali elia litonji lia Elambɔ ya BaYuda la mbo losai loaka tina, iyo loingesa Yesu omao.
english: Then, because of the Jews’ Preparation Day (for the tomb was near at hand), they laid Jesus there.

lokele: Nda lise lia oso lia yenga, ani lilima likoyali, Malia wa Mangandala loya nda losai la inde lɔɛnɛ litalɛ lisosokolomo nda losai.
english: Now on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene went early, while it was still dark, to the tomb, and saw that the stone had been taken away from the tomb.

lokele: Inde lokwaka mangu ende Simona Petelo la ende boeki wasi ona oyasami Yesu osam’inde limɔ inde loonga lau mbo— Basosokola Ngɛnɛ nda losai la totiluwe olo asoingesomo Inde.
english: Therefore she ran and came to Simon Peter and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved, and said to them, “They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we don’t know where they have laid him!”

lokele: Limɔ Petelo la boeki oyɔmɔi iyo loakola ɔkɛ nda losai.
english: Therefore Peter and the other disciple went out, and they went toward the tomb.

lokele: Iyo yaambale lokwa mangu lilenga, nde boeki ebɔmɔi loetela Petelo mangu, inde loiya oso nda losai.
english: They both ran together. The other disciple outran Peter and came to the tomb first.

lokele: Inde lotulama se, inde lɔɛnɛ bisinda bifufu oko nda nyɛlɛ, nde atiaɔtɔkɔ kɔni nda losai.
english: Stooping and looking in, he saw the linen cloths lying there; yet he didn’t enter in.

lokele: Nde Simona Petelo, inde lotuta la ayaka’inde, inde lɔɔtɔ nda losai, inde lɔɛnɛ bisinda bifufu nda nyɛlɛ
english: Then Simon Peter came, following him, and entered into the tomb. He saw the linen cloths lying,

lokele: la itambala eshalingelomu botö wande, nde sisiami la bisinda la shao loundukwakana nda elela ɛmɔi.
english: and the cloth that had been on his head, not lying with the linen cloths, but rolled up in a place by itself.

lokele: Limɔ boeki ebɔmɔi oyiyaka oso nda losai, inde lɔɔtɔ imɔ, inde lɔɛnɛ la inde loimela.
english: So then the other disciple who came first to the tomb also entered in, and he saw and believed.

lokele: Eoka batitaluweke litina lia Lokasa loa Mungu mbo lole loande ndokuswa liasi nda liwa.
english: For as yet they didn’t know the Scripture, that he must rise from the dead.

lokele: Baeki-ba losokwa okakɛ liasi eyau. Malia wa Mangandala lɔɛnɛ Yesu
english: So the disciples went away again to their own homes.

lokele: Nde Malia loemakala lousa loa losai ani atolelaka; la alelak’inde ongoma, inde lotulama se ndoticha nda losai,
english: But Mary was standing outside at the tomb weeping. So as she wept, she stooped and looked into the tomb,

lokele: inde lɔɛnɛ bakitomo bambale ebawati bisinda bifufu, bayalaka se, ɔmɔi nda fangi ya botö, ɔmɔi nda fangi ya bakolo, olo ayalaka bolyo wa Yesu.
english: and she saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.

lokele: Iyo loonga la Malia mbo— ¿Otomali, otolela moni? Inde loonga lau mbo— Basosokola Ngɛnɛ wami la itiluwe olo asoinges’iyo Inde.
english: They asked her, “Woman, why are you weeping?” She said to them, “Because they have taken away my Lord, and I don’t know where they have laid him.”

lokele: Aongaka inde ongoma, Malia lokikwa mbisa, limɔ inde lɔɛnɛ Yesu emali nde atialuwaka mbo ende Yesu.
english: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing, and didn’t know that it was Jesus.

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— ¿Otolela moni, otomali? ¿Otoluka ndai? Malia atangaka nde mbo ende Botingani wa elanga, inde loonga lande mbo— Bwana, eya to mbo end’aɛ oyasoila bolyo wande, kambesaka’mi olo osoinges’Inde limɔ imi kɔkɛ lande.
english: Jesus said to her, “Woman, why are you weeping? Who are you looking for?” She, supposing him to be the gardener, said to him, “Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have laid him, and I will take him away.”

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— Malia! Limɔ Malia lokikwa, inde loonga lande nda baoi ba BaEbele mbo— Laboni! (Litina mbo Boekesi)
english: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to him, “Rabboni!” 20:16 which is to say, “Teacher!” 20:16

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— Omatëke’mi eoka ikaki kɔni ende Sango wami, nde kɛndɛkɛ ende beoto yami, kambesaka iyo mbo ikɔkɛ ende Sango wami la Sango wanu, Mungu wami la Mungu wanu.
english: Jesus said to her, “Don’t hold me, for I haven’t yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brothers and tell them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’”

lokele: Malia wa Mangandala lɔkɛ okakambesa baeki mbo— Isɔɛnɛ Ngɛnɛ, la mbo asoonga lande ongoma. Baeki liu lɔɛnɛ Yesu
english: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had said these things to her.

lokele: Nda lise-ao to, la litele, liko lise lia oso lia yenga, ani biome ya ndakɔ eyayalaka baeki bikandakomu eoka bawangaka BaYuda, Yesu loya, Inde loemala sisi yau, Inde loonga lau mbo— Lilatemi liyaleke lanu!
english: When therefore it was evening on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were locked where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the middle and said to them, “Peace be to you.”

lokele: Aongak’Inde ongoma, Inde lotamb’iyo bangasa bande la likuka liande, limɔ baeki loyaimwa la limɛngɔ ani basɔɛnɛ Ngɛnɛ.
english: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad when they saw the Lord.

lokele: Limɔ Yesu loonga lau liasi mbo— Lilatemi liyaleke lanu! Kwa atomaka Sango otoma’mi, kwani Imi nd’asotom’ino.
english: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you.”

lokele: Aongaka’Inde ongoma, Inde lokusoel’iyo luli, Inde loonga lau mbo— Ɔlɔkɔ Bolimo Botanu!
english: When he had said this, he breathed on them, and said to them, “Receive the Holy Spirit!

lokele: Bomɛsɛkɛlɛ batwanelo ba bato ambo bao komɛsɛlɔmɔ; bofeka limɛsɛli ambo bao kofekelomo.
english: If you forgive anyone’s sins, they have been forgiven them. If you retain anyone’s sins, they have been retained.”

lokele: Nde Tomasa, ɔmɔi w’eba liu la ambale, oyatangomoko Liäsa, inde atiayalaka lau nda mbile eyayaka Yesu.
english: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, 20:24 wasn’t with them when Jesus came.

lokele: Eokao ebamɔi loakola ndoonga lande mbo— Tosɔɛnɛ Ngɛnɛ! Nde inde loonga lau mbo— Sakolo ngo ko yɛnɛ loelo loa bakɔ̈kɔ nda bangasa bande la kotaka isangakala shami nda elela ya bakɔ̈kɔ la kota lingasa liami nda likuka liande ani imi angoimela. Baeki liu la ɔmɔi lɔɛnɛ Yesu
english: The other disciples therefore said to him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he said to them, “Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.”

lokele: Mbisa ya bacho bonanɛi baeki bande loyala liasi omao nda ndakɔ la Tomasa imɔ amamwito lau. Akandomoko biome, Yesu loemala sisi yau, Inde mbo— Lilatemi liyaleke lanu!
english: After eight days, again his disciples were inside and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, the doors being locked, and stood in the middle, and said, “Peace be to you.”

lokele: Limɔ Inde loonga la Tomasa mbo— Eshaka to isangakala shaɛ eyamaya, ɛnɛkɛ bangasa bami, eshaka lingasa liaɛ la taka liao nda likuka liami, oyalëke la fee, kangä boto wa liimeli.
english: Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.”

lokele: Tomasa lomutola lande mbo— Ngɛnɛ wami la Mungu wami!
english: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— ¿Osoimela ko eoka mbo osɔɛnɛ’mi? Ebasoimela ani batitɛnɛkɛ bende la lɔkɛmɔ loeta.
english: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, 20:29 you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen and have believed.”

lokele: Yesu lokelaka ndembe yasi wike ya tolombo oso wa biɔmbɔ ya baeki bande ebititomo nda lokasa-lo,
english: Therefore Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;

lokele: nde ebi bisotomo mbo wimeleke mbo Yesu ende Masiya, Wana wa Mungu, la mbo ko la liimeli, ino bɔɔlɛkɛ loiko, ko la lina liande.
english: but these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.

lokele: Mbisa yamao Yesu lɔɛnɛlɛ, Inde angɛnɛ, ende baeki liasi nda Eliya ya Tibelia, la Inde lɔɛnɛlɛ ko ani,
english: After these things, Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias. He revealed himself this way.

lokele: bayalaka elela ɛmɔi la Simona Petelo la Tomasa oyatangomoko Liäsa, la Natanaele wa Kana nda Ngalilai la bana ba Sebedai, la baeki basi bambale ba Yesu.
english: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, 21:2 Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were together.

lokele: Simona Petelo loonga lau mbo— Isɔkɛ okaluwa swi. Iyo loonga mbo— Lasu imɔ tɔsɔkɛ laɛ. Iyo losokwa nda okenge, iyo lokwa nda watɔ, nde la bocho-ao batiole yeka.
english: Simon Peter said to them, “I’m going fishing.” They told him, “We are also coming with you.” They immediately went out and entered into the boat. That night, they caught nothing.

lokele: Asɔswaka bonyanya, Yesu loemala nda ngɔngɛ, nde baeki batiluwe mbo ende Yesu.
english: But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach; yet the disciples didn’t know that it was Jesus.

lokele: Yesu loonga to lau mbo— ?Ban’atolome, wende la swi? Iyo lomutola mbo— Mbayɔ!
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Children, have you anything to eat?” They answered him, “No.”

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— Taka to wɛngɔ nda fangi ya olome ya watɔ, limɔ otosha yao. Iyo lota to nde batilonge ndosamba wao eoka ya bokamu wa swi.
english: He said to them, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.” They cast it therefore, and now they weren’t able to draw it in for the multitude of fish.

lokele: Ongoma boeki ona oyasamomu la Yesu, inde loonga la Petelo mbo— Ende Ngɛnɛ! Okakä to Simona Petelo mbo ende Ngɛnɛ, inde lowata esinda, eoka ayali nde wase, limɔ inde loungwa nda balia
english: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It’s the Lord!” So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he wrapped his coat around himself (for he was naked), and threw himself into the sea.

lokele: nde baeki ebamɔi loya se la ndɛli, eoka batiaaka esika la ngɔngɛ, kwa yiso kama bɔɔmwi kongo, iyo losulya wɛngɔ ombisa ani botumi la swi.
english: But the other disciples came in the little boat (for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits 21:8 away), dragging the net full of fish.

lokele: Akwak’iyo nda boili, iyo lɔɛnɛ bösä wa bala la swi eyechakomu nda wao la batuma.
english: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish and bread laid on it.

lokele: Yesu loonga lau mbo— Eshaka swi bimɔi ya yao ebioliki ino kwani.
english: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.”

lokele: Lamao Simona Petelo lɔkɛ okasamba wɛngɔ nda ngɔngɛ, wao lotuma la swi bifi. Yaaka mia la kama bɔɔmwi la swi isatɔ nde ayalaka swi wike, ongoma wɛngɔ angoachacha.
english: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of one hundred fifty-three great fish. Even though there were so many, the net wasn’t torn.

lokele: Yesu loonga lau mbo— Yauku otalaka bieka. Angwɛnɛ angomwito wa baeki lotendela ndofel’Inde mbo— ¿Aɛ wende ndai? Baluwaka mbo ale ko Ngɛnɛ.
english: Jesus said to them, “Come and eat breakfast!” None of the disciples dared inquire of him, “Who are you?” knowing that it was the Lord.

lokele: Yesu loya, Inde lɔɔsɔ lituma, Inde lofaef’iyo liao la swi lisanga.
english: Then Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.

lokele: Eli liende liɛnɛlɛ lia asatɔ eliɛnɛlɛkɛ Yesu ende baeki bande ani asotɛmwa nda liwa. Yesu lofela Petelo mbo— ¿Osami nde’mi?
english: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples after he had risen from the dead.

lokele: Asilak’iyo ndola bieka, Yesu loonga la Simona Petelo mbo— ¿Simona wana wa Yona, osami nde’mi la losamɔ loeta ebamɔi? Inde mbo— Eingo, Ngɛnɛ Aɛ nd’aluwi mbo isami nd’Aɛ. Yesu loonga lande mbo— Lesaka bana ba bɛkɔkɔ yami.
english: So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Feed my lambs.”

lokele: Yesu loonga lionga lia ambale mbo— ¿Simona wana wa Yona, osami nde Imi? Inde mbo— Eingo, Ngɛnɛ, Aɛ nd’aluwi mbo isami nd’Aɛ. Yesu mbo— Kukiaka bɛkɔkɔ yami.
english: He said to him again a second time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Tend my sheep.”

lokele: Yesu loonga lande lionga lia asatɔ mbo— ¿Simona wana wa Yona, osami nde’mi? Petelo looka ikɛnɛnɛ sifi eoka mbo aongi nde elia asatɔ mbo— ¿Osami nde’mi? Limɔ inde loonga la Yesu mbo— Ngɛnɛ, oluwi nde bitotina, Aɛ nd’aluwi la wɛli mbo isami nd’Aɛ. Yesu loonga lande mbo— Lesaka bɛkɔkɔ yami.
english: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, “Do you have affection for me?” He said to him, “Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you.” Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.

lokele: Wewe, wewe, itoonga laɛ mbo— Ayalak’aɛ isenge, aɛ angɛnɛ lokandaka bɔkɔli waɛ, la wakɛndɛkɛndɛkɛ olo alɛmbɛk’aɛ, nde akayalek’aɛ inunu, otonanola besamba yaɛ la wasi nd’atokanda bɔkɔli waɛ, la betolak’aɛ olo atiasangek’aɛ.
english: Most certainly I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted to. But when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will dress you and carry you where you don’t want to go.”

lokele: Yesu loonga ongoma ndoluwesa boweli ebokaweke lande ani atotalia Mungu tala. Limɔ asilak’Inde ndoonga ongoma, Inde mbo— Tutaka’mi. Lofelo loasɔ loa boeki oyasamomoko la Yesu
english: Now he said this, signifying by what kind of death he would glorify God. When he had said this, he said to him, “Follow me.”

lokele: Petelo lokikwa, inde lɔɛnɛ boeki ona oyasamomoko la Yesu ani atotut’iyo ako inde oyaɛkɛmɛkɛ nda bokuku wa Yesu nda elambɔ, la oyaongaka lande mbo— ¿Ngɛnɛ, ende ndai oyatowamb’Aɛ?
english: Then Peter, turning around, saw a disciple following. This was the disciple whom Jesus loved, the one who had also leaned on Jesus’ chest at the supper and asked, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”

lokele: Limɔ ɛnɛkɛ̈ Petelo wɛnɛ inde, inde loonga la Yesu mbo— ¿Ngɛnɛ, oyo moni to?
english: Peter, seeing him, said to Jesus, “Lord, what about this man?”

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— ¿Eya mbo isosanga mbo atikaleke kond’akayeke Imi, lole to loasɔ loaɛ? Aɛ angɛnɛ tutaka’mi.
english: Jesus said to him, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.”

lokele: Eokao lioi-li lomelana ende beoto mbo boeki-bo atilawek’imɔ; kongo ko Yesu atiaongaka lande mbo atilaweke, kangä mbo— ¿Eya mbo isosanga mbo atikaleke kond’akayeke Imi, lole to loasɔ loaɛ?
english: This saying therefore went out among the brothers 21:23 that this disciple wouldn’t die. Yet Jesus didn’t say to him that he wouldn’t die, but, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you?”

lokele: Boeki ona ale ngo ko inde oyɛnɛkɛ la oyakambesaka njasɔ-bi la oyasosɔnɔ yao, la toluwi nde mbo yao ebiong’inde yende ko wewe.
english: This is the disciple who testifies about these things, and wrote these things. We know that his witness is true.

lokele: Yaaka la bekeeli yasi wike imɔ eyakelaka Yesu, la bisɔnɔmɔkɔ bitotina, lɔmɔi la lɔmɔi, itangi nde mbo wenda bototina angoina kasa ebikasɔnɔmɔkɔ.
english: There are also many other things which Jesus did, which if they would all be written, I suppose that even the world itself wouldn’t have room for the books that would be written.
